title: Opportunistic Risk Assessment of Major Osteoporotic Fractures from Routine Chest Radiographs Using Deep Learning
zh_title: 基于常规胸片深度学习的机会性骨质疏松性骨折风险评估
summary: 在5.3万成人中训练CNN生存模型，并在两家独立机构8.5万患者中外部验证，利用常规胸片预测主要骨质疏松性骨折。
key_points: 训练队列53,109人，外部验证85,284人
对象均为已行DXA检查者
主要结局为主要骨质疏松性骨折的发生
reason: 大样本且多机构外部验证，属重要档；无前瞻性结局
abstract: Background Bone mineral density (BMD) and the Fracture Risk Assessment Tool (FRAX) incompletely capture fracture risk in the osteopenic range, where much of the fracture burden occurs. Routine chest radiographs are acquired across a broad range of patients and may contain information relevant to fracture risk, offering a potential opportunistic complement without additional imaging burden. Methods We developed a convolutional neural network survival model in 53,109 adults at a tertiary hospital and externally validated it in 85,284 patients from two independent institutions. Eligibility required a chest radiograph obtained within 1 year of dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry scans, so all participants had been referred for densitometry. The primary outcome was incident major osteoporotic fracture. Discrimination was assessed by using the concordance index (C-index) and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) at 2, 3, 5, and 10 years, compared with FRAX with BMD and with the lowest BMD T-score. Results In the external validation cohorts (mean 58.6 years of age; 68.9% female; and follow-up of 77 months), the deep-learning (DL) model achieved a C-index of 0.843 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.837 to 0.850) and a censoring-adjusted 10-year AUROC of 0.855 (95% CI, 0.846 to 0.863), which was higher than that of FRAX with BMD (C-index, 0.779, 95% CI, 0.770 to 0.787; 10-year AUROC, 0.785, 95% CI, 0.775 to 0.794; both P Conclusions A survival DL model applied to routine chest radiographs identified patients at high fracture risk with discrimination exceeding that of FRAX, with the greatest benefit in patients with osteopenia. As all participants had been referred for densitometry, absolute-risk and case-finding estimates require prospective evaluation in an unselected routine-radiography population. (Funded by the National Research Foundation of Korea and others.).
zh_abstract:
【背景】骨密度（BMD）和骨折风险评估工具（FRAX）不能完全反映骨量减少范围内的骨折风险，而大部分骨折负担正出现在这一范围。常规胸部X线片在广泛的患者中获取，可能包含与骨折风险相关的信息，有望在不增加额外影像负担的情况下作为一种机会性补充手段。
【方法】我们在一家三级医院的53,109名成人中开发了一种卷积神经网络生存模型，并在来自两家独立机构的85,284名患者中进行了外部验证。纳入要求为在双能X线吸收测定扫描后1年内有胸部X线片，因此所有参与者均曾被转诊进行骨密度测定。主要结局为新发主要骨质疏松性骨折。使用一致性指数（C-index）以及2年、3年、5年和10年的受试者操作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）评估区分度，并与结合BMD的FRAX以及最低BMD T值进行比较。
【结果】在外部验证队列中（平均年龄58.6岁；女性占68.9%；随访77个月），深度学习（DL）模型的C-index为0.843（95%置信区间[CI]，0.837至0.850），经删失校正的10年AUROC为0.855（95% CI，0.846至0.863），高于结合BMD的FRAX（C-index，0.779，95% CI，0.770至0.787；10年AUROC，0.785，95% CI，0.775至0.794；两者P值……）。
【结论】应用于常规胸部X线片的生存DL模型识别高骨折风险患者的区分度超过FRAX，在骨量减少患者中获益最大。由于所有参与者均曾被转诊进行骨密度测定，绝对风险和病例发现的估计需要在未经选择的常规X线摄影人群中进行前瞻性评估。（由韩国国家研究基金会等资助。）

title: Routine laboratory trajectories predict organ-level complications in cancer
zh_title: 常规实验室指标轨迹预测癌症器官级并发症
summary: Transformer 利用 3905 例多发性骨髓瘤/卵巢癌患者的纵向常规化验数据，预测两年内新发的 162 种治疗相关并发症。
key_points: 277 万余项化验值，预测 162 种并发症、覆盖八类临床类别
各终点 AUROC 较非序列基线高 0.024–0.070
在 MIMIC-IV 和 MMRF CoMMpass 上做了外部验证
reason: 有外部验证，但人群仅两种癌症；摘要被截断，未见临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Routine laboratory panels drawn during cancer treatment constitute longitudinal physiological recordings of organ function, yet their temporal structure is discarded by single-timepoint prognostic tools. A transformer trained on 2,777,595 laboratory measurements from 3905 patients with multiple myeloma or ovarian cancer predicted which of 162 treatment-associated complications would be newly recorded within two years, spanning eight clinical categories, achieving 1.5- to 6.1-fold enrichment above prevalence. Across individual endpoints it exceeded non-sequential baselines, including engineered-trajectory models, by +0.024 to +0.070 in mean AUROC. Predictions generalised across both cancers, divergence concentrating in disease-specific complications, and biomarker masking recovered signatures consistent with established pathophysiology. External validation on MIMIC-IV and MMRF CoMMpass showed transferability, strongest for renal and metabolic endpoints, attenuated for infection endpoints. On CoMMpass it added prognostic value to ISS staging. Routine oncological laboratory data carry complication-specific physiological signal months before a complication is recorded, and require no testing beyond standard oncological care.

title: Effect of Previsit AI-Generated Document Summaries on Consultation Time and Patient–Physician Communication — The AI-INFOCARE Randomized Controlled Trial
zh_title: 就诊前AI生成文档摘要对问诊时间与医患沟通的影响：AI-INFOCARE随机对照试验
summary: 单中心神经外科门诊随机试验，300人按1:1分组，评估就诊前经质检的AI通俗摘要是否改善患者报告的医患互动质量。
key_points: 300名成人1:1随机分配
主要终点为FAPI医患互动质量
次要终点含自主支持、就诊难度和问诊时长
reason: 随机对照设计、有工作流和沟通结局，但单中心样本较小
abstract: Background Limited health literacy, clinical jargon, and time-constrained consultations often impair patients' understanding of medical findings. We evaluated whether AI-generated, quality-checked lay language summaries provided before consultations improve communication-related outcomes. Methods In this single-center, randomized trial in an outpatient neurosurgical setting, 300 adults were randomly assigned 1:1 to standard care with or without a quality-checked, AI-generated layperson summary of their medical findings (Simply Onno) before consultation. The primary end point was patient-reported quality of physician-patient interaction (Fragebogen zur Arzt-Patient-Interaktion [FAPI]). Secondary end points included autonomy support (Health Care Climate Questionnaire [HCCQ]), encounter difficulty (Difficult Doctor-Patient Relationship Questionnaire [DDPRQ-10]), and consultation duration (minutes). Results The mean FAPI score was higher in the intervention group (4.42±0.51 vs. 4.25±0.54; difference, 0.17; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.05 to 0.29; P=0.005; Hedges' g=0.33), driven by shared decision-making (difference, 0.29; 95% CI, 0.15 to 0.42), with no evidence of a difference in perceived empathy. Patient-rated autonomy support was higher (difference, 0.14; 95% CI, 0.06 to 0.23), whereas physicians rated their own autonomy support slightly lower (difference, -0.12; cluster-robust 95% CI, -0.21 to -0.04). Median consultation time was 25 versus 33 minutes in the intervention group versus the control group, respectively, an approximate 21% relative reduction (ratio of geometric means, 0.79; 95% CI, 0.70 to 0.88). For encounter difficulty (DDPRQ-10), we found potential evidence of a small increase (difference, 0.09; cluster-robust 95% CI, -0.03 to 0.21). Secondary end point confidence intervals were unadjusted for multiplicity. Conclusions AI-generated summaries provided before outpatient neurosurgical consultations were associated with better patient-reported interaction quality and autonomy support and shorter consultations. Physicians rated their own autonomy support as slightly lower in the intervention group; evidence for increased encounter difficulty was limited, with confidence intervals compatible with no difference. These findings support further evaluation of quality-checked, patient-facing document translation; effects on clinical outcomes and clinician workload require confirmation before routine adoption.
zh_abstract:
【背景】健康素养有限、临床术语以及时间受限的诊疗常常妨碍患者对医学检查结果的理解。我们评估了在诊疗前提供经质量核查的、由人工智能（AI）生成的通俗语言摘要是否能改善与沟通相关的结局。
【方法】在这项于门诊神经外科环境中开展的单中心随机试验中，300名成人按1:1随机分配至标准诊疗组，或在诊疗前额外获得一份经质量核查的、由AI生成的关于其医学检查结果的通俗摘要（Simply Onno）的标准诊疗组。主要终点为患者报告的医患互动质量（Fragebogen zur Arzt-Patient-Interaktion [FAPI]）。次要终点包括自主性支持（Health Care Climate Questionnaire [HCCQ]）、诊疗接触困难程度（Difficult Doctor-Patient Relationship Questionnaire [DDPRQ-10]）以及诊疗时长（分钟）。
【结果】干预组的FAPI平均得分更高（4.42±0.51 vs. 4.25±0.54；差值0.17；95%置信区间[CI]，0.05至0.29；P=0.005；Hedges' g=0.33），这主要由共同决策驱动（差值0.29；95% CI，0.15至0.42），而在感知到的共情方面未发现存在差异的证据。患者评定的自主性支持更高（差值0.14；95% CI，0.06至0.23），而医生对自身自主性支持的评分略低（差值-0.12；聚类稳健95% CI，-0.21至-0.04）。干预组与对照组的诊疗时间中位数分别为25分钟和33分钟，相对减少约21%（几何均数之比0.79；95% CI，0.70至0.88）。对于诊疗接触困难程度（DDPRQ-10），我们发现可能存在小幅升高的证据（差值0.09；聚类稳健95% CI，-0.03至0.21）。次要终点的置信区间未针对多重比较进行校正。
【结论】在门诊神经外科诊疗前提供AI生成的摘要，与患者报告的互动质量和自主性支持改善以及诊疗时间缩短相关。干预组中医生对自身自主性支持的评分略低；诊疗接触困难程度增加的证据有限，其置信区间与无差异相容。这些发现支持对经质量核查、面向患者的文档转译开展进一步评估；其对临床结局和临床医生工作量的影响需在常规应用前得到证实。

title: Artificial Intelligence–Enhanced Auscultation to Identify Left Ventricular Dysfunction — Development and External Validation in Prospective Multicenter Studies
zh_title: AI增强听诊识别左心室功能障碍：前瞻性多中心开发与外部验证
summary: 前瞻性多中心研究，用数字听诊结合单导联心电，以Transformer与1D-CNN集成模型检测超声所定义的左心室功能障碍(LVEF≤40%)。
key_points: 转诊行超声心动图的成人前瞻性入组
四个标准听诊部位同步单导联心电
集成Transformer与1D-CNN，含外部验证
reason: 前瞻性多中心并有外部验证，属重要档
abstract: Background Left ventricular dysfunction (LVD) is common and associated with adverse prognosis, even in asymptomatic individuals. Early treatment improves outcomes, underscoring the need for efficient strategies to identify patients who may benefit from echocardiographic evaluation. This study aimed to develop and externally validate an AI auscultation method to detect LVD among patients referred for clinically indicated echocardiography. Methods In this prospective, multicenter study, adult patients referred for echocardiography were enrolled to undergo digital auscultation at four standard auscultation sites with simultaneous single-lead ECGs. LVD was defined as a left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) less than or equal to 40% on concurrent echocardiography. An ensemble model combining a transformer-based network and a one-dimensional convolutional neural network was trained on multicenter data and externally validated. The model's performance was compared with a seven-cardiologist reader substudy and clinical logistic regression models incorporating clinical variables, single-lead ECG-derived features, and B-type natriuretic peptide levels. Results The multicenter training cohort included 2359 patients (mean age, 69.7±13.5 years; 40.4% female; 8.9% with reduced LVEF). The external validation cohort of 964 patients (mean age, 68.6±15.4 years; 38.9% female; 7.6% with reduced LVEF) was obtained from another independent multicenter registry. The four-site AI auscultation outperformed ECG-only models and the clinical logistic models, achieving an area under the receiver operator curve (AUROC) of 0.926 (95% confidence interval [CI], 0.911 to 0.939) in the training cohort. In the external validation cohort, AUROC was 0.904 (95% CI, 0.876 to 0.930) and sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy were 86.3%, 74.2%, and 75.1%, respectively. In a 100-patient reader substudy, AI auscultation outperformed cardiologist consensus in accuracy (82.0% vs. 62.0%; P=0.004). Model performance was consistent across prespecified subgroups. The simplified two-site auscultation model retained high accuracy in the external validation cohort (AUROC, 0.903; 95% CI, 0.878 to 0.927). Conclusions AI auscultation accurately detected LVD among patients referred for clinically indicated echocardiography, supporting its potential as a scalable and accessible pre-echocardiographic risk-enrichment tool. Further validation is warranted before broader screening applications. (Funded by AMI Inc
zh_abstract:
【背景】左心室功能障碍（LVD）很常见，即使在无症状个体中也与不良预后相关。早期治疗可改善结局，这凸显了需要高效策略来识别可能从超声心动图评估中获益的患者。本研究旨在开发并外部验证一种AI听诊方法，用于在因临床指征转诊行超声心动图检查的患者中检测LVD。
【方法】在这项前瞻性多中心研究中，纳入因超声心动图转诊的成年患者，在四个标准听诊部位进行数字听诊，并同步记录单导联心电图。LVD定义为同期超声心动图显示左心室射血分数（LVEF）小于或等于40%。采用结合基于Transformer的网络与一维卷积神经网络的集成模型，在多中心数据上训练并进行外部验证。将该模型的性能与由七名心脏病专家参与的读片者子研究以及纳入临床变量、单导联心电图衍生特征和B型利钠肽水平的临床逻辑回归模型进行比较。
【结果】多中心训练队列包括2359名患者（平均年龄69.7±13.5岁；40.4%为女性；8.9%LVEF降低）。外部验证队列包含964名患者（平均年龄68.6±15.4岁；38.9%为女性；7.6%LVEF降低），来自另一个独立的多中心登记研究。四部位AI听诊优于仅用心电图的模型和临床逻辑模型，在训练队列中受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）为0.926（95%置信区间[CI]，0.911至0.939）。在外部验证队列中，AUROC为0.904（95% CI，0.876至0.930），敏感性、特异性和准确率分别为86.3%、74.2%和75.1%。在一项100例患者的读片者子研究中，AI听诊在准确率上优于心脏病专家共识（82.0% vs. 62.0%；P=0.004）。模型性能在预先设定的各亚组中保持一致。简化的两部位听诊模型在外部验证队列中保持了较高的准确性（AUROC，0.903；95% CI，0.878至0.927）。
【结论】AI听诊能够在因临床指征转诊行超声心动图检查的患者中准确检测LVD，支持其作为可扩展且易于获得的超声心动图前风险富集工具的潜力。在更广泛的筛查应用之前仍需进一步验证。（由AMI Inc资助

title: FIRE-EVIDENCE: enabling LLM-driven, machine-readable evidence synthesis for women’s health
zh_title: FIRE-EVIDENCE：面向女性健康的LLM机器可读证据合成
summary: 提出基于大语言模型的框架，将临床研究全文转化为符合FHIR的结构化可计算证据，并在两个数据集上评估，聚焦女性健康与更年期。
key_points: 将全文临床研究转为FHIR对齐的结构化证据
在7篇开发文档上优化流程
在26项RCT和18项系统综述来源研究上评估
reason: 新颖LLM证据合成方法，评估样本小，无外部临床验证
abstract: Clinical evidence is abundant in the published literature yet remains fragmented and underutilized, particularly in women’s health and menopause, where timely, personalized decision-making is critical. Conventional evidence synthesis relies on resource-intensive manual review, limiting scalability and delaying translation into practice, while automated approaches often produce outputs that are not directly computable or integrable into decision-support workflows. We present FIRE-EVIDENCE, a large language model framework that transforms full-text clinical studies into structured, Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR)-aligned computable evidence. The pipeline was optimized on seven development documents and evaluated on two datasets: a primary dataset of 26 expert-annotated randomized controlled trials and a secondary dataset of 18 studies derived from five systematic reviews. Across expert-annotated trials, FIRE-EVIDENCE achieved 94.35% completeness, 94.61% correctness, 97.36% source faithfulness, and an F1 score of 94.43%. FHIR-compliance testing in a 10-output native FHIR-R5 subset showed that all validated outputs passed base HL7 FHIR validation without errors. FIRE-EVIDENCE demonstrates a feasible pathway for standard-based, machine-readable evidence synthesis.
zh_abstract: 已发表文献中临床证据丰富，但仍然碎片化且未得到充分利用，在女性健康和更年期领域尤为如此，而这些领域恰恰需要及时、个体化的决策。传统的证据综合依赖耗费大量资源的人工审阅，限制了可扩展性并延缓了向临床实践的转化；而自动化方法生成的输出往往不可直接计算，也难以整合进决策支持工作流程。我们提出了 FIRE-EVIDENCE，这是一个大语言模型框架，可将临床研究全文转化为与快速医疗互操作性资源（Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources，FHIR）对齐的结构化、可计算证据。该流程在七份开发文档上进行了优化，并在两个数据集上进行了评估：一个主数据集，包含 26 项经专家标注的随机对照试验；一个次级数据集，包含源自五项系统综述的 18 项研究。在经专家标注的试验中，FIRE-EVIDENCE 的完整性为 94.35%，正确性为 94.61%，来源忠实度为 97.36%，F1 分数为 94.43%。在包含 10 个原生 FHIR-R5 输出的子集中进行的 FHIR 合规性测试显示，所有经验证的输出均无错误地通过了基础 HL7 FHIR 验证。FIRE-EVIDENCE 展示了一条基于标准、机器可读的证据综合的可行路径。

title: A Meta-Research Review of Statistical Practices for Image-Reliant AI Tools Predicting Lung Cancer Outcomes
zh_title: 肺癌影像AI预测工具统计实践的元研究综述
summary: 对36项2023至2025年基于影像的肺癌AI研究进行横断面元研究，评估其方法学严谨性与报告透明度，发现不确定性量化等存在不足。
key_points: 纳入36项研究，75%使用CNN
81%以AUC为主要指标
64%报告不确定性，多限于整体指标置信区间
reason: 元研究综述，有方法学价值，综述类上限6分
abstract: AbstractAI models using medical images are increasingly proposed to support clinical decision-making in lung cancer, motivating assessment of their methodological rigor and transparency. To assess how these models are developed, evaluated, and reported, and to identify gaps in best statistical practices, we conducted a cross-sectional meta-research review of OpenAlex-indexed studies (January 1, 2023, to June 30, 2025) that developed image-based AI tools for lung cancer risk prediction, detection, or prognosis. Thirty-six studies met our inclusion criteria. Convolutional neural networks were used in most studies (27 studies, 75%), and area under the curve (AUC) was the most frequently reported evaluation metric (29 studies, 81%). Although 23 studies (64%) reported some form of uncertainty quantification, most were limited to presenting confidence intervals for global performance metrics (e.g., AUC, sensitivity, and accuracy) rather than individual prediction- or risk-level uncertainty. Common limitations included limited external test set use (14 studies, 39%), insufficient subgroup analyses (10 studies, 28%), and limited adherence to established prediction-model reporting guidelines. Overall, future research should prioritize standardized reporting, use of external test sets, and model performance assessment across clinically relevant subpopulations. The coexistence of increasingly powerful AI-based prediction models with inconsistent study design, evaluation, and reporting practices emphasizes the urgent need to implement more rigorous and transparent methodological standards in this field. (Funded by Yale School of Public Health.).
zh_abstract: 摘要：基于医学影像的AI模型被越来越多地提出用于支持肺癌的临床决策，这促使人们对其方法学的严谨性和透明度进行评估。为评估这些模型的开发、评价和报告方式，并找出最佳统计实践中的不足，我们对OpenAlex收录的研究（2023年1月1日至2025年6月30日）进行了横断面元研究综述，这些研究开发了用于肺癌风险预测、检测或预后的基于影像的AI工具。共有36项研究符合纳入标准。大多数研究使用了卷积神经网络（27项研究，75%），曲线下面积（AUC）是最常报告的评价指标（29项研究，81%）。尽管23项研究（64%）报告了某种形式的不确定性量化，但大多仅限于给出整体性能指标（如AUC、敏感度和准确度）的置信区间，而非个体预测或风险水平的不确定性。常见的局限包括外部测试集使用有限（14项研究，39%）、亚组分析不足（10项研究，28%），以及对既定预测模型报告指南的遵循有限。总体而言，未来研究应优先考虑标准化报告、使用外部测试集，以及在具有临床意义的亚人群中评估模型性能。日益强大的基于AI的预测模型与不一致的研究设计、评价和报告实践并存，凸显了在该领域实施更严格、更透明的方法学标准的迫切需要。（由耶鲁大学公共卫生学院资助。）

title: Comparative Cost of Care Recommended by Large Language Models versus Treating Physicians
zh_title: 大模型与接诊医生所推荐诊疗的成本比较
summary: 评估24个AI系统在200份门诊/急诊病历上的推荐方案，并按2026年Medicare价格与医生记录方案比较检查和转诊成本。
key_points: 24个AI系统，200份MTSamples脱敏病历
三个LLM提取医嘱并按Medicare定价
还测试了成本意识提示和节俭但安全提示
reason: 系统比较大量模型，但为回顾性公开病历，无结局
abstract: Background Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly consulted for clinical decision support, yet the cost of services or treatment they recommend has not been systematically evaluated. Methods We evaluated 24 AI systems on 200 deidentified outpatient and emergency department notes from MTSamples, a public collection of deidentified U.S.-format clinical notes contributed by practicing clinicians. Each system received the presentation recorded before the physician's assessment and wrote its own plan; the physician's documented plan was the comparator. Orders from both were extracted by three independent LLMs and priced at 2026 Medicare rates. The primary outcome was the per-visit total cost of recommended care: diagnostic tests plus specialist referrals. New medications were counted rather than priced. We also tested two prompts: one cost-aware prompt and one parsimonious-but-safe prompt. Results Across the 20 general-purpose systems, AI-suggested care cost a mean of US$314 per visit, compared with US$97 for care recommended by treating physicians - a difference of US$216 per visit (95% confidence interval, US$177 to US$257; P Conclusions The care these systems recommended cost substantially more than physicians' documented care, chiefly because they suggested testing at visits where the physician had ordered none. LLM outputs are suggestions, not plans of care; final decisions should remain with clinicians.
zh_abstract:
【背景】大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于临床决策支持，但其推荐的服务或治疗的成本尚未得到系统评估。
【方法】我们在MTSamples的200份去标识化门诊和急诊科病历上评估了24个AI系统，MTSamples是由执业临床医生提供的、公开的美国格式去标识化临床病历集合。每个系统获得医生评估之前记录的就诊情况，并自行撰写计划；医生记录的计划作为对照。两者的医嘱由三个独立的LLM提取，并按2026年医疗保险（Medicare）费率定价。主要结局为推荐诊疗的每次就诊总费用：诊断检查加专科转诊。新增药物仅计数、不定价。我们还测试了两种提示语：一种为成本意识提示语，另一种为简约但安全的提示语。
【结果】在20个通用系统中，AI建议的诊疗平均每次就诊费用为314美元，而主治医生推荐的诊疗为97美元，每次就诊相差216美元（95%置信区间，177美元至257美元；P值……）。
【结论】这些系统推荐的诊疗费用明显高于医生记录的诊疗，主要是因为它们在医生未开具任何检查的就诊中建议了检查。LLM的输出是建议，而非诊疗计划；最终决定应由临床医生做出。

title: SCAN: Site-Aware Collaborative Privacy-Preserving Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for Neurological Disease Classification
zh_title: SCAN：神经疾病分类中视觉语言模型的站点感知隐私保护适配
summary: SCAN使新站点无需共享脑MRI即可适配3D医学VLM，基于12国67站点7,641例扫描评估阿尔茨海默病、卒中和癫痫分类。
key_points: 站点保留类原型，共享加噪摘要
7,641例扫描，67个站点
未见站点零样本AUC 0.833-0.945
reason: 多国多站点跨站验证，VLM与神经疾病契合，预印本
abstract: Worldwide neuroimaging data could strengthen diagnostic foundation models, but privacy rules often prevent centralizing brain MRI scans. We present SCAN, a site-aware collaborative adaptation framework for Neurological Disease Classification that lets new sites adapt a 3D medical vision-language model (VLM) without retraining or sharing patient scans. Each site keeps exact class prototypes for local prediction and can share privacy-protected class summaries: norm-bounded sums and counts perturbed once with calibrated noise. Using 7,641 scans from 67 sites across 12 countries, covering Alzheimer's disease (AD), stroke, epilepsy and controls, we assess local adaptation, cross-site benefits, and effects on existing sites. At seven unseen sites, the frozen VLM's zero-shot AUCs were 0.833-0.945 for AD and stroke. Training-free local prototypes improved epilepsy AUC at three sites from 0.598/0.625/0.508 to 0.684/0.729/0.762 and AD AUC at one site from 0.833 to 0.863, nearly matching a classifier trained at each site (mean AUC 0.757 vs. 0.759). With differential privacy ($ε$ = 4), new sites contributed without materially reducing accuracy at existing sites (AUC change $\leq$0.2%), although gains from sharing were limited, and membership attacks performed near chance. SCAN offers hospitals a worldwide framework to adapt and share brain MRI VLMs without exchanging scans or retraining.
zh_abstract: 全球范围的神经影像数据可以增强诊断基础模型，但隐私规定往往阻碍脑MRI扫描数据的集中化。我们提出了SCAN，这是一种用于神经系统疾病分类的站点感知协同适配框架，使新站点能够在无需重新训练或共享患者扫描数据的情况下适配三维医学视觉-语言模型（VLM）。每个站点保留精确的类别原型用于本地预测，并可共享受隐私保护的类别摘要：经范数约束的求和与计数，并一次性加入校准噪声。我们使用来自12个国家67个站点的7,641例扫描，涵盖阿尔茨海默病（AD）、卒中、癫痫和对照，评估了本地适配、跨站点获益以及对现有站点的影响。在7个未见过的站点，冻结的VLM对AD和卒中的零样本AUC为0.833-0.945。无需训练的本地原型使3个站点的癫痫AUC从0.598/0.625/0.508提高到0.684/0.729/0.762，并使1个站点的AD AUC从0.833提高到0.863，几乎与在每个站点训练的分类器相当（平均AUC 0.757 vs. 0.759）。在差分隐私（$ε$ = 4）条件下，新站点的加入并未实质性降低现有站点的准确率（AUC变化 $\leq$0.2%），尽管共享带来的增益有限，且成员推断攻击的表现接近随机水平。SCAN为医院提供了一个全球性框架，可在无需交换扫描数据或重新训练的情况下适配和共享脑MRI VLM。

title: A Biologically Interpretable Single-Cell Pathology Foundation Model for Molecular Decoding of H&E Images
zh_title: Loki2：可生物学解释的单细胞病理基础模型，用于H&E分子解码
summary: 提出单细胞分辨率病理基础模型 Loki2，基于含1500万细胞的 UniSeg 资源训练，探讨常规 H&E 中可恢复的分子与细胞信息。
key_points: UniSeg整合1500万细胞，含分割、谱系注释及转录组谱
在细胞表征、分子可恢复性和患者层面相关性上评估
预印本，未经同行评审
reason: 大规模单细胞病理基础模型，命中偏好；预印本，细节有限
abstract: The microscopic structure of human tissues encodes molecular information that is not directly accessible by visual inspection. Current pathology foundation models improve histological interpretation but operate at multicellular resolution. It remains unclear whether routine histology contains structured molecular and cellular information recoverable at single-cell resolution, which biological properties are associated with this recoverability, and where its limits lie. Here, we introduce Loki2, a single-cell pathology foundation model trained on UniSeg, a pan-tissue resource integrating 15 million cells with segmentation, lineage annotations and measured or histology-inferred transcriptomic profiles. We examine the above question across cellular representation, molecular recoverability, and patient-level relevance. Loki2 captures cellular identity and continuous morphological variation, with interpretable latent dimensions linked to physical nuclear phenotypes through DAPI validation. Transcriptomic retrieval and in silico protein staining test molecular recoverability, with gene-level analyses revealing the strongest recovery for genes associated with morphologically distinct cellular identities and functions. Then, patient staging and biomarker discovery connect cellular morphology representations to clinical relevance. Together, these findings establish Loki2 as a biologically interpretable single-cell pathology foundation model and provide the opportunities of recovering cellular and molecular information from routine H&E histology at single-cell resolution.
zh_abstract: 人体组织的微观结构编码了无法通过肉眼观察直接获得的分子信息。目前的病理基础模型改善了组织学解读，但只在多细胞分辨率下运行。目前尚不清楚常规组织学是否包含可在单细胞分辨率下恢复的结构化分子与细胞信息，哪些生物学特性与这种可恢复性相关，以及其局限何在。在此，我们提出 Loki2，一种单细胞病理基础模型，其训练基于 UniSeg——一个整合了1500万个细胞的泛组织资源，包含细胞分割、谱系注释，以及实测或由组织学推断的转录组谱。我们从细胞表征、分子可恢复性和患者层面相关性三个方面探讨上述问题。Loki2 能够捕捉细胞身份和连续的形态学变化，其可解释的潜在维度通过 DAPI 验证与物理性的细胞核表型相关联。转录组检索和计算机模拟蛋白染色用于检验分子可恢复性；基因水平分析显示，与形态学上差异明显的细胞身份和功能相关的基因恢复效果最强。随后，患者分期和生物标志物发现将细胞形态学表征与临床相关性联系起来。总之，这些发现确立了 Loki2 作为一种具有生物学可解释性的单细胞病理基础模型，并为在单细胞分辨率下从常规 H&E 组织学中恢复细胞和分子信息提供了机会。

title: AlphaGenome 2 predicts regulatory activity and variant effects across cell states
zh_title: AlphaGenome 2：跨细胞状态预测调控活性与变异效应
summary: AG2以1Mb DNA序列和组织/细胞类型/状态条件为输入，在人和小鼠单细胞图谱及bulk功能基因组数据上训练，预测基因表达与染色质可及性的变异效应。
key_points: 针对非编码变异的细胞类型特异性预测
基于全生物体人/鼠单细胞图谱训练
以条件输入区分相关细胞状态，无需针对新数据微调
reason: 头部机构基因组基础模型，方法新，但为预印本且摘要缺少评测数字
abstract: Most genetic variants associated with human traits and diseases lie in non-coding DNA, where they can alter gene regulation in specific cell types and states. Single-cell atlases chart these states across tissues and development, but rarely profile enough donors to associate variants with expression directly. Deep learning models could bridge this gap by predicting variant effects from DNA sequence, yet they poorly distinguish related cell states and require fine-tuning for new datasets. Here we present AlphaGenome 2 (AG2), which substantially advances cell-type-specific prediction of regulatory activity and variant effects for gene expression and chromatin accessibility. Trained on organism-wide human and mouse single-cell atlases and bulk functional genomics data, AG2 takes as input a 1-Mb DNA sequence and a condition specifying a target tissue, cell type, or cell state. Conditioning enables AG2 to impute unmeasured epigenomic tracks and predict multimodal variant effects across cell types. Inferring this condition directly from gene expression extends AG2 to unseen datasets and cell states without fine-tuning. AG2 outperforms fine-tuned AlphaGenome 1 and specialized models trained on target datasets, doubling recall of causal single-cell eQTLs at 90% precision. AG2 also achieves state-of-the-art enhancer-gene linking and can pinpoint causal variants at complex trait loci. Across hundreds of human cell types, we generated an atlas of enhancer-gene links and scores for 7 million common variants. As single-cell profiling expands across development, tissues, and disease cohorts, AG2 provides a blueprint for turning observational atlases into variant effect maps.
zh_abstract: 与人类性状和疾病相关的大多数遗传变异位于非编码DNA中，它们可在特定细胞类型和状态下改变基因调控。单细胞图谱描绘了跨组织和发育过程的这些状态，但很少对足够多的供者进行分析，因而难以直接将变异与表达相关联。深度学习模型可通过从DNA序列预测变异效应来弥补这一缺口，但它们难以区分相近的细胞状态，且针对新数据集需要微调。在此我们提出 AlphaGenome 2（AG2），它显著推进了基因表达和染色质可及性的细胞类型特异性调控活性及变异效应预测。AG2 在全生物体范围的人和小鼠单细胞图谱以及bulk功能基因组学数据上训练，输入为1 Mb的DNA序列以及指定目标组织、细胞类型或细胞状态的条件。条件化使 AG2 能够推补未测得的表观基因组轨迹，并预测跨细胞类型的多模态变异效应。直接从基因表达推断该条件，可使 AG2 无需微调即扩展到未见过的数据集和细胞状态。AG2 优于经微调的 AlphaGenome 1 以及在目标数据集上训练的专用模型，在90%精确度下将因果单细胞eQTL的召回率提高一倍。AG2 还实现了最先进的增强子–基因连接，并能在复杂性状位点精确定位因果变异。我们在数百种人类细胞类型中，生成了增强子–基因连接图谱以及700万个常见变异的评分。随着单细胞分析在发育、组织和疾病队列中不断扩展，AG2 为将观察性图谱转化为变异效应图提供了蓝图。

title: When artificial intelligence falls short: Multimodal analysis improves head and neck lymphoma classification.
zh_title: 多模态分析提升头颈部淋巴瘤分类
summary: 基于十家机构610例，将UNI病理特征、CellViT++核形态与临床变量融合，外部队列AUROC约0.80–0.84。
key_points: 仅UNI模型泛化有限，AUROC 0.66
多模态内部AUROC 0.87
两个外部队列AUROC为0.84和0.80
reason: 多机构含外部队列验证，但样本仅610例，命中病理偏好
abstract: [iScience] Artificial intelligence is increasingly applied in digital pathology, yet its generalizability in routine diagnostic settings remains challenging. We developed a multimodal framework for classifying head and neck lymphoid lesions using 610 cases from ten institutions. UNI was used for histological feature extraction, while CellViT++ enabled nuclear segmentation and quantitative morphometry, subsequently integrated with clinicopathological variables. The UNI-based model showed limited generalization (accuracy of 0.66, F1 score of 0.65, and Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.66), whereas multimodal integration substantially improved internal performance (accuracy of 0.91, F1 score of 0.91, and AUROC of 0.87) and maintained performance across two external cohorts (accuracy of 0.84 and 0.79 and AUROC of 0.84 and 0.80). Class-stratified SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) analysis revealed distinct feature attribution patterns across diagnostic groups, with nuclear morphometric features contributing prominently to model predictions. Morphology alone imposes a clear performance ceiling in head and neck lymphomas. Multimodal integration provides a more reliable and clinically relevant approach, supporting diagnostic triage in routine practice.
zh_abstract: [iScience] 人工智能在数字病理学中的应用日益增多，但其在常规诊断场景中的泛化能力仍具挑战。我们利用来自十家机构的 610 例病例，开发了一个用于头颈部淋巴样病变分类的多模态框架。使用 UNI 进行组织学特征提取，同时由 CellViT++ 实现细胞核分割和定量形态测量，随后与临床病理变量整合。基于 UNI 的模型泛化能力有限（准确率 0.66，F1 分数 0.65，受试者操作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）0.66），而多模态整合显著提高了内部性能（准确率 0.91，F1 分数 0.91，AUROC 0.87），并在两个外部队列中保持了性能（准确率分别为 0.84 和 0.79，AUROC 分别为 0.84 和 0.80）。按类别分层的 SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）分析揭示了各诊断组之间不同的特征归因模式，其中细胞核形态测量特征对模型预测的贡献突出。仅凭形态学在头颈部淋巴瘤中存在明显的性能上限。多模态整合提供了一种更可靠且与临床更相关的方法，可支持常规实践中的诊断分诊。

title: Artificial Intelligence in Clinical Hepatology: Emerging Opportunities and Translational Challenges.
zh_title: 临床肝病学中的人工智能：机遇与转化挑战
summary: 综述指出FDA于2025年12月认定首个用于药物试验的AI数字肝活检评估工具，并概述AI在肝病诊断、预后与管理中的研究与转化挑战。
key_points: FDA认定首个AI数字肝活检工具用于药物试验
当前面向患者的应用多为辅助类工具
综述AI在肝病诊断与预后中的研究
reason: 综述类上限6分；含FDA认定信息，但为概览性质
abstract: [Journal of clinical gastroenterology] In December 2025, the Food and Drug Administration assessed and qualified the first artificial intelligence (AI)-powered tool for use in drug development trials; this AI system evaluates digital liver biopsies for steatohepatitis and fibrosis. However, AI is still being investigated before it can be applied directly to patient care in the field of Hepatology. Current patient-facing applications at most institutions are limited to assistive tools such as computer-aided polyp detection and large language model documentation tools that draft clinic notes and patient communications, although there exist radiographic and pathologic liver AI tools that could function at and may even exceed human capabilities. This review provides a broad introduction to AI and highlights clinical research that use AI to enhance the diagnosis, prognostication, and management of liver diseases. It will also discuss the challenges that will need to be overcome before AI can be adopted to clinical practice.
zh_abstract: [Journal of clinical gastroenterology] 2025年12月，美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）评估并认定了首个用于药物研发试验的人工智能（AI）工具；该AI系统可对数字化肝活检切片评估脂肪性肝炎和纤维化。然而，在肝病学领域，AI在能够直接应用于患者诊疗之前仍处于研究阶段。目前大多数机构中面向患者的应用仅限于辅助性工具，如计算机辅助息肉检测，以及用于起草门诊记录和患者沟通内容的大语言模型文书工具，尽管已有一些影像学和病理学肝脏AI工具可能达到甚至超越人类水平。本综述对AI作了较为全面的介绍，并重点介绍了利用AI改进肝病诊断、预后判断和管理的临床研究。本文还将讨论AI应用于临床实践之前需要克服的挑战。

title: From static structures to conformational ensembles: Artificial intelligence for protein sampling and dynamics.
source: PubMed · Current opinion in structural biology
zh_title: 从静态结构到构象系综：AI用于蛋白质采样与动力学
summary: 综述AI如何用于蛋白质构象系综与动力学建模，涵盖加速分子动力学到直接构象采样等方法及其挑战。
key_points: 构象系综建模比单结构预测更难
涉及多时间尺度与数据稀缺
应用于药物发现与蛋白质工程
reason: 综述类，与药物发现相关，上限6档内居中
abstract: [Current opinion in structural biology] After sparking a revolution in protein structure prediction, machine learning (ML), and artificial intelligence (AI) are now reshaping the modeling of protein conformational ensembles and dynamics. A fast, scalable, and accurate representation of protein conformational ensembles could enable genome-scale studies of protein function, with broad applications in drug discovery and protein engineering. The challenges associated with this goal, however, are far greater than those involved in single structure prediction because of the broad timescales spanned by protein motion, the complex relationship between sequence and dynamics, and the scarcity of datasets with experimental measurements. Despite these difficulties, many promising solutions have emerged in recent years, ranging from accelerated molecular dynamics to direct sampling of the conformational distribution, as well as some hybrid methods. Here, we review recent AI-powered approaches to tackle protein dynamics and conformational sampling, and outline their current limitations.
zh_abstract: [Current opinion in structural biology] 在引发蛋白质结构预测革命之后，机器学习（ML）和人工智能（AI）正在重塑蛋白质构象系综与动力学的建模。快速、可扩展且准确地表示蛋白质构象系综，可使基因组规模的蛋白质功能研究成为可能，并在药物发现和蛋白质工程中具有广泛应用。然而，实现这一目标所面临的挑战远大于单一结构预测，原因在于蛋白质运动跨越的时间尺度很宽、序列与动力学之间的关系复杂，以及具有实验测量的数据集稀缺。尽管存在这些困难，近年来仍涌现出许多有前景的解决方案，从加速分子动力学到直接对构象分布进行采样，以及一些混合方法。在此，我们综述了近期应对蛋白质动力学和构象采样的 AI 驱动方法，并概述其当前的局限性。

title: Ontology pre-training improves machine learning-based predictions for metabolites.
zh_title: 本体预训练提升代谢物预测
summary: 提出在通用预训练与任务微调之间加入本体预训练步骤，将生物本体分类层级知识嵌入深度学习模型。
key_points: 作为中间训练步骤嵌入分类层级
改善代谢物功能、活性等预测
缩短训练时间
reason: 方法新颖有提升，证据范围有限
abstract: [PLoS computational biology] Deep learning has recently led to multiple breakthroughs in longstanding biological problems. Recent advances have shown that integration of expert knowledge can improve deep learning model predictive performance in complex domains such as biology. Bio-ontologies offer a rich source of curated biological knowledge that can be harnessed to this end. Here, we describe an intuitive and generalisable approach to embed the knowledge contained in a classification hierarchy derived from a bio-ontology into a deep learning model as an intermediate training step between general-purpose pre-training and task-specific fine-tuning: a process that we call'ontology pre-training'. We show that this approach leads to an improvement in predictive performance and a reduction in training time for a broad range of prediction tasks related to metabolite functions, activities and properties in living systems, using a range of datasets derived from MoleculeNet. We see the biggest improvement for regression tasks, e.g., prediction of lipophilicity and aqueous solubility of molecules, and a robust improvement for most classification tasks. Our approach can be adapted for a wide range of knowledge sources, models and prediction tasks.

title: PeriaTrace: Tooth-Level Grounding Diagnosis and Patient-Facing Explanations from Periapical Radiographs
zh_title: PeriaTrace：根尖片牙位级定位诊断与患者友好解释
summary: 预印本提出三阶段框架，对根尖片做牙位级诊断、可视化定位报告生成及患者解释，在内部及两个外部队列共12,877张影像上评估。
key_points: 内部评估宏Dice 85.35%，定位加FDI识别F1 94.37%
两个外部队列中资深牙髓医师认可率分别为91.16%和84.52%
整合牙位级诊断、定位报告与患者解释
reason: 含外部队列与医师评价，但为预印本、牙科专科，属值得一看档
abstract: Periapical radiographs (PRs) are central to endodontic diagnosis, but interpreting them and preparing reports are time-consuming. Technical language can limit patients' understanding, while existing automated methods often lack tooth-level links between findings and image evidence. We present PeriaTrace, a three-stage framework integrating tooth-level diagnosis, visually grounded report generation, and patient-friendly explanations and care recommendations. PeriaTrace was developed and evaluated using 12,877 PRs from an internal dataset and two external clinical cohorts. In internal evaluation, it achieved a macro Dice coefficient of 85.35%, BLEU-4 of 0.6504, an F1 score of 94.37% for joint tooth localization and Fédération Dentaire Internationale (FDI) identification, and a grounding-tag F1 score of 77.93%. In the two external cohorts, senior endodontists considered 91.16% and 84.52% of reports suitable for retention or revision without complete rewriting. Generation averaged 4.41 seconds per PR, several tens of times faster than manual drafting. Among 196 survey participants without medical backgrounds, 96.4% preferred reports with plain-language explanations and care recommendations, and 84.7% found visual localization cues helpful. PeriaTrace may enable faster, evidence-traceable reporting while supporting clinical review and patient communication. (Abridged version)
zh_abstract: 根尖周X线片（PRs）是牙髓病诊断的核心，但解读片子和撰写报告耗时。专业术语可能限制患者的理解，而现有自动化方法往往缺乏发现与影像证据之间的牙位级关联。我们提出 PeriaTrace，这是一个三阶段框架，整合了牙位级诊断、基于视觉定位的报告生成，以及面向患者的通俗解释和护理建议。PeriaTrace 使用来自内部数据集和两个外部临床队列的 12,877 张 PRs 进行开发和评估。在内部评估中，其宏平均 Dice 系数为 85.35%，BLEU-4 为 0.6504，牙位联合定位与国际牙科联合会（FDI）牙位识别的 F1 分数为 94.37%，定位标签 F1 分数为 77.93%。在两个外部队列中，资深牙髓病专家认为 91.16% 和 84.52% 的报告适合保留或修改而无需完全重写。每张 PR 的平均生成时间为 4.41 秒，比人工撰写快数十倍。在 196 名无医学背景的调查参与者中，96.4% 更喜欢带有通俗解释和护理建议的报告，84.7% 认为视觉定位提示有帮助。PeriaTrace 有望实现更快速、证据可追溯的报告生成，同时支持临床审核和医患沟通。（摘要节选版）

title: Right Diagnosis, Unsafe Route: Auditing Clinical AI Decision Trajectories and Corrective Oversight for Validity and Potential Harm
zh_title: 诊断正确但路径不安全：审计临床AI决策轨迹与纠正性监督
summary: 提出逐步轨迹审计，回放真实入院病例，按潜在危害与临床有效性评价AI每项检查、治疗和处置决策，而非仅看最终诊断。
key_points: 指出最终诊断正确可能经由有潜在危害的中间决策
按检查点释放证据，逐项评定危害与有效性
采用LLM评判并参照医生编写的疾病评分细则
reason: 临床智能体安全评测新框架，预印本，细节有限；契合读者偏好
abstract: A clinical AI system can reach a correct final diagnosis through intermediate decisions that could have harmed the patient, and can repair an error while introducing new risks. Most evaluations score final diagnoses; even stepwise benchmarks, which release a case's evidence over time, score whether systems reach the right diagnosis or gather the right information, not whether the decisions a patient passes through are safe. We make patient safety the target of stepwise evaluation. A trajectory audit replays real admissions checkpoint by checkpoint, lets each system decide with only the evidence released so far, and rates every test, treatment and disposition for its potential harm to the patient and, separately, for clinical validity, against the documented final diagnosis and physician-written disease rubrics yet on the evidence available when the decision was made. An LLM judge scores every decision, and a physician reference standard (triple annotation and senior adjudication of a stratified sample) calibrates the rates. An oversight audit branches each trajectory at its first actionable error and measures, on the same branches, whether corrective feedback repairs the error and whether it introduces new harm. Across 300 cases from a hospital cardiology cohort, MIMIC-IV and the public ASCENT benchmark, with up to seven AI systems per source, 55.2% of hospital trajectories reaching an acceptable final diagnosis passed through a decision with moderate or severe potential harm and 24.8% through a clinically unacceptable one; the harm rates were 76.2% on MIMIC-IV and 39.6% on ASCENT. Structured corrections resolved 73.6% of first errors versus 24.8% after bare rejection, yet new potentially unsafe decisions followed 30.2% of corrections versus 19.7% of rejections. A correct final diagnosis does not certify a safe trajectory, and a successful correction does not certify a safe recovery.
zh_abstract: 临床AI系统可能通过可能伤害患者的中间决策而得出正确的最终诊断，也可能在纠正一个错误的同时引入新的风险。大多数评估仅对最终诊断打分；即便是随时间逐步释放病例证据的分步基准，评分对象也是系统是否得出正确诊断或收集到正确信息，而不是患者所经历的决策是否安全。我们将患者安全作为分步评估的目标。轨迹审计（trajectory audit）按检查点逐步回放真实住院病例，让每个系统仅依据截至当时已释放的证据做出决策，并针对记录在案的最终诊断和医生撰写的疾病评分细则，但基于决策当时可得的证据，对每一项检查、治疗和处置去向的潜在患者伤害以及临床合理性分别进行评级。由大语言模型（LLM）裁判对每项决策评分，并以医生参考标准（对分层样本进行三重标注和资深医生裁定）校准各项比率。监督审计（oversight audit）在每条轨迹首次出现可采取行动的错误处设置分支，并在相同分支上衡量纠正性反馈是否修复了错误以及是否引入了新的伤害。在来自医院心内科队列、MIMIC-IV 和公开的 ASCENT 基准的300例病例中（每个来源最多7个AI系统），达到可接受最终诊断的医院轨迹中，55.2%经历过具有中度或重度潜在伤害的决策，24.8%经历过临床上不可接受的决策；MIMIC-IV 上的伤害率为76.2%，ASCENT 上为39.6%。结构化纠正解决了73.6%的首次错误，而单纯驳回后仅为24.8%；但纠正之后出现新的潜在不安全决策的比例为30.2%，驳回之后为19.7%。正确的最终诊断并不能证明轨迹是安全的，成功的纠正也不能证明恢复过程是安全的。

title: OmniTongue: A Comprehensive MLLM Benchmark for Automated Tongue Diagnosis in Traditional Chinese Medicine
zh_title: OmniTongue：中医舌诊多模态大模型综合基准
summary: 预印本提出首个细粒度中医舌诊VQA基准，含1351张专家验证图像和21616条指令对，覆盖16个临床维度。
key_points: 1351张图像、21616条指令对
16个临床维度与区域级标注
用于评估MLLM舌诊视觉理解
reason: 新MLLM医学基准，预印本，规模中等
abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have excelled in Western medical imaging, yet their potential in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) tongue diagnosis remains systematically unevaluated. Tongue diagnosis requires sophisticated global and local perception, serving as a rigorous touchstone for assessing the visual understanding depth of MLLMs. However, existing datasets are limited by single dimensions, coarse granularity, and ambiguous labels, hindering the evaluation of authentic clinical capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniTongue, the first comprehensive, fine-grained Visual Question Answering benchmark for TCM tongue diagnosis. This benchmark integrates 1,351 expert-validated images and 21,616 instruction pairs. Its core design features 16 clinical dimensions for multidimensional evaluation, region-specific annotations for pathological localization, and 66 fine-grained labels for precise diagnostic representation. Extensive evaluations of existing MLLMs reveal significant performance gaps, demonstrating that medical-specific models lack domain advantages, while universally poor Macro-F1 scores expose a reliance on statistical shortcuts rather than genuine understanding of tongue pathology. These findings not only highlight the current limitations of MLLMs in interpreting regional medical features but also underscore OmniTongue's significance for developing robust automated tongue diagnosis models. The code and dataset will be made publicly available in a future release.
zh_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在西方医学影像领域表现出色，但其在中医（TCM）舌诊中的潜力尚未得到系统评估。舌诊需要精细的整体与局部感知，是检验 MLLMs 视觉理解深度的严格试金石。然而，现有数据集受限于单一维度、粒度粗糙和标签含糊，难以评估真实的临床能力。为填补这一空白，我们提出 OmniTongue，这是首个面向中医舌诊的全面、细粒度视觉问答基准。该基准整合了 1,351 张经专家验证的图像和 21,616 条指令对。其核心设计包括：用于多维度评估的 16 个临床维度、用于病理定位的区域特异性标注，以及用于精确表征诊断的 66 个细粒度标签。对现有 MLLMs 的广泛评估显示出显著的性能差距：医学专用模型并不具备领域优势，而普遍偏低的 Macro-F1 分数表明模型依赖统计捷径，而非真正理解舌象病理。这些发现不仅凸显了当前 MLLMs 在解读区域性医学特征方面的局限，也强调了 OmniTongue 对于开发稳健的自动化舌诊模型的意义。代码和数据集将在后续版本中公开发布。

title: Impact of Pretraining Length, Model Size, and Annotation Budget on Downstream Clinical Tasks of Foundation Models in Radiotherapy
zh_title: 放疗基础模型：预训练时长、模型规模与标注预算的影响
summary: 预印本在约15万例放疗CBCT上以掩码图像建模预训练ViT，考察预训练长度、模型规模和微调策略对下游临床任务的影响。
key_points: 预训练数据约150,000个3D CBCT扫描
下游含喂养管识别（51,135例CBCT，1,562名患者）
分析预训练指标与下游表现的相关性
reason: 大规模放疗影像基础模型系统研究，预印本，属值得一看偏上
abstract: Cone-beam CT (CBCT) scans acquired during radiotherapy capture changes such as tumor shrinkage and radiation-induced tissue changes, offering great potential for foundation models that help monitor individual treatment responses. However, to our knowledge, no large-scale pretrained models for radiotherapy CBCT exist, and evaluating modeling choices is difficult since downstream tasks are not known in advance. We examine how pretraining length, model size, and finetuning strategy relate to downstream clinical performance, and how metrics tracked during pretraining correlate with it. We pretrain vision transformer encoders with masked image modeling on about 150,000 raw 3D radiotherapy CBCT scans, tracking representation quality via validation loss, effective rank, and linear probing. Downstream tasks are classification of feeding tube presence ($n=51,135$ CBCTs, $1,562$ patients) and clinical characteristics (T-, N-stage, sex, age, tumor site; $n=1,278$ patients) in head and neck cancer. We compare low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and full finetuning against no pretraining, varying annotated dataset size. Pretext validation loss was the most consistent predictor of downstream performance; effective rank and linear probing were also associated, but not consistently across model sizes and finetuning methods. LoRA performed comparably to full finetuning while training only 0.5-2.5% of the parameters. Fully finetuned models consistently outperformed models without pretraining across all sizes, with AUROC 0.91-0.97 vs. 0.58-0.85 for feeding tube classification and 0.99-1.00 vs. 0.71-0.97 for sex classification. Model size had only a small, inconsistent effect, suggesting smaller models suffice at lower computational cost. Code and pretrained models (non-commercial license): https://github.com/alexCortinaU/RT-CBCT_SSL
zh_abstract: 放疗期间获取的锥形束CT（CBCT）扫描可捕捉肿瘤缩小和放射诱导的组织变化等改变，为有助于监测个体治疗反应的基础模型提供了巨大潜力。然而，据我们所知，目前尚无针对放疗CBCT的大规模预训练模型，并且由于下游任务事先未知，评估建模选择十分困难。我们研究了预训练时长、模型规模和微调策略与下游临床性能之间的关系，以及预训练期间所跟踪的指标与下游性能的相关性。我们在约150,000例原始三维放疗CBCT扫描上，采用掩码图像建模（masked image modeling）对视觉Transformer编码器进行预训练，并通过验证损失、有效秩（effective rank）和线性探测（linear probing）跟踪表征质量。下游任务为头颈癌中的饲管存在分类（n=51,135例CBCT，1,562例患者）以及临床特征分类（T分期、N分期、性别、年龄、肿瘤部位；n=1,278例患者）。我们在改变标注数据集规模的情况下，将低秩适应（LoRA）和全量微调与未经预训练的模型进行了比较。预训练任务（pretext）的验证损失是下游性能最一致的预测指标；有效秩和线性探测也与之相关，但在不同模型规模和微调方法之间并不一致。LoRA的性能与全量微调相当，而仅训练0.5%-2.5%的参数。在所有模型规模下，全量微调的模型始终优于未经预训练的模型：饲管分类的AUROC为0.91-0.97，对比0.58-0.85；性别分类为0.99-1.00，对比0.71-0.97。模型规模的影响很小且不一致，提示较小的模型即可满足需求，且计算成本更低。代码和预训练模型（非商业许可）：https://github.com/alexCortinaU/RT-CBCT_SSL

title: Where Does Hindsight Enter Clinical Agent Benchmarks? An Audit of Simulators and Case Construction
zh_title: 临床智能体基准中的事后偏倚审计
summary: HindAudit基于MIMIC-IV的27,489例急诊入院，审计模拟器、回顾性语境和病例文本三条事后信息通道；最大影响来自病例文本。
key_points: 区分三类事后信息通道
模拟检验结果未见明显泄漏
病例文本改写影响最大
reason: 大样本基准审计，方法有新意，但为预印本
abstract: Benchmarks for LLM diagnostic agents are built from retrospective records: the case an agent reads is rewritten from discharge summaries, and unrecorded test results are generated by a simulator that often sees the final diagnosis. HindAudit separates three hindsight channels (the diagnosis given to the simulator, the retrospective context it conditions on, and the agent-facing case text) and measures each with judges trained only on real data. On 27,489 emergency admissions from MIMIC-IV, five registered tests found no leakage into simulated laboratory results: providing the diagnosis to five simulators had a negligible effect, and prompted gatekeepers diluted the diagnostic signal, although exploratory results suggest they can raise agent scores. The largest effect lay in the case text. Against a presentation-time reconstruction from triage records, benchmark-style summaries raised the zero-shot accuracy of four LLMs from 25.4% to 39.7% and discharge histories to 45.3%, and raised six interactive agents' scores while barely changing their ranking. The exploratory gap was reproduced in a registered replication on held-out patients. Masking diagnosis names left it unchanged. Because MIMIC lacks a contemporaneous bedside history, the gap is an upper bound on hindsight. We report all registered outcomes and recommend construction practices.
zh_abstract: LLM 诊断智能体的基准是基于回顾性记录构建的：智能体所读的病例由出院小结改写而成，未记录的检查结果则由常常能看到最终诊断的模拟器生成。HindAudit 区分了三条后见之明（hindsight）通道（提供给模拟器的诊断、模拟器所依据的回顾性上下文，以及面向智能体的病例文本），并使用仅在真实数据上训练的评判器对每条通道进行测量。在来自 MIMIC-IV 的 27,489 例急诊入院病例中，五项预先注册的检验均未发现模拟实验室结果存在泄漏：向五个模拟器提供诊断的影响可以忽略，而经提示的守门者（gatekeeper）会稀释诊断信号，不过探索性结果提示它们可能提高智能体得分。最大的影响出现在病例文本方面。与基于分诊记录重建的就诊时点文本相比，基准风格的小结使四个 LLM 的零样本准确率从 25.4% 提高到 39.7%，出院病史则提高到 45.3%，并提高了六个交互式智能体的得分，而其排名几乎不变。这一探索性差距在对留出患者进行的预先注册重复研究中得到再现。遮蔽诊断名称并未改变该差距。由于 MIMIC 缺少同期的床旁病史，该差距是后见之明的上限。我们报告了所有预先注册的结局，并推荐相应的构建实践。

title: Beyond Acuity Accuracy: A Multidimensional Framework for Evaluating Patient-Facing Emergency Triage AI Tools
zh_title: 超越分诊准确率：面向患者的急诊分诊AI评估框架
summary: 提出SAFE-Triage多维评估框架，在10,030例分诊分析中比较两种LLM分诊方式，提示式LLM准确率更高、欠分诊更低。
key_points: 整合人工、自动指标与LLM评审
PLT的ESI准确率57.5%对42.8%
揭示准确率与欠分诊等权衡
reason: 评估框架较完整，样本较大，但为预印本且基于模拟病例
abstract: Patient-facing AI triage tools may support care-seeking and emergency department prioritization, but require evaluation beyond acuity accuracy alone. We developed SAFE-Triage, a framework integrating human review, automated metrics, LLM-as-judge evaluation, and simulation testing across clinical performance, patient interaction, and clinician-facing summary quality. We applied SAFE-Triage to 40 MIMIC-IV-derived emergency vignettes and a 10,030-case acuity analysis comparing prompted LLM triage (PLT) with rule-augmented prompted LLM triage (rPLT). PLT achieved higher emergency severity index (ESI) accuracy (57.5% vs 42.8%, $P < 0.001$), lower undertriage (13.1% vs 29.8%, $P < 0.001$), and higher clinician ratings across all domains. rPLT produced shorter and more stable outputs with higher automated readability scores. SAFE-Triage identified trade-offs between acuity accuracy, undertriage risk, communication quality, readability, and summary quality, supporting pre-deployment refinement and ongoing monitoring by showing where triage tools are efficient, need improvement, or need clinician oversight.
zh_abstract: 面向患者的人工智能分诊工具可能有助于就医行为和急诊科优先级排序，但其评估不应仅限于病情严重程度判断的准确性。我们开发了SAFE-Triage框架，该框架整合了人工评审、自动化指标、LLM-as-judge（以大语言模型为评判者）评估和模拟测试，涵盖临床表现、患者交互以及面向临床医生的摘要质量。我们将SAFE-Triage应用于40个源自MIMIC-IV的急诊病例情景，以及一项包含10,030例的病情严重程度分析，比较提示式LLM分诊（PLT）与规则增强的提示式LLM分诊（rPLT）。PLT的急诊严重度指数（ESI）准确率更高（57.5% vs 42.8%，$P < 0.001$），分诊不足率更低（13.1% vs 29.8%，$P < 0.001$），并且在所有维度上获得了更高的临床医生评分。rPLT生成的输出更短、更稳定，自动化可读性评分更高。SAFE-Triage识别出了病情严重程度准确性、分诊不足风险、沟通质量、可读性和摘要质量之间的权衡，通过显示分诊工具在哪些方面高效、需要改进或需要临床医生监督，支持部署前的优化和持续监测。

title: SimAI: Mechanistic User Simulation through Psychological Network Models
zh_title: SimAI：基于心理网络模型的机制性用户模拟
summary: 提出以心理网络建模用户行为的模拟框架，并构建含18,576对档案-网络的PSYCHE数据集，来源于516例心理治疗个案。
key_points: 图重建目标提供图级奖励
PSYCHE数据集源自516个心理治疗案例
模拟多样性优于现有患者模拟器
reason: 心理健康用户模拟新方法并含数据集，预印本，命中偏好
abstract: Realistic user simulation enables the study of human interactions when direct experimentation is costly or potentially harmful. However, existing simulators largely overlook the psychological mechanisms that drive user behavior. We introduce SimAI, a framework for mechanistic user simulation that models how psychological factors interact to shape user responses. To overcome the challenge of supervising open-ended behavior, we propose a graph reconstruction objective that provides graph-level rewards based on how well simulated conversations reflect the underlying psychological relationships. To support this approach, we construct PSYCHE, a dataset of 18,576 profile-network pairs derived from 516 psychotherapy cases. Automatic evaluations show that SimAI achieves greater simulation and behavioral diversity than existing patient simulators while maintaining strong profile alignment. In an interactive study with 30 mental-health professionals and trainees, SimAI receives the highest average ratings for conversational authenticity, realistic help-seeking behavior, and clinical training utility. Beyond simulation quality, SimAI enables realistic clinical training and uncovers safety failures in prolonged AI interactions with vulnerable users. Code is available at https://github.com/behavioral-data/ANGEL-UserSim.
zh_abstract: 当直接实验成本高昂或可能有害时，逼真的用户模拟使研究人类互动成为可能。然而，现有模拟器在很大程度上忽视了驱动用户行为的心理机制。我们提出 SimAI，这是一个用于机制性用户模拟的框架，对心理因素如何相互作用以塑造用户反应进行建模。为克服监督开放式行为的挑战，我们提出一种图重建目标，根据模拟对话对潜在心理关系的反映程度提供图级奖励。为支持该方法，我们构建了 PSYCHE 数据集，包含源自 516 个心理治疗案例的 18,576 个个人档案-网络对。自动评估显示，SimAI 在保持较强档案一致性的同时，比现有患者模拟器实现了更高的模拟性和行为多样性。在一项有 30 名心理健康专业人员和受训者参与的交互式研究中，SimAI 在对话真实性、逼真的求助行为和临床培训效用方面获得了最高平均评分。除模拟质量外，SimAI 还能实现逼真的临床培训，并揭示在与脆弱用户的长时间 AI 交互中存在的安全故障。代码见 https://github.com/behavioral-data/ANGEL-UserSim。

title: HealthCLBench:Evaluating Context Learning in Health Conversations through Controlled Case Clusters
zh_title: HealthCLBench：健康对话情境学习评测
summary: 提出中文健康对话基准，含328个受控案例簇、1103个案例和4931条评分细则，评估模型对情境的获取与运用。
key_points: 案例簇内背景相同而证据或目标变化
70人医学团队标注与审核
覆盖医疗咨询与日常健康管理
reason: 新医学LLM基准，规模中等，预印本
abstract: Complex health conversations require answers grounded in individual information and currently valid evidence. We evaluate health context learning: acquiring, integrating, and applying relevant context during inference with fixed model parameters to answer health questions and respond appropriately to changes in facts, evidence, or task goals. To our knowledge, Chinese-language medical benchmarks have yet to systematically combine explicit contextual difficulties, controlled case variations, and member-specific medical criteria for open-ended answers. We introduce HealthCLBench, comprising 328 controlled clusters, 1,103 cases, and 4,931 rubric criteria across medical consultation and everyday health management. Members share backgrounds while evidence, patient states, or task goals change; each has its own medical scoring requirements. A 70-person medical team annotates and reviews the simulated cases and their rubrics. Human review of 700 full-context responses from the original evaluation yields 90.5% pooled agreement with the original automated judgments at the rubric-item level. We report full-context and query-only results for seven general-purpose models and Ant Afu. Across the eight systems, full- query differences range from 11.83 to 31.76 case points and from 10.87 to 38.97 geometric cluster points. GPT-6-Astra leads both full-context metrics at 75.03 and 60.42, followed by Claude-Opus-5-5 and Ant Afu. Cross-condition differences describe score changes under the reported evaluation settings. Response comparisons reveal failures in checking historical information, expressing uncertainty when warranted, and ensuring recommendations respect required conditions. The resource supports model comparison and targeted follow-up evaluation.
zh_abstract: 复杂的健康对话需要基于个体信息和当前有效证据的回答。我们评估健康情境学习（health context learning）：在模型参数固定的前提下，于推理过程中获取、整合并应用相关情境，以回答健康问题，并对事实、证据或任务目标的变化做出恰当回应。据我们所知，中文医学基准尚未系统性地将显性情境难点、受控病例变体以及针对开放式回答的成员特异性医学标准结合起来。我们提出 HealthCLBench，包含 328 个受控簇、1,103 个病例和 4,931 条评分细则（rubric）标准，涵盖医疗咨询和日常健康管理。簇内成员共享背景，而证据、患者状态或任务目标各有变化；每个成员拥有各自的医学评分要求。一个 70 人的医学团队对模拟病例及其评分细则进行标注和审核。对原始评估中 700 条完整情境回答进行的人工审核显示，在评分细则条目层面，与原始自动判定的合并一致率为 90.5%。我们报告了七个通用模型和 Ant Afu 在完整情境和仅提问（query-only）条件下的结果。在这八个系统中，完整情境与仅提问之间的差异范围为 11.83 至 31.76 个病例分，以及 10.87 至 38.97 个几何簇分。GPT-6-Astra 在两项完整情境指标上均居首位，分别为 75.03 和 60.42，其后为 Claude-Opus-5-5 和 Ant Afu。跨条件差异描述的是在所报告评估设置下的得分变化。回答比较揭示了以下方面的失误：核查历史信息、在需要时表达不确定性，以及确保建议符合所要求的条件。该资源可支持模型比较和有针对性的后续评估。

title: SlideJev: Order-Stable and Tissue-Grounded Jev Decisions for Whole-Slide Pathology
zh_title: SlideJev：全切片病理VQA中顺序稳定且组织落地的判断
summary: 针对病理视觉问答中VLM依赖语言先验、对选项顺序敏感的问题，提出逐候选答案验证并对组织证据落地的框架。
key_points: VLM答案受候选顺序影响，存在绕过组织证据的捷径
用支持与拒绝对数似然之差为每个候选打分
并行评分且无选项位置信息，以保证顺序稳定
reason: 病理VLM新方法，预印本，摘要未见外部验证；命中病理/VLM偏好
abstract: Whole-slide visual question answering (VQA) offers a natural-language interface to pathology, allowing diagnostic and phenotypic questions to be answered directly from tissue slides. However, current vision-language models (VLMs) rely heavily on linguistic priors: their answers are sensitive to the order of the candidate answers, and can be reached through shortcuts that bypass the tissue evidence. To address these challenges, we introduce SlideJev, a framework that separately verifies candidate answers against the slide and learns to ground these judgments in tissue evidence. To connect parallel candidate evaluation with visual evidence learning, we adopt Jev and score each candidate by the difference between support and rejection log-likelihoods from the original language-model head. We compute these scores in parallel using separate prompts with the same format and no option-position labels, then normalize them for answer selection. To ground these scores in tissue evidence, candidate-conditioned reading and comparison guide gated updates to visual tokens across decoder layers. With the backbone frozen, we train these visual modules through the same scores using question-answer and paired-image supervision. Across three whole-slide pathology VQA benchmarks, SlideJev achieves the highest mean overall accuracy and 100% answer consistency across four option orders. Image-control experiments further show that SlideJev achieves the largest average accuracy gains from correct images over mismatched and image-free inputs across the three datasets. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/leowu-ai/SlideJev.
zh_abstract: 全切片视觉问答（VQA）为病理学提供了自然语言接口，使诊断和表型相关问题能够直接根据组织切片作答。然而，当前的视觉-语言模型（VLM）严重依赖语言先验：其答案对候选答案的顺序敏感，并可能通过绕过组织证据的捷径得出。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 SlideJev，这是一个针对切片分别验证候选答案，并学习将这些判断建立在组织证据之上的框架。为将并行的候选答案评估与视觉证据学习联系起来，我们采用 Jev，并以原始语言模型头输出的支持与否定对数似然之差为每个候选答案打分。我们使用格式相同且不含选项位置标签的独立提示并行计算这些分数，然后对其归一化以选择答案。为使这些分数建立在组织证据之上，以候选答案为条件的阅读与比较引导各解码器层中视觉 token 的门控更新。在骨干网络冻结的情况下，我们利用问答及配对图像监督，通过相同的分数训练这些视觉模块。在三个全切片病理 VQA 基准上，SlideJev 取得了最高的平均总体准确率，并在四种选项顺序下达到 100% 的答案一致性。图像对照实验进一步表明，在三个数据集上，与不匹配图像输入和无图像输入相比，SlideJev 从正确图像中获得的平均准确率提升最大。我们的代码已公开于 https://github.com/leowu-ai/SlideJev。

title: Visual Harness Scales General VLMs to Medical Images
zh_title: 视觉Harness将通用VLM扩展到医学图像
summary: 提出医学视觉harness，为通用VLM配备交互式视觉工具与诊断证据记忆，在4种模态的11项任务上提升性能。
key_points: VLM交互检查图像，并将证据存入无损记忆
提交初答后接受遗漏与可靠性评估，迭代修正
使用Qwen3.8-27B时11项任务均有提升
reason: 多模态VLM智能体新方法，覆盖11项任务，预印本，无临床验证
abstract: We show that an appropriate visual harness can substantially improve the performance of general vision-language models (VLMs) across diverse medical imaging tasks. We introduce \ours, a medical visual harness that equips general VLMs with interactive visual tools and systematic diagnostic evidence management. With \ours, general VLMs interactively explore medical images and progressively acquire diagnostic evidence, which is preserved in a lossless memory for subsequent retrieval and use. After submitting an initial answer, the VLM receives an assessment of potential omissions and the reliability of identified findings. This assessment guides further image inspection and measurement, followed by answer revision in an iterative agentic loop until sufficient evidence is obtained. Across 11 tasks and four imaging modalities, \ours improves performance on all tasks with Qwen3.8-27B, with notable gains in spleen measurement (63.3\% to 98.3\%), renal search (57.5\% to 71.2\%), and pulmonary nodule detection (0.0\% to 28.2\%). High-capability API-based VLMs achieve even higher performance with \ours. For example, GPT-6.1 Sol improves pulmonary nodule detection from 10.8\% to 69.2\% with \ours, demonstrating the complementary benefits of stronger model capabilities and an effective medical visual harness. Our results highlight the potential of visual harnesses as a new paradigm for scaling general VLMs to medical imaging tasks.
zh_abstract: 我们证明，合适的视觉“挽具”（visual harness）可显著提升通用视觉-语言模型（VLM）在多种医学影像任务中的表现。我们提出 \ours，这是一种医学视觉挽具，为通用 VLM 配备交互式视觉工具和系统化的诊断证据管理。借助 \ours，通用 VLM 可交互式地探查医学图像并逐步获取诊断证据，这些证据保存在无损记忆中，供后续检索和使用。在提交初始答案后，VLM 会收到关于潜在遗漏及已识别发现可靠性的评估。该评估指导进一步的图像检查和测量，随后在迭代式智能体循环中修订答案，直至获得足够的证据。在 11 项任务和四种影像模态上，\ours 使 Qwen3.8-27B 在所有任务上的表现均有提升，其中脾脏测量（63.3% 提升至 98.3%）、肾脏搜索（57.5% 提升至 71.2%）和肺结节检测（0.0% 提升至 28.2%）提升尤为显著。能力更强的基于 API 的 VLM 在使用 \ours 后取得更高的表现。例如，GPT-6.1 Sol 借助 \ours 将肺结节检测从 10.8% 提升至 69.2%，表明更强的模型能力与有效的医学视觉挽具具有互补效益。我们的结果凸显了视觉挽具作为一种将通用 VLM 扩展到医学影像任务的新范式的潜力。

title: RetiDual-Select: Reliability-Aware Specialist-Generalist Routing for Retinal OCT under Image-Quality Shift
zh_title: RetiDual-Select：图像质量漂移下视网膜OCT的专家-通才可靠路由
summary: 结合RETFound与MedSigLIP图像编码器，用校准融合、危害守卫和复核评分处理视网膜OCT分类中的图像质量漂移。
key_points: 静态PoE融合在三个数据集上达到最高或并列最高的干净数据准确率
2%可接受错误目标下，Kermany-4接受94.3%，选择性准确率99.89%
设置验证冻结的危害守卫，防止自适应融合推翻正确判断
reason: 眼科基础模型融合方法，多数据集评估，预印本；命中眼科偏好
abstract: Adaptive fusion can repair a static ensemble's errors, but can also overturn correct decisions. RetiDual-Select combines retinal specialist RETFound with the image encoder of the medical vision-language model MedSigLIP, separating candidate fusion, routing safety and predictive review. Calibrated product-of-experts (PoE) fusion is the static reference, a small gate proposes an alternative for each image, a validation-frozen harm guard decides whether that candidate may replace the reference, and a separate score prioritizes review. Static PoE reached the highest or joint-highest clean accuracy on all three datasets. At a clean 2% accepted-error target the review policy accepted 94.3% of Kermany-4 images at 99.89% selective accuracy, and 92.4% of OCT-C8 at 98.65%. Both branches were correct on 95.0% and 91.8% of clean images; only 4.4% and 6.2% had exactly one correct branch. Across 15 prespecified synthetic conditions, adaptive gains were concentrated in severe contrast reduction, where this routing opportunity widened roughly ninefold; percentile rescaling largely removed the effect, linking it to compressed dynamic range. In post-hoc validation-only analyses, gain was higher when the gate followed the more reliable branch, and a frozen guard cut the worst-condition OCT-C8 loss from 1.39 to 0.36 percentage points. Adaptive routing was useful when image quality created a reliability opportunity and the gate followed it; otherwise the system retained Static PoE or deferred for review. The findings are bounded by the synthetic perturbations evaluated and do not establish robustness to natural acquisition or scanner shift.
zh_abstract: 自适应融合可以修正静态集成的错误，但也可能推翻原本正确的决策。RetiDual-Select 将视网膜专科模型 RETFound 与医学视觉-语言模型 MedSigLIP 的图像编码器相结合，并将候选融合、路由安全性和预测复核分离开来。校准的专家乘积（product-of-experts，PoE）融合作为静态参照，一个小型门控网络为每幅图像提出一个替代方案，验证集冻结的伤害防护器（harm guard）决定该候选是否可替代参照，另有一个独立评分用于对复核进行优先排序。静态 PoE 在三个数据集上均取得最高或并列最高的干净图像准确率。在干净图像可接受错误率目标为 2% 时，复核策略接受了 94.3% 的 Kermany-4 图像，选择性准确率为 99.89%；接受了 92.4% 的 OCT-C8 图像，选择性准确率为 98.65%。两个分支在 95.0% 和 91.8% 的干净图像上均判断正确；仅有 4.4% 和 6.2% 的图像恰有一个分支判断正确。在 15 种预先设定的合成条件中，自适应收益集中在严重对比度降低的情形，此时这种路由机会扩大了约九倍；百分位重缩放在很大程度上消除了这一效应，提示其与动态范围被压缩有关。在事后仅用验证集的分析中，当门控网络跟随更可靠的分支时收益更高，且冻结的防护器将 OCT-C8 最差条件下的损失从 1.39 个百分点降至 0.36 个百分点。当图像质量带来可靠性机会且门控网络跟随该机会时，自适应路由是有用的；否则系统保留静态 PoE 或转交复核。这些结论受限于所评估的合成扰动，不能证明对真实采集条件或扫描仪差异具有稳健性。

title: MedGuardBench: A Patient-Oriented Benchmark for Personalized Guardrail Development
zh_title: MedGuardBench：面向患者的个性化用药安全护栏基准
summary: 提出患者条件化用药护栏任务，发布覆盖87种药物、5001个场景的MedGuardBench，并开发个性化推理护栏方法。
key_points: 任务：依据患者档案与处方预测安全结论及17类风险
发现常规护栏依赖表面措辞线索而非患者事实
提出个性化推理蒸馏与上下文展开（CU）以减少误报
reason: 新基准且问题有意义，但为预印本、场景多为构造，属值得一看档
abstract: Safety is personal: the same action can be safe for one person but unsafe for another. Yet current guardrails judge content without considering who is affected. Using medication safety, we introduce \textit{patient-conditioned medication guarding}, which predicts a safety verdict and 17 risk categories from a patient profile and prescription. We release \textbf{MedGuardBench}, a drug-disjoint benchmark of 5{,}001 scenarios across 87 medications. We find that standard guardrails rely on surface cues, such as wording and profile presence, rather than patient facts. To address this, we develop \textit{personalized reasoning guardrails} with three components. \textbf{Personalized Reasoning Distillation} links risks to relevant patient fields. \textbf{Context Unrolling (CU)} makes models check each field themselves, reducing false alarms on most backbones; controls show that providing the check does not yield the same benefit. A \textbf{rule-based reward (guided GRPO)} improves unsafe recall and complex-risk detection, including allergies and adverse reactions, on some backbones, but increases false alarms on others. Our models outperform base models and matched no-profile controls in accuracy, while reducing false alarms relative to no-profile controls. Profile removal and swapping confirm that gains come from patient information, not fine-tuning alone.
zh_abstract: 安全是因人而异的：同一行为对某个人可能是安全的，对另一个人却可能不安全。然而，现有的防护机制在判断内容时并未考虑受影响的是谁。以用药安全为例，我们提出\textit{以患者为条件的用药防护}（patient-conditioned medication guarding），即根据患者档案和处方预测安全性判定及 17 个风险类别。我们发布了 \textbf{MedGuardBench}，这是一个药物互不重叠（drug-disjoint）的基准，包含涉及 87 种药物的 5{,}001 个场景。我们发现，标准防护机制依赖措辞和是否提供患者档案等表面线索，而非患者的实际情况。为解决这一问题，我们开发了包含三个组成部分的\textit{个性化推理防护}。\textbf{个性化推理蒸馏}（Personalized Reasoning Distillation）将风险与相关的患者字段关联起来。\textbf{上下文展开}（Context Unrolling，CU）使模型自行核查每个字段，在大多数骨干模型上减少了误报；对照实验显示，仅提供核查内容并不能带来同样的收益。\textbf{基于规则的奖励（引导式 GRPO）}在部分骨干模型上提高了不安全情形的召回率以及对复杂风险（包括过敏和不良反应）的检出，但在其他骨干模型上增加了误报。我们的模型在准确率上优于基础模型和匹配的无档案对照，同时相对于无档案对照减少了误报。移除和替换患者档案的实验证实，性能提升来自患者信息，而不仅仅是微调。

title: MI-Hyper: Generating Multiple Instance Models for Weight Space Transfer Learning in Histopathology via Mixed Tasks Pretrained HyperNetwork
zh_title: MI-Hyper：病理零样本WSI预测的超网络权重生成
summary: 用混合任务预训练的超网络为新病理任务生成多实例学习模型权重，在52个数据集的308个任务上略优于MI-Zero。
key_points: 超网络生成MIL的聚合与分类权重
覆盖52个病理数据集共308个任务
平均AUC较MI-Zero提升1.85个百分点
reason: 病理方法新颖、任务覆盖广，但提升幅度小且为预印本
abstract: Zero-shot whole-slide image (WSI) prediction aims to generalize to new pathology tasks without parameter updates at deployment. MI-Zero makes these predictions by pooling patch-text similarities. Conditional weight generation, combined with supervision from diverse pathology tasks, offers an alternative: learning to construct predictive rules from task descriptions. We introduce MI-Hyper, a hypernetwork pretrained across mixed tasks to generate the aggregation and classification weights of multiple instance learning (MIL) models. We first train the generator and a shared MIL basis jointly using source labels. We then freeze the basis and refine the generator. The generated task weights are reused across cases. Across 308 tasks from 52 pathology datasets, MI-Hyper improves mean AUC, balanced accuracy and macro-F1 over MI-Zero by 1.85, 1.17 and 0.57 percentage points, respectively. On some molecular prediction tasks, both AUC and balanced accuracy improve by more than 20 points. These results support task-conditioned weight generation as a promising approach to weight-space transfer for long-sequence modeling.
zh_abstract: 零样本全切片图像（WSI）预测旨在部署时无需更新参数即可泛化到新的病理任务。MI-Zero 通过汇聚图像块与文本的相似度来进行此类预测。条件权重生成结合来自多样化病理任务的监督，提供了一种替代方案：学习根据任务描述构建预测规则。我们提出 MI-Hyper，这是一种在混合任务上预训练的超网络（hypernetwork），用于生成多实例学习（MIL）模型的聚合权重和分类权重。我们首先利用源任务标签联合训练生成器和共享的 MIL 基底；随后冻结该基底并对生成器进行精调。所生成的任务权重可在不同病例间重复使用。在来自 52 个病理数据集的 308 项任务上，MI-Hyper 的平均 AUC、平衡准确率和宏平均 F1 分别比 MI-Zero 提高了 1.85、1.17 和 0.57 个百分点。在部分分子预测任务上，AUC 和平衡准确率均提高了 20 个百分点以上。这些结果支持将任务条件化的权重生成作为一种有前景的方法，用于长序列建模中的权重空间迁移。

title: SRED: Sparse Regional Evidence Distillation Across Magnifications in Whole-Slide Imaging
zh_title: SRED：全切片图像跨倍率稀疏区域证据蒸馏
summary: 用稀疏自编码器从20x教师特征学习事件字典，将区域事件出现信息蒸馏到低倍率模型，无需切片级标签。
key_points: 解决跨倍率蒸馏中低倍率难以获取细节的问题
SAE事件字典加逻辑OR池化记录区域事件
无需切片级标签，便于扩展
reason: 病理计算效率方法有新意，但摘要未给结果，预印本
abstract: In computational pathology, high-magnification whole-slide image analysis preserves tissue detail but requires encoding many patches, whereas lower magnification reduces computation by covering a higher field of view per patch while sacrificing detail. Existing cross-magnification distillation matches features that often encode detail unreachable by low-magnification input, sometimes requiring slide-level labels that limit scalability. To address those issues, we introduce Sparse Regional Evidence Distillation (SRED), which transfers regional event occurrences that encode reachable high-level interactions between details without slide-level labels. We use a sparse autoencoder (SAE) to learn an event dictionary from 20x teacher features. Logical OR pooling records whether each event is detected in any spatially aligned patch, retaining both localized and shared evidence within the corresponding 5x region. A pretrained 5x encoder is fine-tuned to predict these regional targets without slide-level labels. Visual analysis identifies dictionary components responsive to recognizable histological patterns, supporting target interpretation. Compared with native 5x features, SRED improves average macro-F1 by 1.1 points across seven classification and grading cohorts and average C-index by 1.7 points across five survival cohorts. Runtime matches native 5x, with an average 11.58x speedup over 20x.
zh_abstract: 在计算病理学中，高倍率全切片图像分析可保留组织细节，但需要对大量图像块进行编码；而较低倍率下每个图像块覆盖更大的视野，从而降低计算量，但牺牲了细节。现有的跨倍率蒸馏方法匹配的特征往往编码了低倍率输入无法获取的细节，有时还需要切片级标签，限制了可扩展性。为解决这些问题，我们提出稀疏区域证据蒸馏（SRED），它在无需切片级标签的情况下，迁移编码细节之间可达的高层交互的区域事件发生情况。我们使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）从 20 倍教师特征中学习事件字典。逻辑“或”池化记录每个事件是否在任一空间对齐的图像块中被检测到，从而在对应的 5 倍区域内同时保留局部性证据和共享证据。预训练的 5 倍编码器经微调，在无需切片级标签的情况下预测这些区域目标。可视化分析识别出对可辨认的组织学模式有响应的字典成分，支持对目标的解释。与原生 5 倍特征相比，SRED 在七个分类和分级队列中使平均宏平均 F1 提高 1.1 个点，在五个生存队列中使平均 C-index 提高 1.7 个点。运行时间与原生 5 倍相当，相对 20 倍平均加速 11.58 倍。

title: Beyond scales: Artificial intelligence, language, and behavior in suicide risk modeling-a narrative review.
source: PubMed · European neuropsychopharmacology : the journal of the European College of Neuropsychopharmacology
zh_title: 超越量表：自杀风险建模中的AI、语言与行为（叙述性综述）
summary: 叙述性综述，总结机器学习、深度学习和LLM基于电子病历、自然语言等多模态数据预测自杀想法与行为的进展。

abstract: [European neuropsychopharmacology : the journal of the European College of Neuropsychopharmacology] Suicide is a leading, preventable cause of premature mortality, yet identifying individuals at imminent risk remains difficult. There are no validated biomarkers for routine stratification, and common approaches (clinical interviews, rating scales, self-report) are limited by subjectivity, reporting bias, and weak positive predictive value for rare outcomes. Rapid advances in artificial intelligence (AI)-including machine learning, deep learning, and large language models-offer opportunities to integrate heterogeneous signals relevant to risk and treatment response. This narrative review summarizes recent AI-enabled prediction and characterization of suicidal thoughts and behaviors across major data modalities: structured electronic health records and claims; natural language processing of clinical notes and digital text; speech and facial/behavioral signals; neuroimaging and other neurobiological measures; and passive sensing from smartphones and wearables. We review common modeling and evaluation practices, emphasizing clinically relevant performance assessment (discrimination and calibration) and the importance of temporal and external validation. We also highlight barriers to translation, including class imbalance and label noise, dataset shift across sites and time, limited prospective evaluation, and the need for interpretable outputs that can support medication decisions and care pathways (e.g., triage, monitoring, and stepped interventions). Ethical and implementation challenges-privacy and consent, algorithmic bias and equity, governance, and the clinical consequences of false-positive and false-negative predictions-are discussed with an emphasis on safe deployment. We conclude with priorities for the field, including multimodal longitudinal cohorts, harmonized reporting standards, and pragmatic trials to determine whether AI decision support measurably improves suicide-prevention outcomes.
zh_abstract: [欧洲神经精神药理学：欧洲神经精神药理学学院杂志] 自杀是导致过早死亡的主要且可预防的原因，但识别面临迫在眉睫风险的个体仍然困难。目前尚无可用于常规分层的经验证生物标志物，而常用方法（临床访谈、评定量表、自我报告）受限于主观性、报告偏倚，以及对罕见结局的阳性预测值较弱。人工智能（AI）——包括机器学习、深度学习和大语言模型——的快速进展，为整合与风险和治疗反应相关的异质性信号提供了机会。本叙述性综述总结了近期 AI 在多种主要数据模态中对自杀想法和行为进行预测与刻画的进展：结构化电子健康记录和医保理赔数据；对临床笔记和数字文本的自然语言处理；语音及面部/行为信号；神经影像和其他神经生物学测量；以及来自智能手机和可穿戴设备的被动感知。我们回顾了常见的建模与评估实践，强调与临床相关的性能评估（区分度和校准度）以及时间验证和外部验证的重要性。我们还指出了转化应用中的障碍，包括类别不平衡和标签噪声、跨站点和跨时间的数据集偏移、前瞻性评估有限，以及需要可解释的输出以支持用药决策和照护路径（如分诊、监测和阶梯式干预）。文中还讨论了伦理和实施方面的挑战——隐私与知情同意、算法偏倚与公平性、治理，以及假阳性和假阴性预测的临床后果——并强调安全部署。最后，我们提出了该领域的优先事项，包括多模态纵向队列、统一的报告标准，以及用于确定 AI 决策支持能否切实改善自杀预防结局的实用性试验。

abstract: [Health care science] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly reshaping health systems worldwide, offering unprecedented opportunities but also introducing new risks. Effective governance is therefore essential to ensure that AI in health is safe, trustworthy, and aligned with public interest. This article examines emerging global t`rends in AI governance in health across a diverse set of countries. Three major trends are shaping the global governance landscape. First, national health data resources are increasingly treated as strategic assets, reflecting a shift toward digital sovereignty. Countries are investing in nationally governed health data infrastructures to enable AI development while safeguarding national interests. Second, regulators are coordinating between general AI laws and health-specific regulations, adopting different governance approaches based on the countries' situations. Third, regulatory systems are transitioning from static, pre-market gatekeeping to lifecycle-based oversight. Countries such as the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Singapore, and China are pioneering mechanisms to manage adaptive AI systems. Beyond these, emerging themes-including regulatory sandboxes, evolving definitions of AI safety, and the prioritization of equity and digital inclusion-are reshaping national strategies. The analysis highlights the need for interoperable standards, robust data governance, and capacity-building for regulators and health institutions.

title: Clinician Acceptance of Large Language Model-Generated Discharge Summaries.
zh_title: 临床医生对大模型生成出院小结的接受度
summary: 在伦敦5家医院的回顾性非劣效比较研究中，评估医生对EHR来源的LLM出院小结与常规医生撰写小结的可接受性。

abstract: [JAMA network open] Hospital discharge summaries are essential for continuity of care, but fragmented electronic health record (EHR) data can compromise their quality and safety. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed for clinical documentation tasks despite limited evidence regarding their performance in health care settings compared with the current standard of care. To evaluate clinician acceptability of LLM-generated discharge summaries derived from EHRs compared with routine clinician-written summaries. In this retrospective comparative effectiveness study using a prespecified noninferiority framework, acceptability of LLM-generated discharge summaries was compared with clinician-authored discharge summaries. Admission records from 5 London hospitals for September 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023, were evaluated against the full admission record by practicing physicians. Admissions were eligible only if the clinician-authored discharge summary contained identifiable clinical summary, plan and requested actions, and information given sections. Data analysis was conducted from July 2025 to February 2026. LLM-generated summaries were produced using GPT-4o mini (July 18, 2024 release; OpenAI) and a clinician-codesigned prompt. The primary outcome was clinician signoff with no or minor edits, derived from 2 sequential questions: (1) whether the reviewer would sign the summary and (2) whether no, minor, or major edits were required. A 5-percentage-point noninferiority margin was prespecified.
