zh_abstract: [JAMA network open] 出院小结对于医疗连续性至关重要，但电子健康记录（EHR）数据的碎片化可能损害其质量和安全性。尽管与现行标准诊疗相比，大语言模型（LLM）在医疗场景中表现的证据有限，但其越来越多地被提议用于临床文书任务。目的：评估临床医生对基于EHR由LLM生成的出院小结与常规临床医生撰写的出院小结的可接受性。在这项采用预先设定的非劣效性框架的回顾性比较有效性研究中，比较了LLM生成的出院小结与临床医生撰写的出院小结的可接受性。由执业医生对照完整入院记录，对2022年9月1日至2023年9月30日期间伦敦5家医院的入院记录进行评估。仅当临床医生撰写的出院小结包含可识别的临床总结、计划与要求的行动以及告知信息部分时，该入院记录才符合纳入条件。数据分析于2025年7月至2026年2月进行。LLM生成的小结使用GPT-4o mini（2024年7月18日发布版本；OpenAI）及由临床医生共同设计的提示词生成。主要结局为临床医生签署时无需或仅需少量修改，由两个连续问题得出：（1）审阅者是否会签署该小结；（2）需要无修改、少量修改还是大量修改。预先设定的非劣效界值为5个百分点。次要结局评估准确性、完整性、语气和清晰度（采用5级Likert量表：1，差；2，一般；3，良好；4，很好；5，优秀），以及缺失或错误信息的潜在危害性（采用5级Likert量表：1，无伤害；2，轻微伤害；3，中度伤害；4，高度伤害；5，极高度伤害）。研究样本包含1294份（649份临床医生撰写、645份LLM生成）独特病例出院小结，由12名执业医生对照完整入院记录进行评估。病例患者的年龄中位数为46.0岁（IQR，26.2-69.8岁），733例（56.6%）出生时性别为女性，住院时间中位数为3.0天（IQR，1.0-7.0天）。无需或仅需少量修改即可签署的模型估计概率的绝对差值（LLM生成减去临床医生撰写）为22.2个百分点（95% CI，19.0-27.5个百分点）；其下限超过预先设定的-5个百分点非劣效界值（原文在此处截断）

title: InclusionMed: Benchmarking AI for Inclusive Healthcare
zh_title: InclusionMed：面向包容性医疗的AI基准
summary: 提出开放评测倡议InclusionMed，按三类医疗角色与三种AI能力组织基准，并评测前沿大模型，总指数得分17.5至49.1。
key_points: 从388个候选中筛选4个公开基准
含私有诊断推理基准DxFiles
前沿LLM总分介于17.5–49.1
reason: 新基准框架，预印本，部分基准私有
abstract: Advancing medical AI for inclusive healthcare requires evaluation across diverse healthcare roles, tasks, and care settings, but benchmark coverage remains uneven. We introduce InclusionMed, an open medical AI evaluation initiative for inclusive healthcare. The InclusionMed Atlas organizes benchmarks across three healthcare roles and three AI capabilities. For the first release, we selected four public benchmarks from 388 candidates through structured audits and independent reproduction. With InclusionMed-DxFiles, our private diagnostic reasoning benchmark, the Atlas contains five benchmarks covering three of its nine role--capability cells. We evaluated frontier large language models on the Atlas and aggregated their results into the InclusionMed Index, with overall scores ranging from 17.5 to 49.1 out of 100. The Index also reports scores by healthcare role and AI capability, showing that a model's rank varied with the role or capability considered. A within-benchmark analysis using task-level tags showed that the ten highest-ranked models in the Index all scored higher on patient communication than on clinical decision-making. Models with similar Index scores also differed substantially in estimated inference cost. These findings highlight the need for evaluation covering more diverse healthcare needs and for context-specific model selection. Through open collaboration and community contributions, InclusionMed seeks to ensure that diverse healthcare needs worldwide shape how medical AI progress is defined and measured.
zh_abstract: 推进面向包容性医疗的医学 AI，需要在多样的医疗角色、任务和照护场景中进行评估，但基准的覆盖仍不均衡。我们提出 InclusionMed，这是一项面向包容性医疗的开放医学 AI 评估倡议。InclusionMed Atlas 围绕三种医疗角色和三种 AI 能力来组织各项基准。在首次发布中，我们通过结构化审核和独立复现，从 388 个候选基准中选出四个公开基准。加上我们的私有诊断推理基准 InclusionMed-DxFiles，Atlas 包含五个基准，覆盖其九个角色-能力单元中的三个。我们在 Atlas 上评估了前沿大语言模型，并将结果汇总为 InclusionMed 指数，总体得分范围为 17.5 至 49.1（满分 100）。该指数还按医疗角色和 AI 能力分别报告得分，显示模型的排名随所考虑的角色或能力而变化。使用任务级标签进行的基准内分析表明，指数中排名前十的模型在患者沟通上的得分均高于临床决策。指数得分相近的模型在估计的推理成本上也存在显著差异。这些发现凸显了需要开展覆盖更多样医疗需求的评估，以及针对具体情境进行模型选择。通过开放协作和社区贡献，InclusionMed 力求确保全球多样的医疗需求能够影响医学 AI 进展的定义和衡量方式。

title: Towards wearable-scale, transition-aware sleep staging for clinical populations
zh_title: 面向临床人群的可穿戴级、感知转换的睡眠分期
summary: 提出以 SleepGPT 为教师、超轻量 CNN-GRU 为学生的蒸馏框架，并引入 Gcv-TAD 损失，用于脑卒中、RBD 等临床人群睡眠分期。
key_points: 三个临床队列中觉醒更多、N1 更多、REM 更少
SleepGPT 仅用 25% 患者标签适配
学生模型仅 31k 参数，可实时分期
reason: 睡眠基础模型蒸馏，有新方法，预印本且证据有限
abstract: Automatic sleep staging models are predominantly developed on healthy sleepers and generalize poorly to clinical populations with fragmented sleep. Across three cohorts (patients with stroke, isolated REM sleep behaviour disorder, and other sleep disorders), we observe 2-3x more awakenings per hour, nearly twice as much N1, and less REM sleep than in healthy sleepers. We propose a label-efficient teacher-student framework for wearable-scale sleep staging. SleepGPT (136M parameters), adapted using labels from 25% of training patients, supervises a causal CNN-GRU (31k parameters; 122 KB) that stages EEG, EOG, or both in real time. We introduce Gcv-TAD, a new black-box transition-aware distillation loss. It emphasizes uncommon stage transitions while discounting those that vary across patients, using a prior estimated from labelled patients. In patient-wise 10-fold cross-validation, Gcv-TAD improves per-patient macro F1 over supervised training on the same labels by +3.2 to +7.6 points on average. Gains are largest on N1, and performance approaches full-label training.
zh_abstract: 自动睡眠分期模型主要基于健康睡眠者开发，在睡眠碎片化的临床人群中泛化能力较差。在三个队列（卒中患者、孤立性快速眼动睡眠行为障碍患者和其他睡眠障碍患者）中，我们观察到每小时觉醒次数是健康睡眠者的2-3倍，N1期接近其两倍，而快速眼动（REM）睡眠较少。我们提出一种面向可穿戴设备规模的、标签高效的教师-学生框架。SleepGPT（1.36亿参数）利用25%训练患者的标签进行适配，并监督一个因果CNN-GRU（3.1万参数；122 KB），后者可对EEG、EOG或二者联合进行实时分期。我们提出了Gcv-TAD，一种新的黑盒式、感知转换的蒸馏损失。它利用从有标签患者估计的先验，强调少见的睡眠分期转换，同时降低在患者之间变化较大的转换的权重。在按患者划分的10折交叉验证中，与使用相同标签的监督训练相比，Gcv-TAD使每位患者的宏平均F1平均提高了+3.2至+7.6个百分点。N1期的提升最大，性能接近使用全部标签训练的水平。

title: EEGProbe: Do Vision-Language Models Really Understand EEG? A Benchmark for Signal-Grounded EEG Signals Evaluation
zh_title: EEGProbe：视觉语言模型真的理解脑电吗？
summary: 提出含620道题、13个子任务的信号基础EEG基准，评估通用视觉语言模型对原始通道脑电的提取与推理能力。
key_points: 涵盖分类、跨模态对齐、神经生理推理
经信号必要性检验与专家核验
评估了11个开源与闭源VLM
reason: 新的EEG-VLM基准，专家核验，但规模较小，预印本
abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong multimodal capabilities across scientific and biomedical domains, yet their ability to understand electroencephalography (EEG) signals remains unclear. We introduce EEGProbe, a signal-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether general-purpose VLMs can extract and reason from minimally processed, channel-wise EEG without task-specific feature engineering or EEG-specific adaptation. EEGProbe contains 620 EEG-centered questions across 13 subtasks and three capability categories: EEG Signal Classification, EEG Cross-modal Alignment, and EEG Neurophysiological Reasoning. To reduce shortcut-based answering, EEGProbe preserves the temporal structure of the recordings where possible, minimizes benchmark-induced processing, and applies signal-necessity testing followed by expert verification. We evaluate 11 representative open- and closed-source VLMs under a unified zero-shot protocol. The strongest model, GPT-5.6 Sol, achieves an overall score of only 41.63\%, with cross-modal EEG alignment emerging as a major bottleneck. We further examine model behavior from a neurophysiological perspective and analyze how temporal, spectral, spatial, and physiological EEG structure relates to model successes and failures. Inference-time neurophysiological guidance can reshape model predictions by helping models recognize the neurophysiological patterns present in the input and connect them with relevant neurological knowledge, narrowing the gap between general multimodal competence and EEG understanding. EEGProbe provides a testbed for current VLMs and a basis for developing future multimodal models that can interpret EEG evidence more reliably. The EEGProbe benchmark will be publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/2122ZHU/EEGProbe.

title: Segment Anything for Microscopy 2
zh_title: 显微镜分割基础模型 Segment Anything for Microscopy 2
summary: 将SAM2适配至光镜与电镜的2D/3D联合分割，训练于超2300万细胞与核标注，并支持分类与细胞追踪。
key_points: 训练数据含2300万+细胞与核、160万细胞结构
体数据上优于通用与专用方法
功能含分类与2D/3D细胞追踪
reason: 大规模生物影像基础模型，预印本，有基线对比
abstract: Foundation models have advanced microscopy image segmentation, but existing models are trained on two-dimensional data, struggle with complex structures in volumetric data, and address only a narrow range of analysis tasks. Here we present Segment Anything for Microscopy 2 (SAM2), a foundation model that adapts SAM2 to joint 2D and 3D segmentation in light and electron microscopy. Trained on annotations of more than 23 million cells and nuclei and 1.6 million cellular structures, SAM2 achieves state-of-the-art automatic and interactive segmentation and outperforms generalist and specialist methods on volumetric data. Dedicated models further enable accurate mitochondrion and nucleus segmentation in electron microscopy. Beyond segmentation, SAM2 supports pixel and object classification from few annotations as well as cell tracking in 2D and 3D time-lapse data. All functionality is available in the user-friendly SAM napari plugin. We demonstrated the capabilities of SAM2 on challenging use cases spanning developmental biology, organoid research, cardiac physiology, and histopathology.
zh_abstract: 基础模型推动了显微图像分割的发展，但现有模型是在二维数据上训练的，难以处理体数据中的复杂结构，且只能应对范围较窄的分析任务。在此，我们提出 Segment Anything for Microscopy 2（SAM2），这是一个将 SAM2 适配于光学显微镜和电子显微镜中二维与三维联合分割的基础模型。SAM2 在超过 2300 万个细胞和细胞核以及 160 万个细胞结构的标注上训练，实现了最先进的自动和交互式分割，并在体数据上优于通用型和专用型方法。专用模型还可在电子显微镜中实现准确的线粒体和细胞核分割。除分割之外，SAM2 还支持基于少量标注的像素和对象分类，以及二维和三维延时数据中的细胞追踪。所有功能均可在用户友好的 SAM napari 插件中使用。我们在涵盖发育生物学、类器官研究、心脏生理学和组织病理学的具有挑战性的用例中展示了 SAM2 的能力。

title: Calpha: Toward Native Biomolecular Intelligence in a General-Purpose Language Model
zh_title: Calpha：通用语言模型中的原生生物分子智能
summary: 预印本：让Qwen3.5-9B读取ESM2增强的序列，并调用SimpleFold结构头输出单链蛋白结构，迈出通用LLM融合折叠能力的第一步。
key_points: LLM可文本回答或触发结构头
结构头仅通过Qwen残基状态获取信息
当前仅覆盖单链蛋白结构
reason: 新颖的LLM-蛋白结构融合预印本，证据有限
abstract: Biomolecular foundation models predict the structures of proteins and their complexes accurately, and large language models (LLMs) reason in natural language, but the two remain separate: the abilities of the former are not part of a general-purpose LLM, and the reasoning of the latter does not enter a structure prediction. Calpha aims at one general model that folds proteins and complexes, understands protein sequence and structure, and lets its language reasoning influence the structures it predicts. This report covers the first step, in which an LLM outputs single-chain protein structures. Qwen3.5-9B reads a sequence enriched with ESM2 residue features. It can respond in text or emit a token that invokes a pretrained SimpleFold structure head, which receives information about the protein only through Qwen's residue states. Under a fixed folding request, the head achieves mean TM-scores of 0.808 on the FoldBench-334 development set, 0.635 on CASP16 domains and 0.900 on a CAMEO-style PDB set. We compare these predictions with a baseline in which ESM2-3B encodes the sequence and a fine-tuned SimpleFold-3B head predicts the coordinates. The two systems also differ in trainable weights, training duration and crop length. For chains of 100--299 residues, all three paired confidence intervals include zero. At 300--600 residues, the mean differences are -0.044, -0.160 and -0.025, respectively. In a separate test, four English request types triggered folding on every evaluated example. Protein training reduced accuracy on a 350-item MMLU-Pro subset from 77.4% to 70.3%. An LLM can therefore output single-chain structures from its own states, with lower long-chain scores in the current comparisons and reduced accuracy on the evaluated MMLU-Pro subset. Complex prediction, structure understanding and the effect of language reasoning on the predicted coordinates remain future work.
zh_abstract: 生物分子基础模型能够准确预测蛋白质及其复合物的结构，大语言模型（LLM）能够用自然语言进行推理，但二者仍相互分离：前者的能力不属于通用 LLM，后者的推理也不会进入结构预测。Calpha 旨在构建一个通用模型，既能折叠蛋白质及复合物，又能理解蛋白质序列和结构，并让其语言推理影响所预测的结构。本报告涵盖第一步，即由 LLM 输出单链蛋白质结构。Qwen3.5-9B 读取经 ESM2 残基特征增强的序列。它既可以用文本回应，也可以输出一个标记来调用预训练的 SimpleFold 结构头，该结构头仅通过 Qwen 的残基状态获取蛋白质信息。在固定的折叠请求下，该结构头在 FoldBench-334 开发集上的平均 TM-score 为 0.808，在 CASP16 结构域上为 0.635，在 CAMEO 风格的 PDB 集上为 0.900。我们将这些预测与一个基线进行比较，该基线由 ESM2-3B 编码序列，并由经微调的 SimpleFold-3B 头预测坐标。两个系统在可训练权重、训练时长和裁剪长度上也有所不同。对于 100–299 个残基的链，三个配对置信区间均包含零。在 300–600 个残基时，平均差异分别为 -0.044、-0.160 和 -0.025。在另一项测试中，四种英文请求类型在每个被评估样本上均触发了折叠。蛋白质训练使 350 题 MMLU-Pro 子集上的准确率从 77.4% 降至 70.3%。因此，LLM 可以根据自身状态输出单链结构，但在当前比较中长链得分较低，且在所评估的 MMLU-Pro 子集上准确率下降。复合物预测、结构理解以及语言推理对所预测坐标的影响仍有待未来研究。

title: WHITE-Net: White matter HyperIntensities Tissue Extraction using deep learning network.
zh_title: WHITE-Net：深度学习白质高信号分割
summary: 基于3D ResUNet、用多站点MRI训练的WMH自动分割框架，在BrainLaus、ADNI和WMH Challenge三个独立数据集上评估。
key_points: 3D ResUNet，训练数据涵盖多种扫描仪与协议
三个独立数据集上评估
面向大规模MRI研究中的小血管病标志物
reason: 有多数据集外部评估，但为常规分割方法
abstract: [Imaging neuroscience (Cambridge, Mass.)] White matter hyperintensities (WMH) are a hallmark of cerebral small vessel disease, a highly prevalent condition in aging, making their accurate detection in large-scale magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) studies critically important. Currently available semi-automated and automated segmentation methods are frequently limited by sensitivity to variations in imaging conditions and computational constraints, restricting their applicability across diverse acquisition settings. We present WHITE-Net, a deep learning-based framework for automated WMH segmentation built on a 3D ResUNet architecture and trained on multisite MRI data encompassing substantial variability in scanner vendors, acquisition protocols, spatial resolution, and image characteristics. Evaluated across three independent datasets-BrainLaus, ADNI, and WMH Challenge, WHITE-Net achieves high segmentation accuracy and ranks among the top-performing methods across datasets, enabling a comprehensive assessment of generalizability in varied imaging environments. WHITE-Net maintains stable performance in a wide spectrum of lesion loads and demonstrates a favorable balance between precision and recall, effectively limiting false positive detections-a common limitation of existing approaches. Beyond accuracy, WHITE-Net requires no parameter tuning and offers fast inference times, making it well suited for deployment in large-scale neuroimaging studies. The obtained results highlight the value of training on diverse multisite data for improving generalizability and position WHITE-Net as a reliable, scalable tool for automated WMH segmentation in computational anatomy research.
zh_abstract: [影像神经科学（Imaging neuroscience，Cambridge, Mass.）] 白质高信号（WMH）是脑小血管病的标志，而脑小血管病在老年人群中高度流行，因此在大规模磁共振成像（MRI）研究中准确检测 WMH 至关重要。目前可用的半自动和自动分割方法常常受限于对成像条件变化的敏感性和计算条件的限制，从而限制了其在不同采集环境中的适用性。我们提出 WHITE-Net，一种基于深度学习的 WMH 自动分割框架，建立在 3D ResUNet 架构之上，并在多中心 MRI 数据上训练，这些数据在扫描仪厂商、采集协议、空间分辨率和图像特征方面存在很大差异。在三个独立数据集——BrainLaus、ADNI 和 WMH Challenge 上评估时，WHITE-Net 取得了较高的分割准确性，并在各数据集中跻身表现最佳的方法之列，从而可对其在不同成像环境中的泛化能力进行全面评估。WHITE-Net 在广泛的病灶负荷范围内保持稳定的性能，并在精确率与召回率之间表现出良好的平衡，有效限制了假阳性检出——这是现有方法的常见局限。除准确性外，WHITE-Net 无需参数调整，推理速度快，非常适合部署于大规模神经影像研究。所得结果凸显了在多样化多中心数据上训练对提高泛化能力的价值，并使 WHITE-Net 成为计算解剖学研究中可靠且可扩展的 WMH 自动分割工具。

title: A deep learning-based linear system for liver station in EUS (with video).
zh_title: 基于深度学习的肝脏EUS站点线性识别系统
summary: 基于9403张EUS肝脏图像训练8站点分类模型，并开展内部验证、人机竞赛及视频交叉研究评估辅助效果。
key_points: 训练集9403张，内部验证2780张图像
含26段视频与340张图像人机竞赛
交叉研究评估降低判读难度
reason: 含人机对照但仅内部验证，值得一看档
abstract: [Endoscopic ultrasound] With the widespread adoption of endoscopic techniques, the integration of EUS into hepatology has become an inevitable trend. This study aimed to develop a system that can conduct a comprehensive inspection of liver segments through scanning imaging at 8 stations. A standardized EUS examination protocol for the liver comprises 8 stations. We developed a deep learning-based station classification model using a dataset of 9403 EUS liver images. Internal validation was performed on 2780 EUS images and 26 EUS video clips. To further evaluate the model's clinical utility, a human-machine competition involving 340 liver images was conducted. The same set of 26 video clips in internal video validation was also employed for a crossover study to evaluate the system's effectiveness in reducing the difficulty of interpreting liver EUS images. For station classification, the model achieved an accuracy of 92.52% on image validation and a per-frame accuracy of 85.98% on video validation. In the human-machine comparison, the overall classification accuracy reached 88.53%, which was comparable to the average accuracy of the EUS experts (84.56%, P = 0.064). In the crossover study, trainees' station recognition accuracy improved significantly, with an increase of 16.36% (95% confidence interval, 11.43%-21.29%; P < 0.05). The system demonstrates high accuracy in liver station localization and achieves a classification performance comparable to EUS experts. It shows promise for facilitating standardized hepatic EUS examinations and may contribute to shortening the learning curve for trainees in the future.
zh_abstract: [内镜超声（Endoscopic ultrasound）] 随着内镜技术的广泛应用，将EUS整合入肝病学已成为必然趋势。本研究旨在开发一套能够通过8个站点的扫描成像对肝段进行全面检查的系统。肝脏标准化EUS检查方案包括8个站点。我们利用9403幅EUS肝脏图像的数据集开发了基于深度学习的站点分类模型。在2780幅EUS图像和26段EUS视频片段上进行了内部验证。为进一步评估模型的临床实用性，开展了涉及340幅肝脏图像的人机比赛。内部视频验证中使用的同一组26段视频片段还被用于交叉研究，以评估该系统在降低肝脏EUS图像判读难度方面的有效性。在站点分类方面，模型在图像验证中的准确率为92.52%，在视频验证中的逐帧准确率为85.98%。在人机比较中，总体分类准确率达88.53%，与EUS专家的平均准确率（84.56%，P = 0.064）相当。在交叉研究中，受训者的站点识别准确率显著提高，提高了16.36%（95%置信区间，11.43%–21.29%；P < 0.05）。该系统在肝脏站点定位方面具有较高准确性，分类性能与EUS专家相当。它有望促进肝脏EUS检查的标准化，并可能在未来有助于缩短受训者的学习曲线。

title: Generative Artificial Intelligence-Based Dietary Advice: A Scoping Review of Nutritional Accuracy, Safety, and Eating-Related Risks.
zh_title: 生成式AI饮食建议的范围综述：准确性、安全与进食相关风险
summary: 范围综述汇总生成式AI/大模型在饮食建议、体重管理及进食障碍相关指导中的营养准确性与安全性证据。
key_points: 遵循Arksey与O'Malley框架及PRISMA-ScR
检索五个数据库，纳入评估LLM饮食建议的原始研究
关注营养准确性、体重管理、进食相关危害与专业保障
reason: 范围综述，泛综述上限内，信息有限属增量档
abstract: [Clinical nutrition ESPEN] This scoping review aimed to synthesize current evidence on generative artificial intelligence (AI)-based dietary advice, with particular attention to nutritional accuracy, safety, weight-management guidance, eating-related harm, and professional safeguards. A scoping review was conducted following the Arksey and O'Malley framework, refined by Levac et al., and reported according to the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses Extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR). PubMed, Scopus, CINAHL, Web of Science, and Embase were searched up to 30 June 2026. Original empirical studies evaluating generative AI or large language models for dietary advice, meal planning, nutritional information, weight management, or eating-disorder-related guidance were eligible. Study selection, data charting, and synthesis were performed independently by two reviewers, with disagreements resolved by consensus or third-reviewer assessment. Nine studies published between 2023 and 2026 were included. In this small and emerging evidence base, one study reported 84.38% accuracy on an objective nutrition-literacy assessment, and another found overall Diet Quality Index-International scores above 70 for chatbot-generated weight-loss plans. However, important limitations were identified in caloric accuracy, portion sizing, macronutrient and micronutrient balance, reproducibility, personalization, and management of food allergies and multimorbidity. Potential safety concerns were identified in adolescent and eating-disorder scenarios, where chatbot responses sometimes combined appropriate healthy-eating advice with restrictive or weight-focused recommendations; these studies did not establish resulting clinical or behavioral harm. Although some systems encouraged consultation with healthcare professionals, safety warnings and referral to regulated resources were inconsistent. Evidence from the nine included studies remains preliminary, heterogeneous, and largely simulation-based. Generative AI may have a supplementary role in nutrition education and preliminary dietary guidance, but the available evidence is insufficient to support autonomous use in place of dietitians. Current findings indicate potential safety risks in high-risk or clinically complex scenarios rather than demonstrated long-term harm. Longitudinal and real-world studies are needed to establish the clinical and behavioral effects of AI-generated dietary advice.
zh_abstract: [Clinical nutrition ESPEN] 本范围综述旨在综合当前关于基于生成式人工智能（AI）的膳食建议的证据，特别关注营养准确性、安全性、体重管理指导、进食相关危害以及专业保障措施。本范围综述遵循Arksey和O'Malley框架（经Levac等人完善）开展，并按照《系统评价与荟萃分析优先报告条目——范围综述扩展版》（PRISMA-ScR）进行报告。检索了PubMed、Scopus、CINAHL、Web of Science和Embase，检索截至2026年6月30日。纳入评估生成式AI或大语言模型用于膳食建议、膳食计划、营养信息、体重管理或进食障碍相关指导的原始实证研究。研究选择、数据提取和综合由两名评审员独立完成，分歧通过共识或第三名评审员评估解决。共纳入2023年至2026年间发表的9项研究。在这一规模较小且尚处于起步阶段的证据基础中，一项研究报告其在客观营养素养评估中的准确率为84.38%，另一项研究发现聊天机器人生成的减重计划的国际膳食质量指数（Diet Quality Index-International）总分高于70。然而，在热量准确性、份量估计、宏量和微量营养素平衡、可重复性、个性化以及食物过敏和多重疾病共存的处理方面发现了重要局限。在青少年和进食障碍情景中发现了潜在的安全隐患，聊天机器人的回应有时将恰当的健康饮食建议与限制性或以体重为导向的建议混合在一起；这些研究并未证实由此造成的临床或行为危害。尽管一些系统鼓励咨询医疗专业人员，但安全警示和向受监管资源转介的做法并不一致。这9项纳入研究的证据仍属初步、异质性较大，且主要基于模拟。生成式AI可能在营养教育和初步膳食指导中发挥辅助作用，但现有证据不足以支持其自主使用以取代营养师。目前的发现提示，在高风险或临床复杂的情景中存在潜在安全风险，而非已证实的长期危害。需要开展纵向和真实世界研究，以确定AI生成的膳食建议的临床和行为影响。

title: Commercially available multimodal LLMs for EEG-based prognostication after cardiac arrest.
zh_title: 商用多模态LLM基于脑电图像预测心脏骤停后预后
summary: 用两款商用多模态LLM直接读取33例心脏骤停昏迷患者的EEG图像，估计良好神经功能结局概率，并比较五种提示策略。
key_points: 前瞻性队列共33例患者
单段10秒双极导联EEG转PNG
测试ChatGPT 5.4与Claude Opus 4.7
reason: 样本仅33例、无外部验证，增量档；多模态LLM略加分
abstract: [Resuscitation] Machine-learning and deep-learning approaches have been successfully applied to EEG-based prognostication in comatose patients after cardiac arrest (CA), but typically rely on task-specific signal processing, feature extraction, and model development. Here, we investigated whether two commercially available multimodal large language models (LLMs) could predict neurological outcome directly from EEG images. Thirty-three comatose patients on the first day after CA from a prospective cohort were included. For each patient, a single 10-second EEG segment displayed using a longitudinal bipolar montage was rendered as PNG image. ChatGPT 5.4. and Claude Opus 4.7 were instructed to estimate the probability for favorable outcome for each case based on the EEG and a generic information block describing conditions of recordings. Five different prompting strategies were used, including few-shot prompting where four exemplary EEGs (not from the 33 patients) were provided. Predictive performance was quantified using AUC and accuracy. Across prompting strategies, the AUC ranged from 0.86 to 0.99 for ChatGPT and from 0.74 to 1.00 for Claude. The highest accuracy achieved by both models was 93.9% using few-shot prompting. As reference, a previously published dedicated deep-learning model achieved 100% on the same cohort. In this exploratory study of a small cohort, multimodal LLMs showed variable but potentially promising discrimination for predicting favorable outcome from single EEG image in comatose patients after CA. Performance depended substantially on prompt design. These findings require confirmation in a larger cohort.
zh_abstract: 【复苏】机器学习和深度学习方法已成功应用于心脏骤停（CA）后昏迷患者基于脑电图（EEG）的预后判断，但通常依赖于针对特定任务的信号处理、特征提取和模型开发。在此，我们研究了两种商用多模态大语言模型（LLM）能否直接根据 EEG 图像预测神经功能结局。纳入一项前瞻性队列中CA后第一天的33例昏迷患者。对每例患者，将以纵向双极导联显示的单个10秒 EEG 片段渲染为 PNG 图像。指示 ChatGPT 5.4 和 Claude Opus 4.7 基于该 EEG 及描述记录条件的通用信息块，估计每例预后良好的概率。使用了五种不同的提示策略，其中包括提供四个示例 EEG（不来自这33例患者）的少样本提示。预测性能以 AUC 和准确率量化。在各提示策略下，ChatGPT 的 AUC 为0.86至0.99，Claude 为0.74至1.00。两种模型所达到的最高准确率均为93.9%，均采用少样本提示。作为参照，先前发表的专用深度学习模型在同一队列上达到100%。在这项小队列探索性研究中，多模态 LLM 在根据单张 EEG 图像预测CA后昏迷患者的良好结局方面，显示出有差异但可能有前景的区分能力。性能在很大程度上取决于提示设计。这些发现需要在更大队列中加以验证。

title: Uncovering the Invisible in Routine Radiology: Cross-Modal Detection of MRI-Verified Soft-Tissue Pathologies from CBCT via Physics-Guided 3D Self-Supervised Learning
zh_title: 物理引导3D自监督从CBCT检测MRI验证的软组织病变
summary: 以颞下颌关节为模型，用物理引导的3D掩码自编码器在CBCT上机会性检测MRI确认的软组织病变，在配对数据稀缺下进行。
key_points: 配对CBCT-MRI关节共212个
在6550个无标注CBCT体积上预训练冻结3D MAE
应对高容量3D网络过拟合的两阶段框架
reason: 有新意的自监督方法预印本，样本小、证据有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Routine X-ray modalities like cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) are optimized for high-contrast mineralized tissues, leaving soft-tissue abnormalities buried beneath photon noise and below human visual perception. Thus, detecting non-calcified pathologies requires secondary magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). We demonstrate that sub-visual radiographic signatures of soft-tissue pathology are physically preserved within routine CBCT scans and can be extracted for opportunistic screening using a targeted, physics-guided deep learning pipeline, even under extreme paired-data scarcity. Using the temporomandibular joint (TMJ) as a model system (N = 212 paired CBCT-MRI joints), we address the severe overfitting of high-capacity 3D networks through a two-stage framework. First, we employ a frozen full-grid 3D masked autoencoder (BertsWin) pre-trained on 6,550 unlabeled CBCT volumes via the GradientConductor (GCond) optimizer and an anatomy-aware objective (PhysLoss) redirecting gradient flow into the [-300, 300] HU soft-tissue window. Second, automated localization of the condylar zenith drives a deterministic 3D cropping that eliminates 81% of background osseous variance. Evaluated via a patient-isolated 3x10-fold stratified cross-validation protocol, a statistically robust sub-visual signal for MRI-verified synovial effusion (ROC AUC = 0.793) emerges exclusively from representations pre-trained with the PhysLoss and GCond regime. Crucially, only this setup captures true 3D anatomical chirality (p < 0.001) and high intra-patient structural consistency (0.791) over inter-patient noise; conversely, identical architectures pre-trained with standard L2 loss or unmasked variance decomposition (MVC) collapse to random guessing. These findings establish a generalizable paradigm for repurposing routine, low-contrast radiographic scans into opportunistic screening tools for occult soft-tissue disease.
zh_abstract: 锥形束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）等常规X线成像方式针对高对比度的矿化组织进行了优化，使软组织异常被淹没在光子噪声之下，低于人眼视觉感知阈值。因此，检测非钙化病变需要再行磁共振成像（MRI）。我们证明，软组织病变的亚视觉影像学特征在常规CBCT扫描中得以物理性保留，并且即便在配对数据极度稀缺的情况下，也可通过有针对性的、物理引导的深度学习流程提取出来，用于机会性筛查。我们以颞下颌关节（TMJ）为模型系统（N = 212个CBCT-MRI配对关节），通过两阶段框架解决高容量3D网络的严重过拟合问题。第一阶段，我们采用冻结的全网格3D掩码自编码器（BertsWin），在6,550个无标注CBCT容积上，通过GradientConductor（GCond）优化器和解剖感知目标函数（PhysLoss）进行预训练，PhysLoss将梯度流重定向至[-300, 300] HU的软组织窗。第二阶段，髁突顶点的自动定位驱动确定性的3D裁剪，消除了81%的背景骨性变异。通过患者隔离的3×10折分层交叉验证方案评估，对于MRI证实的滑膜积液，仅在采用PhysLoss和GCond方案预训练的表征中出现了统计学上稳健的亚视觉信号（ROC AUC = 0.793）。关键的是，只有这种设置能够捕捉真实的3D解剖手性（p < 0.001），并在患者间噪声之上保持较高的患者内结构一致性（0.791）；相反，采用标准L2损失或无掩码方差分解（MVC）预训练的相同架构则退化为随机猜测。这些发现确立了一种可推广的范式，可将常规低对比度影像扫描重新用作隐匿性软组织疾病的机会性筛查工具。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Correction for Generalist Medical Image Segmentation
zh_title: GRACE：面向通用医学图像分割的检索增强修正
summary: 提出检索增强的掩码修正器GRACE，借助已验证病例知识库，一次训练即可修正多器官、血管与肿瘤分割结果。
key_points: 从已验证病例知识库检索上下文来编辑输入掩码
在多器官语料上训练一次，覆盖器官、血管、肿瘤
留出数据集迁移与留一解剖结构实验，支持免参数扩展索引
reason: 新方法预印本，有迁移评估，证据有限
abstract: Automated segmentation is routinely used as the first step in quantitative image-based clinical workflows, where predicted masks are subsequently reviewed and corrected by human operators. Automated correction of the residual structural errors is currently addressed one anatomy at a time, so the number of trained correctors scales with the number of segmentation targets. We present GRACE, a retrieval-augmented refiner that edits an input mask under context drawn from a shared knowledge base of verified prior cases. The refiner is trained once on a multi-organ corpus spanning compact organs, cavities, branching vessels, and tumour lesions. In the held-out dataset-transfer evaluation, three held-out datasets query a fixed knowledge base built from training data only. A separate leave-one-anatomy-out experiment tests parameter-free index extension: verified cases of an unseen solid organ enter the knowledge base, and the refiner stays frozen. A light shape-aware projection head on a frozen multimodal encoder maps embedding similarity to the shape agreement of the masks, so the knowledge base returns cases that the refiner can use as a shape prior. We evaluate GRACE on 18 public datasets spanning CT, MRI and ultrasound, using nine refinement configurations and seven upstream segmentors that span weak, mid, and strong operating regimes. We report each change with the DSC of its input mask. On the weak tier, the input DSC is 0.386 and GRACE adds up to +0.35 DSC. On a strong segmentor, the input DSC is 0.932 and the mean change is small. Transfer to an imaging modality that is absent from training and from the index is partial and depends on the anatomy, and remains an open research direction. Our results suggest retrieval-conditioned refinement is a practical alternative to anatomy-specific correction models. Code: https://github.com/robustml-eurecom/grace
zh_abstract: 自动分割通常作为基于图像的定量临床工作流程的第一步，其预测的掩膜随后由人工操作者审核并修正。目前，对残余结构性错误的自动校正是按单一解剖结构逐一处理的，因此需要训练的校正器数量会随分割目标数量而增加。我们提出 GRACE，一种检索增强的精修器，它在来自已验证既往病例共享知识库的上下文条件下对输入掩膜进行编辑。该精修器仅在涵盖紧凑器官、腔隙、分支血管和肿瘤病灶的多器官语料上训练一次。在留出数据集迁移评估中，三个留出数据集查询仅由训练数据构建的固定知识库。另一项留一解剖结构（leave-one-anatomy-out）实验测试无需参数的索引扩展：未见过的实质性器官的已验证病例被加入知识库，而精修器保持冻结。在冻结的多模态编码器之上加一个轻量的形状感知投影头，将嵌入相似度映射到掩膜的形状一致性，使知识库返回精修器可用作形状先验的病例。我们在涵盖 CT、MRI 和超声的 18 个公共数据集上评估 GRACE，使用九种精修配置和七个上游分割器，这些分割器涵盖弱、中、强三种工作状态。我们报告每次改变量及其输入掩膜的 DSC。在弱档中，输入 DSC 为 0.386，GRACE 最多可提升 +0.35 DSC。对于强分割器，输入 DSC 为 0.932，平均改变量较小。向训练和索引中均不存在的成像模态迁移仅为部分有效，且取决于解剖结构，仍是有待研究的方向。我们的结果提示，检索条件化的精修是替代解剖结构特异性校正模型的一种实用方案。代码：https://github.com/robustml-eurecom/grace

title: EviSlide-MIL: Multi-Query Pooling and Shared Prediction for Class-Incremental Whole-Slide Image Classification
zh_title: EviSlide-MIL：类增量全切片图像分类
summary: 针对新肿瘤亚型不断加入的场景，提出多查询池化与共享预测模块的类增量WSI分类框架，以缓解遗忘。
key_points: 每类多个可学习查询聚合特征
共享预测模块缓解灾难性遗忘
面向弱监督MIL病理分类
reason: 病理持续学习新方法，预印本，摘要未见具体结果
abstract: Histopathological analysis of whole-slide images (WSIs) plays a critical role in cancer diagnosis, and multiple instance learning (MIL) is widely adopted for WSI analysis under weak supervision. As new tumor subtypes are introduced, extending existing MIL models requires learning new classes while retaining knowledge of previously learned ones. This presents a class-incremental learning challenge, where models must acquire new classes with limited access to historical training data and recognize all learned classes without task identifiers at inference. A major obstacle is forgetting, as updates to feature aggregation and prediction modules can degrade performance on previously learned classes. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{EviSlide-MIL}, a class-incremental WSI framework that integrates multiple learnable queries per class with a shared prediction module. The queries aggregate frozen patch features into class-specific representations, while the shared prediction module limits parameter growth across incremental stages. By freezing queries associated with previously learned classes, EviSlide-MIL preserves their attention patterns for identical inputs, while experience replay and knowledge distillation further mitigate forgetting as shared parameters are updated. Experiments on eight tumor subtypes from The Cancer Genome Atlas demonstrate that EviSlide-MIL achieves improved performance and reduced forgetting compared with competing methods across most learning settings, demonstrating its potential for scalable and knowledge-preserving WSI classification. Code and pretrained models will be released.
zh_abstract: 全切片图像（whole-slide images，WSI）的组织病理学分析在癌症诊断中起着关键作用，多示例学习（multiple instance learning，MIL）被广泛用于弱监督下的 WSI 分析。随着新肿瘤亚型的出现，扩展现有 MIL 模型需要在学习新类别的同时保留对既往已学类别的知识。这构成了一个类别增量学习挑战：模型必须在对历史训练数据的访问受限的情况下学习新类别，并在推理时无需任务标识符即可识别所有已学类别。一个主要障碍是遗忘，因为特征聚合和预测模块的更新会降低对既往已学类别的性能。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 \textbf{EviSlide-MIL}，一种类别增量 WSI 框架，它将每个类别的多个可学习查询与一个共享预测模块相结合。这些查询将冻结的图块特征聚合为类别特异性表示，而共享预测模块则限制了各增量阶段的参数增长。通过冻结与既往已学类别相关的查询，EviSlide-MIL 对相同输入保留其注意力模式，同时在共享参数更新时，经验回放和知识蒸馏进一步缓解遗忘。在来自癌症基因组图谱（The Cancer Genome Atlas）的八种肿瘤亚型上的实验表明，在大多数学习设置下，EviSlide-MIL 与对比方法相比性能提高、遗忘减少，显示出其在可扩展且保留知识的 WSI 分类方面的潜力。代码和预训练模型将会发布。

title: CAST: Calibrating Correspondences for Training-Free Biomedical In-Context Segmentation
zh_title: CAST：免训练的生物医学上下文分割对应校准
summary: 基于冻结的DINOv3骨干，通过稳定性与一致性检验校准细粒度对应，实现免训练的生物医学上下文分割。
key_points: 面向新结构、新模态的少样本示例上下文分割
用稳定性测试提升全局与局部特征可靠性
用一致性测试检验候选对应的局部结构支持
reason: 有新意的免训练方法预印本，摘要未见充分证据，属值得一看档
abstract: Biomedical image segmentation must keep up with new anatomical structures, subjects, imaging modalities, and acquisition protocols, yet dense expert annotations are scarce and models trained on one cohort often struggle to transfer. In-context segmentation (ICS) offers a way out: a new structure is specified by a few annotated exemplars at inference time. However, reliable correspondence remains challenging in biomedical images, where adjacent structures often share similar appearances, and variations across subjects and imaging conditions further obscure their distinctions. We introduce CAST, a training-free framework built on a frozen DINOv3 backbone to calibrate fine-grained correspondences. Its stability test improves feature reliability at both global and patch-specific levels, while its coherence test assesses whether candidate correspondences are supported by consistent local structural context. Together, these tests enable more reliable correspondence across diverse anatomical structures and imaging conditions. Across eight biomedical benchmarks spanning 2D and 3D segmentation, cross-subject, and cross-modality transfer, CAST outperforms the strongest overall baseline by 12.34 percentage points in Dice and ranks first across all six volumetric settings. The versatility of CAST further opens up opportunities for challenging biomedical applications, including 2D-to-3D segmentation and atlas label transfer.
zh_abstract: 生物医学图像分割必须跟上新的解剖结构、受试者、成像模态和采集协议的变化，但密集的专家标注十分稀缺，且在一个队列上训练的模型往往难以迁移。上下文分割（in-context segmentation，ICS）提供了一条出路：在推理时通过少量带标注的示例来指定新的结构。然而，在生物医学图像中建立可靠的对应关系仍具挑战，因为相邻结构的外观往往相似，且不同受试者和成像条件间的差异进一步模糊了它们的区别。我们提出 CAST，一个基于冻结 DINOv3 骨干网络、无需训练的框架，用于校准细粒度对应关系。其稳定性检验在全局和图像块（patch）特定层面提高特征可靠性，而其一致性检验则评估候选对应关系是否得到一致的局部结构上下文的支持。二者结合，使得在不同解剖结构和成像条件下能建立更可靠的对应关系。在涵盖 2D 和 3D 分割、跨受试者和跨模态迁移的八个生物医学基准上，CAST 的 Dice 比总体最强基线高出 12.34 个百分点，并在全部六种体数据设置中排名第一。CAST 的通用性还为具有挑战性的生物医学应用开辟了可能，包括 2D 到 3D 分割和图谱标签迁移。

title: Artificial intelligence support for the prediction and management of drug-drug interactions.
source: PubMed · Expert opinion on drug metabolism & toxicology
zh_title: AI用于药物相互作用的预测与管理
summary: 叙述性综述，梳理机器学习、NLP与大模型在药物相互作用预测、文献提取及情境化临床决策支持中的应用。
key_points: ML基于分子结构与知识图谱预测DDI
NLP/LLM从文献、说明书、药物警戒数据提取
AI使临床决策支持更具情境感知
reason: 叙述性综述，上限6，信息较泛
abstract: [Expert opinion on drug metabolism & toxicology] Drug-drug interactions (DDIs) are a preventable cause of adverse drug events (ADEs), yet conventional interaction-checking tools are hampered by incomplete knowledge, poor concordance, and clinically unusable alert burdens. Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly utilized to strengthen multiple stages of the DDI pathway. This narrative review synthesizes literature identified through searches conducted between 15 July and 20 October 2026. It examines how machine learning (ML) predicts novel drug interactions from molecular structure and knowledge graphs; how natural language processing (NLP) and large language models (LLMs) identify and extract interactions from the literature, drug labels, and pharmacovigilance data; and how AI can make clinical decision support context-aware and support medication review. It also integrates mechanistic physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) modeling and individualized patient-level risk prediction. Prediction models achieve impressive benchmark accuracy but frequently underperform in realistic, cold-start settings; LLMs detect interactions with high sensitivity but show poor severity calibration and persistent hallucination. The near-term value of AI lies less in autonomous prediction than in curating knowledge, personalizing alerts, and augmenting clinician judgment. Rigorous external validation, interpretability, and regulatory clarity are prerequisites for clinical adoption.
zh_abstract: [Expert opinion on drug metabolism & toxicology] 药物-药物相互作用（DDI）是药物不良事件（ADE）的一个可预防原因，但传统的相互作用检查工具受限于知识不完整、一致性差以及临床上难以接受的警报负担。人工智能（AI）正越来越多地用于加强 DDI 路径的多个环节。本叙述性综述综合了在 2026 年 7 月 15 日至 10 月 20 日期间检索到的文献。它探讨了机器学习（ML）如何根据分子结构和知识图谱预测新的药物相互作用；自然语言处理（NLP）和大语言模型（LLM）如何从文献、药品说明书和药物警戒数据中识别并提取相互作用；以及 AI 如何使临床决策支持具备情境感知能力并支持用药审查。它还整合了机制性的生理药代动力学（PBPK）建模和个体化的患者层面风险预测。预测模型在基准测试中取得了令人印象深刻的准确性，但在现实的冷启动场景中往往表现不佳；LLM 检测相互作用的敏感性高，但严重程度校准较差，并持续存在幻觉。AI 的近期价值与其说在于自主预测，不如说在于整理知识、个性化警报以及增强临床医生的判断。严格的外部验证、可解释性和监管明确性是临床应用的前提条件。

title: Comprehensive or Wasteful? Clinical AI and the Up-front Workup
zh_title: 全面还是浪费？临床AI与初诊检查
summary: NEJM AI 述评讨论 Aran 等研究：大模型比实际接诊医生推荐更多检查、转诊和治疗，成本超三倍，但是否过度尚不明确。
key_points: LLM 推荐的前期检查、转诊与治疗更多
成本为医生的三倍以上（短期）
多做不等于做得差，长期影响未知
reason: 述评类文章，上限6分；观点性质，信息增量有限
abstract: AbstractClinical AI is being adopted faster than it is being evaluated, on the promise that it will improve health and reduce waste. Aran and colleagues show that large language models recommend more up-front testing, referrals, and treatment than the physicians who actually saw the patients and at more than three times cost, at least in the short-term. But practicing differently is not the same as practicing worse: whether this reflects wasteful excess or appropriate thoroughness is unknown, as are the consequences for long-run health and spending. On one hand, more up-front care could reduce diagnostic errors, catch disease earlier, deliver guideline-concordant treatment that clinicians overlook, and avert costly late-stage care. On the other hand, it could surface incidental findings that spark anxiety and follow-up cascades, add treatments of marginal benefit, and raise spending through added visits and more intensive billing and diagnosis coding. Neither vignettes nor single-visit studies can settle this. Clinical AI deserves the standard we would demand of any new therapy: trials that randomize practices to these tools and measure long-run effects on patients' health and spending.
zh_abstract: 摘要：临床人工智能（AI）的应用速度快于其评估速度，其依据是它有望改善健康并减少浪费。Aran 及其同事表明，大语言模型推荐的前期检查、转诊和治疗多于实际接诊患者的医生，且成本超过三倍，至少在短期内如此。但做法不同并不等于做法更差：这究竟反映的是浪费性的过度医疗还是恰当的周全，尚不清楚，其对长期健康和支出的影响同样未知。一方面，更多的前期医疗可能减少诊断错误、更早发现疾病、提供临床医生所忽视的符合指南的治疗，并避免代价高昂的晚期治疗。另一方面，它可能带来引发焦虑和后续连锁检查的偶然发现、增加获益甚微的治疗，并通过增加就诊次数以及更高强度的计费和诊断编码而推高支出。病例情景研究和单次就诊研究都无法解决这一问题。临床 AI 应当接受我们对任何新疗法所要求的标准：将诊疗机构随机分配使用这些工具，并衡量其对患者健康和支出的长期影响的试验。

title: Flexible Multi-Stack Super-Resolution of Clinical Brain MRI Using Hetero-Orientation Variational Encoding: Expert Reader Evaluation in a Nigerian Cohort
zh_title: MS-HVED：临床脑MRI灵活多栈超分辨率及尼日利亚队列专家评估
summary: 提出序列无关的多栈脑MRI超分辨框架MS-HVED，融合轴、冠、矢状位栈，并在尼日利亚队列中进行专家读片评估（预印本）。
key_points: 各方向栈独立编码为高斯后验
视野感知的高斯乘积融合
物理启发域随机化模拟异质采集
reason: 新方法含专家读者评估，资源受限场景，证据有限的预印本
abstract: High-resolution brain MRI is important for neuroradiological assessment, yet routine clinical protocols often rely on fast, anisotropic 2D acquisitions, particularly in resource-constrained settings. These acquisitions may differ in orientation, alignment and anatomical coverage, resulting in partially overlapping image stacks. Existing learning-based super-resolution methods typically rely on single, under-constrained inputs or fixed multi-stack configurations with idealised acquisition geometry. We introduce MS-HVED, a sequence-agnostic framework for flexible multi-stack brain MRI super-resolution. Available axial, coronal and sagittal stacks are independently encoded into multi-scale Gaussian posteriors and fused using a field-of-view-aware Product-of-Gaussians formulation that limits contributions from unsupported regions. Physics-informed domain randomisation simulates heterogeneous clinical acquisition conditions, including obliqueness, partial coverage and imaging artefacts. MS-HVED achieved competitive or superior reconstruction fidelity across synthetic benchmarks and improved downstream tissue segmentation relative to low-resolution inputs. To assess generalisation beyond the training cohorts, we performed external clinical validation on 30 routine brain MRI examinations from a Nigerian cohort, representing an under-represented population in medical imaging research. These examinations formed the largest component of a blinded reader study involving 44 real cases and seven expert neuroradiologists. In the Nigerian cohort, MS-HVED was preferred over the supervised baseline for overall image quality in 187 of 210 paired assessments. Across all clinical cohorts, MS-HVED achieved higher overall-quality scores with all available inputs (5.93 vs. 4.49, p<.001), with the preference persisting when axial or coronal inputs were omitted (p<.001). Code at github.com/cai4cai/ms-hved
zh_abstract: 高分辨率脑部MRI对神经放射学评估十分重要，但常规临床方案往往依赖快速的各向异性二维采集，在资源受限的环境中尤其如此。这些采集在方向、对齐和解剖覆盖范围上可能存在差异，从而产生部分重叠的图像堆栈。现有基于学习的超分辨率方法通常依赖单一的欠约束输入，或具有理想化采集几何结构的固定多堆栈配置。我们提出了MS-HVED，一种与序列无关、用于灵活多堆栈脑部MRI超分辨率的框架。可用的轴位、冠状位和矢状位堆栈被分别编码为多尺度高斯后验，并通过感知视野（field-of-view）的高斯乘积（Product-of-Gaussians）公式进行融合，以限制来自无支持区域的贡献。基于物理信息的域随机化模拟了异质的临床采集条件，包括倾斜、部分覆盖和成像伪影。MS-HVED在合成基准测试中取得了具有竞争力或更优的重建保真度，并相较于低分辨率输入改善了下游组织分割。为评估在训练队列之外的泛化能力，我们对来自尼日利亚队列的30例常规脑部MRI检查进行了外部临床验证，该队列代表了医学影像研究中代表性不足的人群。这些检查构成了一项盲法读片者研究中最大的部分，该研究涉及44例真实病例和7名神经放射学专家。在尼日利亚队列中，在210次配对评估中，有187次在整体图像质量上MS-HVED优于有监督基线。在所有临床队列中，使用全部可用输入时MS-HVED获得更高的整体质量评分（5.93 对 4.49，p<.001），当省略轴位或冠状位输入时这种偏好依然存在（p<.001）。代码见 github.com/cai4cai/ms-hved

title: A Crowd-Audited Atlas of Implicit Bias in LLM-Powered Agents
zh_title: LLM智能体隐性偏见的众包审计图谱
summary: 基于美国时间使用调查的17个日常领域，生成506个LLM在不同人设下表现出显著隐性偏见的决策场景，并经500人众包审计。
key_points: 赋予种族、性别、政治意识形态人设
生成506个存在显著隐性偏见的场景
500名参与者完成8,010次二元选择审计
reason: 人设智能体偏见审计，方法有新意但预印本
abstract: Prior work has shown that large language models (LLMs) express implicit biases in high-publicity, one-off decision scenarios such as hiring and intelligence assessment. However, as people increasingly employ autonomous, LLM-powered AI agents that make decisions on their behalf in doing day-to-day tasks, it is of critical importance that we understand how implicit biases, based on sociodemographic assumptions, emerge across a broad milieu of workaday decision scenarios. We used the 17 domains of daily activity in the American Time Use Survey (ATUS) to generate an atlas of 506 decision scenarios in which LLMs --- endowed with personas representing different races, gender identities, and political ideologies --- expressed significant implicit bias. Next, in a crowdsourced audit, 500 participants made 8,010 binary choices about which implicitly biased decision scenarios most deserved further review. We found that participants prioritized decision scenarios that had broad relevance (e.g., about food choices), were high stakes (e.g., about health), and where all members of a simulated sociodemographic group made unanimous decisions (because it was a clear indication of stereotyping). They were less swayed by the magnitude of an observed disparity or the specific ATUS domain the decision scenario represented. When examining the rationale behind their prioritization choices, we found that participants often interpreted disparities as traits of demographic groups and judged whether those traits seemed plausible, often based on their own internalized stereotypes. We discuss implications for building personalized AI agents, digital twins, social simulations, and for using crowdsourced bias audits.
zh_abstract: 既往研究表明，大语言模型（LLM）在招聘和智力评估等高关注度的一次性决策场景中表现出隐性偏见。然而，随着人们越来越多地使用由LLM驱动的自主AI智能体在日常任务中代为决策，我们必须了解基于社会人口学假设的隐性偏见如何在广泛的日常决策场景中出现。我们利用美国时间使用调查（ATUS）中的17个日常活动领域，生成了一份包含506个决策场景的图谱；在这些场景中，被赋予代表不同种族、性别认同和政治意识形态的人设（persona）的LLM表现出显著的隐性偏见。随后，在一项众包审计中，500名参与者就哪些存在隐性偏见的决策场景最值得进一步审查做出了8,010次二选一选择。我们发现，参与者优先关注具有广泛相关性的决策场景（如有关食物选择的场景）、高风险的决策场景（如有关健康的场景），以及模拟的某一社会人口学群体所有成员做出一致决策的场景（因为这清楚地表明存在刻板印象）。他们较少受到所观察到差异的大小或决策场景所代表的具体ATUS领域的影响。在考察其优先级选择背后的理由时，我们发现参与者常常把差异解释为人口学群体的特质，并判断这些特质是否看似合理，而这种判断往往基于他们自己内化的刻板印象。我们讨论了这些发现对构建个性化AI智能体、数字孪生、社会模拟以及使用众包偏见审计的意义。

title: When Do Histology Foundation Models Need Geometric Test-Time Augmentation?
zh_title: 组织学基础模型何时需要几何测试时增强？
summary: 在9个组织学基础模型和6个通用模型上基准测试D4测试时增强，发现其仍有稳定增益，但在组织学基础模型和更大模型上收益递减。
key_points: 覆盖4个patch级和2个WSI数据集
TCGA-UT上增益由+1.98pp降至+0.50pp
模型越大收益越小；另有熵路由降低开销
reason: 病理基础模型系统基准，有新意但增益有限，属预印本，值得一看档
abstract: Test-time augmentation (TTA) aggregates model predictions across multiple transformed views of an input during inference. Because histology images lack a canonical orientation, $D_4$ TTA---pooling across the 8 rotations and reflections of a square---is a standard default in computational pathology. However, the rise of self-supervised histology foundation models (FMs) with inherent rotational invariance calls its continued utility into question. We benchmark 9 histology FMs and 6 general-purpose models across four patch-level and two whole-slide image (WSI) datasets. We find that $D_4$ TTA remains a reliable post hoc improvement, but benefits diminish from $+1.98$ percentage points (pp) for general-purpose backbones to $+0.50$ pp for histology FMs on TCGA-UT, and shrink further for the largest models. To eliminate computational overhead, our experiments demonstrate that entropy routing---applying TTA selectively to uncertain predictions---recovers most of the gain while augmenting only ${\sim}13\%$ of samples. Finally, we show that patch-level TTA improvements do not transfer to slide-level multiple instance learning (MIL). Code: https://github.com/lars-chen/histology-tta

title: What You Post Is What You Symptom: Estimating Psychometric Networks from Social Media Discourse
zh_title: 从社交媒体话语估计心理测量症状网络
summary: 提出从社交媒体文本直接估计抑郁与进食障碍症状网络的框架，并与临床共同认可网络比较，在三个语料间做了验证。
key_points: 抑郁表达分与BDI-II总分相关ρ=0.434
21项中20项通过FDR显著
分半信度0.935
reason: 精神健康语言分析，跨语料复现，但为预印本无临床验证
abstract: Symptom networks in psychopathology are estimated almost exclusively from self-report questionnaires, restricting inference to whatever symptom set a given instrument covers. We introduce a framework for symptom-resolved network estimation directly from social media discourse and apply the framework to depression and eating disorders, with a third anorexia corpus as cross-dataset validation. To our knowledge, we are the first to estimate symptom-resolved psychometric networks from social media text, compare them to clinical co-endorsement networks, and replicate transdiagnostic linguistic markers across 3 independently recruited corpora spanning 2 disorders simultaneously. For depression, expression scores correlate with BDI-II totals at $ρ{=}0.434$, 20 of 21 items reach FDR significance, and split-half reliability is 0.935. The Network Comparison Test detects few edge differences between modalities (3-5\% of edges), while bridge symptoms diverge. For eating disorders, the item-level results are exploratory. Identified linguistic features replicate the same direction across all 3 corpora, and they cluster in three construct families.

title: Pathology Randomization for Synthetic Priors and Zero-Shot Detection
zh_title: PathoDraw：用于合成先验与零样本检测的病灶随机化
summary: 提出PathoDraw，一种带病灶的脑MRI生成模型，通过合成数据实现对比度无关的异常检测，以利用医院未整理的脑影像档案。
key_points: 以健康解剖为条件生成病灶标签图
对比度无关渲染，单网络估计健康解剖与强度偏差
面向零样本异常检测，预印本
reason: 新颖的生成式方法，但摘要证据有限，预印本
abstract: Hospital brain imaging archives hold a diverse array of pathology at sample sizes beyond prospective studies, particularly for underrepresented populations and diseases. To unlock uncurated clinical data and scale analysis, methods are needed to detect abnormalities across contrasts and resolutions. Synthetic data has provided robust, contrast-agnostic models for a variety of human neuroimaging tasks in healthy anatomy, but pathology detection and other tasks in clinical settings still require real patient data, contrast-specific models, or disease-specific generators. We propose PathoDraw, a generative model of brain MRI with pathology. A conditional distribution of lesions given the healthy anatomy is drawn into the label map before contrast-agnostic rendering, and a single network estimates healthy anatomy with exact signed intensity deviation of any input scan. The contrast-agnostic 3D UNet learns the healthy labels under the lesion and the signed deviation directly and identifies pathology via robust tissue statistics and learned features, despite no training on real pathology. We show zero-shot detection on public stroke, tumor, and white matter hyperintensity datasets as well as archived clinical data, spanning $T_1$w, FLAIR and $T_2$w at various resolutions under a recent unsupervised anomaly detection benchmark protocol. Our single model exceeds or performs comparably to contrast-specific anomaly detectors trained on real scans and keeps healthy anatomy intact. The same generator trains networks for super-resolution and for registration in the presence of pathology. Our model, robust across acquisition and disease, enables the use of uncurated, archived data for clinical analysis. Our code is available at https://github.com/agr78/Pathology-Randomizer.
zh_abstract: 医院脑影像档案中保存着种类多样的病理资料，其样本量超过前瞻性研究，尤其涵盖代表性不足的人群和疾病。为了利用未经整理的临床数据并实现大规模分析，需要能够跨对比度和分辨率检测异常的方法。合成数据已为健康解剖结构下的多种人类神经影像任务提供了稳健的、与对比度无关的模型，但在临床场景中的病理检测及其他任务仍需要真实患者数据、特定对比度的模型或特定疾病的生成器。我们提出PathoDraw，一种含病理的脑MRI生成模型。在与对比度无关的渲染之前，先根据健康解剖结构抽取病灶的条件分布并绘入标签图，同时由单一网络估计任意输入扫描的健康解剖结构及其精确的带符号强度偏差。这一与对比度无关的3D UNet直接学习病灶下方的健康标签和带符号偏差，并通过稳健的组织统计量和学习到的特征识别病理，尽管训练中未使用真实病理数据。我们在近期一项无监督异常检测基准方案下，展示了在公开的卒中、肿瘤和白质高信号数据集以及存档临床数据上的零样本检测，涵盖不同分辨率的$T_1$w、FLAIR和$T_2$w。我们的单一模型优于或相当于在真实扫描上训练的特定对比度异常检测器，并保持健康解剖结构不受影响。同一生成器还可用于训练超分辨率网络以及存在病理时的配准网络。我们的模型在不同采集条件和疾病间均具稳健性，使未经整理的存档数据可用于临床分析。我们的代码见 https://github.com/agr78/Pathology-Randomizer。

title: OICycle: Observe, Infer, and Intervene Cycle for Belief-State Learning in Longitudinal Clinical Decision Making
zh_title: OICycle：纵向临床决策中的信念状态学习
summary: 提出OICycle，将临床决策建模为POMDP，从回顾性轨迹中直接学习随机信念状态，融合不规则多模态记录。
key_points: 用循环算子融合先前信念与新多模态观测
无需手工指定离散状态空间与转移模型
基于回顾性电子病历轨迹，预印本
reason: 方法新颖的纵向建模预印本，摘要无外部验证信息
abstract: Clinical care is a closed loop: clinicians observe partial evidence, infer the patient's state, and intervene, and each intervention determines what is observed next. This makes clinical decision making a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP), in which a belief over a latent patient state must be updated from irregular, multimodal, and incomplete records. Yet most deep clinical models predict from a single snapshot or from coarsely aggregated history, while POMDP-based clinical methods need hand-specified discrete state spaces and transition models that real electronic health records cannot supply. We introduce OICycle (Observe, Infer, and Intervene Cycle), which learns a stochastic belief state directly from retrospective trajectories. At every episode, a learned recurrent operator fuses a sample of the previous belief with the new multimodal observations and the intervention that produced them. The resulting Gaussian belief is trained to predict clinicians' next interventions, the time to the next episode, and next-episode mortality. To enable reproducible evaluation, we release a benchmark derived from MIMIC-IV, MIMIC-IV-Note, and MIMIC-CXR that organizes 72,075 hospital admissions (5.4M laboratory, microbiology, radiology, prescription, and note records) into temporally ordered therapeutic--diagnostic episodes. Compared with an otherwise identical history-free model, OICycle improves next-intervention adaptive recall from 0.253 to 0.347, time-to-next-episode macro-F1 from 0.293 to 0.351, and next-episode mortality macro-F1 from 0.585 to 0.649. Analysis shows that the learned belief encodes intervention type and trajectory position and evolves smoothly across episodes, and that the benefit of history is concentrated in interventions whose ordering depends on prior findings.
zh_abstract: 临床照护是一个闭环：临床医生观察到部分证据，推断患者状态并进行干预，而每次干预又决定下一步观察到什么。这使得临床决策成为一个部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），其中对潜在患者状态的信念必须由不规则、多模态且不完整的记录来更新。然而，大多数深度临床模型仅基于单一时间点快照或粗略汇总的病史进行预测，而基于POMDP的临床方法则需要人工指定离散状态空间和转移模型，这是真实电子健康记录无法提供的。我们提出OICycle（观察、推断与干预循环，Observe, Infer, and Intervene Cycle），其直接从回顾性轨迹中学习随机信念状态。在每个诊疗事件（episode）中，一个习得的循环算子将先前信念的样本与新的多模态观察及产生这些观察的干预相融合。所得到的高斯信念被训练用于预测临床医生的下一次干预、距下一次诊疗事件的时间以及下一次诊疗事件的死亡率。为实现可重复评估，我们发布了一个源自MIMIC-IV、MIMIC-IV-Note和MIMIC-CXR的基准数据集，将72,075例住院病例（540万条实验室、微生物、放射、处方和病历记录）组织为按时间顺序排列的治疗—诊断事件。与其他方面完全相同但不使用病史的模型相比，OICycle将下一次干预的自适应召回率从0.253提高到0.347，将距下一次诊疗事件时间的宏平均F1从0.293提高到0.351，将下一次诊疗事件死亡率的宏平均F1从0.585提高到0.649。分析表明，习得的信念编码了干预类型和轨迹位置，并在各诊疗事件之间平滑演变，且病史带来的获益集中于其顺序取决于既往发现的干预。

title: VITAL: A Framework for Validating Agentic AI in Pharmaceutical Drug Development and Clinical Trial Operations
zh_title: VITAL：药物开发与临床试验中智能体AI的验证框架
summary: 预印本提出VITAL验证框架，经景观分析、法规映射与专家访谈构建，用于评估制药情境下智能体AI的证据充分性与生命周期治理。
key_points: 整合使用情境、可追溯性、自主性与生命周期证据
基于法规与标准映射、专家访谈和多方修订
应用于流行病学分析、选址、入组与试验设计支持
reason: 智能体验证与治理框架有新意，但为预印本，缺实证结局
abstract: Current assurance approaches do not establish whether evidence is sufficient to validate, monitor and govern agentic artificial intelligence (AI) within a pharmaceutical context of use. Plausible outputs may conceal failures in retrieval, reasoning, orchestration or human-control points, where reference standards are unavailable. We developed and operationalised VITAL (Validation by Intended use, Traceability, Autonomy and Lifecycle evidence), a validation framework for agents in clinical development, through landscape analysis, regulatory and standards mapping, expert interviews and multi-stakeholder refinement. VITAL integrates context of use, controls, behavioural validation and lifecycle evidence within a risk-adjusted framework. We applied VITAL across epidemiology and treatment-landscape analysis, site selection, enrolment rescue and trial-design trade-off support to translate autonomy, reversibility, transparency and patient impact into proportionate validation activities, evidence requirements and auditable reconstruction of system behaviour. VITAL may inform evidence requirements and lifecycle accountability for higher-risk pharmaceutical uses; evaluation should assess reproducibility across assessors, organisations and system configurations.

title: Efficient Self-Supervised Adaptation of 3D Abdominal Vision-Language Model for Institution-Specific HCC Classification via Full Fine-Tuning and PEFT
zh_title: 三维腹部视觉语言模型的机构特异HCC分类自监督适配
summary: 预印本将预训练3D医学VLM用CT与报告微调于跨机构肝癌分类，比较全量微调与PEFT，二者均取得较好表现。
key_points: PEFT的AUC为0.79、F1为0.70
全量微调AUC为0.82
跨机构采集差异下的适配比较
reason: VLM适配有基线对比，但为预印本且证据有限
abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) capture cross-modal relationships between image and text, yet their adaptation to institution-specific clinical tasks remains underexplored. In this study, we fine-tuned a pretrained 3D medical VLM for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) classification using paired abdominal CT scans and radiology reports from a different institution with acquisition characteristics that differ from the model's original pretraining corpus. We compared two adaptation strategies: full fine-tuning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), motivated by the common use of PEFT to reduce computational cost and enable adaptation under limited-data constraints. Both approaches achieve strong downstream HCC classification performance despite the cross-institutional domain shift, with PEFT reaching an AUC of 0.79 and F1 of 0.70, and full fine-tuning achieving an AUC of 0.82 and F1 of 0.71. Although these results remain below the performance reported by supervised HCC classification approaches, our method achieves improvements over the pretrained model through CT-report contrastive learning without requiring lesion-level annotations or HCC classification labels as training targets. Full fine-tuning converges rapidly but overfits within a few epochs, whereas PEFT (ConvLoRA for the image encoder and LoRA for the text encoder) attains comparable performance while updating approximately 1% of the model parameters, although requiring more training steps. We also examine the role of contrastive temperature, observing that temperature initialization significantly affects classification performance. This study demonstrates that a 3D medical VLM can be efficiently adapted to institution-specific HCC classification using self-supervised CT-report contrastive learning, while highlighting the practical trade-offs between full fine-tuning and parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
zh_abstract: 医学视觉-语言模型（VLM）能够捕捉图像与文本之间的跨模态关系，但其对机构特定临床任务的适应性仍缺乏探索。在本研究中，我们使用来自另一机构、采集特征与模型原始预训练语料不同的配对腹部CT扫描和放射学报告，对一个预训练的三维医学VLM进行微调，用于肝细胞癌（HCC）分类。我们比较了两种适应策略：全量微调和参数高效微调（PEFT），其动机在于PEFT常用于降低计算成本并在数据有限的条件下实现适应。尽管存在跨机构的域偏移，两种方法均取得了较强的下游HCC分类性能：PEFT的AUC为0.79、F1为0.70，全量微调的AUC为0.82、F1为0.71。虽然这些结果仍低于有监督HCC分类方法所报告的性能，但我们的方法通过CT-报告对比学习相较预训练模型取得了提升，且无需病灶级标注或将HCC分类标签作为训练目标。全量微调收敛迅速，但在数个epoch内即出现过拟合；而PEFT（图像编码器采用ConvLoRA，文本编码器采用LoRA）在仅更新约1%模型参数的情况下达到了相当的性能，尽管需要更多训练步数。我们还考察了对比学习温度的作用，观察到温度初始化显著影响分类性能。本研究表明，三维医学VLM可通过自监督的CT-报告对比学习高效适应于机构特定的HCC分类，同时凸显了全量微调与参数高效微调之间的实际权衡。

title: Who Pays for Byzantine Robustness? Validity, Data-Share Dictatorships, and Fairness When Only a Few Hospitals Collaborate
zh_title: 拜占庭鲁棒性的代价：少数医院联邦学习的有效性与公平性
summary: 在FLamby的三个跨机构医学数据集上审计八种聚合规则，评估只有3–6家医院时拜占庭鲁棒聚合的表现。
key_points: 评估FedAvg、Krum、Bulyan等八种规则
共进行54,214次训练，含攻击者联盟与对照
揭示数据份额主导与公平性问题
reason: 实验规模大的实证审计，预印本，临床落地间接
abstract: Clinical federated learning (FL) collaborations typically connect only three to six hospitals, yet Byzantine-robust aggregation rules are designed and benchmarked on synthetic partitions across dozens of equal-sized clients. We conduct an empirical audit of eight standard aggregation rules: FedAvg, coordinate-wise median, trimmed mean, Krum, Multi-Krum, Bulyan, geometric median (GeoMed), and Centered Clipping (CC). We evaluate both unweighted and sample-size-weighted variants across three cross-silo medical datasets from the FLamby benchmark: Fed-Heart-Disease ($n = 4$ hospitals), Fed-TCGA-BRCA ($n = 6$ regions), and Fed-ISIC2019 ($n = 6$ centres). We execute 54,214 training runs across enumerated attacker coalitions ($f \in \{1, 2\}$) paired with exact-twin leave-out controls that decompose performance drops into honest data loss versus adversarial attack damage. We report three findings. First, client-count validity checks fail to capture breakdown in skewed medical consortia: while $n = 6, f = 1$ satisfies every count condition except Bulyan's, assigning sample-size weights turns median and GeoMed into a clean-model dictatorship whenever a single hospital holds more than half the training data, and causes weighted median, GeoMed, and CC to collapse when that dominant centre attacks. Second, exact-twin leave-out controls reveal that when the largest hospital attacks, the apparent failure of count-based robust rules is predominantly caused by the loss of honest training data (7.5 to 10.4 points on ISIC) rather than adversarial perturbation (2.3 to 3.8 points on ISIC). Conversely, weight-dependent rules suffer large true attack damage (16.1 to 25.1 points on ISIC). Third, unweighted robust rules consistently discount whichever institution generates the most atypical parameter updates, penalizing the smallest hospital on Heart but penalizing larger institutions on TCGA and ISIC.
zh_abstract: 临床联邦学习（FL）合作通常仅连接三至六家医院，然而拜占庭鲁棒聚合规则却是在数十个规模相等的客户端的合成划分上设计和基准测试的。我们对八种标准聚合规则开展了实证审计：FedAvg、逐坐标中位数、截尾均值、Krum、Multi-Krum、Bulyan、几何中位数（GeoMed）和中心化裁剪（Centered Clipping，CC）。我们在 FLamby 基准的三个跨机构医学数据集上评估了未加权和按样本量加权的两种变体：Fed-Heart-Disease（$n = 4$ 家医院）、Fed-TCGA-BRCA（$n = 6$ 个地区）和 Fed-ISIC2019（$n = 6$ 个中心）。我们在枚举的攻击者联盟（$f \in \{1, 2\}$）下执行了 54,214 次训练运行，并配以精确孪生（exact-twin）留出对照，将性能下降分解为诚实数据损失与对抗攻击损害两部分。我们报告三项发现。第一，客户端数量有效性检查无法捕捉偏斜的医学联盟中的失效：虽然 $n = 6, f = 1$ 满足除 Bulyan 之外的所有数量条件，但按样本量赋权会使中位数和 GeoMed 在单一医院持有超过一半训练数据时变为干净模型的“独裁”，并在该主导中心发起攻击时导致加权中位数、GeoMed 和 CC 崩溃。第二，精确孪生留出对照显示，当最大的医院发起攻击时，基于数量的鲁棒规则的表观失效主要是由诚实训练数据的损失（ISIC 上为 7.5 至 10.4 个百分点）而非对抗性扰动（ISIC 上为 2.3 至 3.8 个百分点）造成的。相反，依赖权重的规则遭受较大的真实攻击损害（ISIC 上为 16.1 至 25.1 个百分点）。第三，未加权的鲁棒规则会一致地对产生最不典型参数更新的机构进行降权，在 Heart 上惩罚最小的医院，而在 TCGA 和 ISIC 上惩罚较大的机构。

title: DiagTrace: An Interactive Benchmark for Clinical Decision Making
zh_title: DiagTrace：临床决策交互式基准
summary: 基于PMC病例报告构建510例、八个专科的交互式基准，评估LLM通过逐步获取信息重建诊断轨迹的能力。
key_points: 不一次性给出全部信息，需交互式问询
每例含初始表现、事件库、临床过程与诊断参考
225例用于评估四个LLM
reason: 新交互式基准，规模中等，预印本
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on medical question answering and diagnostic reasoning benchmarks. However, existing evaluations typically provide all patient information upfront and assess only the final diagnosis or rationale. This setup ignores the need to acquire diagnostic evidence incrementally from incomplete information in real-world diagnosis. To bridge this gap, we introduce DiagTrace, a source-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether LLMs can reconstruct the documented diagnostic trajectory through interactive information seeking. Each benchmark instance is built from a PubMed Central case report and includes an initial presentation, an event bank, a clinical course, and diagnostic references. DiagTrace contains 510 cases across eight specialties, with 225 used to evaluate four LLMs on clinical-course alignment, interaction quality, and efficiency. Results reveal trade-offs in coverage, source-consistent ordering, and turn use.

title: Large Language Models Have Not Yet Transformed Science
zh_title: 大语言模型尚未改变科学：250万篇论文分析
summary: 分析五个学科2015–2025年250万篇全文论文，发现除部分词频变化外，多数2023年前趋势延续，未见明显断点。
key_points: 覆盖250万篇全文、五个学科
多数趋势在2023年前后无明显断裂
生物医学主题多样性下降主要因格式标准化
reason: 大规模科学计量研究，属AI for science社会研究，预印本
abstract: The emergence of large language models (LLMs) in late 2022 has raised questions about the future of science, but assessing their impact requires understanding how scientific practices were already evolving. We analyze 2.5 million full-text papers across five disciplines from 2015 to 2025, tracing trends over a broad spectrum of lexical, structural, epistemological, and social dimensions. Aside from frequency shifts in some words, most pre-2023 trends continued with limited detectable breaks. Among the notable exceptions, growth in computer science coauthor teams accelerated significantly in Asia, while apparent declines in biomedical topic diversity largely reflected standardization in article formats. Our study establishes an empirical foundation for monitoring the health of global science as LLM adoption deepens.
zh_abstract: 2022年末大型语言模型（LLM）的出现引发了人们对科学未来的疑问，但评估其影响需要了解科学实践此前已如何演变。我们分析了2015年至2025年间五个学科的250万篇全文论文，追踪了词汇、结构、认识论和社会等广泛维度上的趋势。除部分词语的频率变化外，大多数2023年之前的趋势仍在延续，可检测到的断点有限。在值得注意的例外中，亚洲计算机科学合著团队的增长显著加速，而生物医学主题多样性的明显下降在很大程度上反映了文章格式的标准化。随着LLM应用的不断深入，我们的研究为监测全球科学的健康状况奠定了实证基础。

title: A Visual Information Extraction System Using Multimodal Large Language Models for Scanned Cognitive and Behavioral Assessments
zh_title: 多模态大模型提取扫描认知行为量表信息
summary: 模块化多模态LLM系统，含表单分类与评分提取，双模型不一致时交由人工，认知量表端到端准确率88%。
key_points: 处理MMSE、MoCA、Mini-Cog等量表
双模型验证限制人工审核范围
含手绘分析的定性评估
reason: 多模态LLM用于认知评估，人机协作，预印本
abstract: Objective. Paper-based assessments are common in patient care, but handwriting and scanning artifacts make these forms difficult to process at scale. This study proposes a modular, multimodal LLM-based system with human oversight for extracting fields and scores. We conducted a qualitative analysis of the use of LLMs for hand-drawing analysis. Materials and Methods. The system processes cognitive assessments (i.e., MMSE, MoCA, Mini-Cog) and the NICHQ Vanderbilt Assessment using two modules: 1) a form classifier that assigns a scanned page to a form type, followed by a corresponding 2) score extractor that extracts fields and scores into a schema. A human-in-the-loop design utilizing dual-model validation engages human annotators when two LLMs disagree, limiting manual review to challenging pages only. Results. End-to-end accuracy for cognitive assessments was 88%, with most form types exceeding 90%. For the NICHQ Vanderbilt, overall accuracy reached 97.5%, with all form types above 96%. The human-in-the-loop design further improved cognitive assessment accuracy to 97.5% while reducing manual work by 63.8%. In the Mini-Cog Clock Drawing task, qualitative analysis showed that 62.3% of all extraction errors stemmed from ambiguous drawing, in which cases the LLM provided reasonable readings. Discussion. Compared to current manual data extraction, our LLM-based system reduces processing time by 10 to 20 times and costs by over 12 times. The modular design allows seamless expansion to additional form types. Conclusion. Our system provides an accurate, scalable, and cost-efficient solution for structuring data trapped in handwritten paper forms for clinical decision support.

title: Fine-Grained Japanese Clinical Named Entity Recognition: A Controlled Comparison of BERT and Open-Weight Large Language Models
zh_title: 日语临床细粒度命名实体识别：BERT与开源LLM对比
summary: 在含113类实体的iCorpus上对比两个BERT-CRF基线与九个开源LLM（零样本与QLoRA微调），并考察输出长度限制等生成设置的影响。
key_points: 测试集433句，训练集1672句
零样本最高宽松F1仅0.337
比较JSON Schema约束与token上限
reason: 规范对比但数据小、预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Background: Generative large language models (LLMs) offer an alternative to encoder-based clinical named entity recognition (NER), but their performance on fine-grained Japanese extraction tasks and sensitivity to generation settings remain uncertain. Methods: We compared two fine-tuned BERT-CRF baselines with nine open-weight LLMs on iCorpus, which defines 113 entity categories. The evaluation used 433 sentences from 36 test documents; 1,672 sentences were used for training. LLMs were evaluated using zero-shot prompting with and without JSON Schema constraints and three-seed QLoRA fine-tuning. Fine-tuned models were assessed under different output-token limits, including 900 and larger model-specific limits of 2,600 or 4,096 tokens. Performance was measured using sentence-level label-surface matching with relaxed and exact-surface F1. Results: The highest zero-shot relaxed F1 was 0.337, compared with 0.836-0.841 for the BERT baselines. At the larger output limits, all eight fine-tuned LLMs with at least 13B total parameters exceeded both BERT baselines (relaxed F1, 0.882-0.914; exact-surface F1, 0.840-0.880). Across three-seed means, increasing the output limit improved relaxed F1 by 0.052-0.085, alongside higher recall and fewer length-limited outputs. JSON Schema constraints changed relaxed F1 by -0.014 to +0.008 among seven models outside the two reasoning-oriented configurations, while medical-general model pairs showed no consistent advantage for medical specialization. Conclusions: On this historical Japanese case-report benchmark, task-specific fine-tuning combined with adequate generation capacity was associated with stronger LLM extraction performance. Output-token limits materially affected comparisons with BERT, whereas enforcing output structure alone did not overcome low zero-shot accuracy.
zh_abstract: 【背景】生成式大语言模型（LLM）为基于编码器的临床命名实体识别（NER）提供了一种替代方案，但其在细粒度日语抽取任务上的表现以及对生成设置的敏感性仍不确定。【方法】我们在定义了113个实体类别的 iCorpus 上，将两个微调的 BERT-CRF 基线与九个开放权重 LLM 进行了比较。评估使用来自36份测试文档的433个句子；训练使用1,672个句子。LLM 采用带或不带 JSON Schema 约束的零样本提示，以及三个随机种子的 QLoRA 微调进行评估。对微调后的模型在不同输出 token 上限下进行评估，包括900以及更大的模型特定上限2,600或4,096 tokens。性能采用句子级标签-表面形式匹配，以宽松 F1 和精确表面形式 F1 衡量。【结果】零样本最高宽松 F1 为0.337，而 BERT 基线为0.836-0.841。在较大的输出上限下，总参数量至少为13B的全部八个微调 LLM 均超过两个 BERT 基线（宽松 F1，0.882-0.914；精确表面形式 F1，0.840-0.880）。按三个种子的均值计，提高输出上限使宽松 F1 提升0.052-0.085，同时召回率更高、受长度限制的输出更少。在两种面向推理的配置之外的七个模型中，JSON Schema 约束使宽松 F1 的变化为-0.014至+0.008，而医学-通用模型配对未显示医学专业化具有一致优势。【结论】在这一历史性的日语病例报告基准上，任务特异性微调结合充足的生成容量与更强的 LLM 抽取性能相关。输出 token 上限对与 BERT 的比较有实质性影响，而仅强制输出结构并不能克服较低的零样本准确率。

title: Not All Evidence Is Admissible: Evidence Governance for Tool-Augmented Medical Agents
zh_title: 证据治理：工具增强型医疗智能体的证据准入
summary: 指出工具增强医疗智能体会因工具静默失败而被错误输出误导（证据劫持），提出将证据取舍与推理器分离的证据治理框架。
key_points: 工具输出可能带来负的可用信息
用V-information解释该现象
按内容选择证据而非单纯减少输入
reason: 有理论与新方法的预印本，证据有限，值得一看档
abstract: Tool-augmented medical agents treat whatever their tools return as evidence. We show that this default is costly: medical tools fail silently, and a frozen reasoner cannot ignore what enters its context, so many cases it would have answered correctly are flipped to wrong once tool outputs are added. We call this evidence hijacking. $\mathcal{V}$-information explains the phenomenon: the reasoner has lost the option to ignore, so a tool output can carry negative usable information, and moving the decision of what to keep outside the reasoner restores that option. The theory further shows that part of any filtering gain comes merely from letting the reasoner see less, and only selection by content lets it see better. Building on this, we recast tool-augmented reasoning as evidence governance, which separates deciding what counts as evidence from the reasoner that answers, and propose context-independent evidence governance (CIEG), the first medical agent framework that rules, after acquisition, on whether each individual tool output may enter as evidence. Every tool output is written as a card that can be checked against the raw input; an independent checker that sees only the input and the cards decides which cards become evidence; and the reasoner answers from the admitted cards alone, with no training anywhere. On medical question answering, fundus glaucoma screening, and chest X-ray pneumonia classification, it achieves the highest accuracy among models of comparable scale, and significantly outperforms state-of-the-art tool-using agents and multi-agent systems built on the same backbone at lower cost.
zh_abstract: 工具增强的医学智能体会将其工具返回的任何内容视为证据。我们表明这一默认做法代价高昂：医学工具会静默失败，而冻结的推理器无法忽略进入其上下文的内容，因此许多本可回答正确的病例在加入工具输出后被翻转为错误。我们将此称为证据劫持（evidence hijacking）。$\mathcal{V}$-信息可以解释这一现象：推理器失去了忽略的选项，因此工具输出可能带有负的可用信息，而将“保留什么”的决定移至推理器之外可恢复该选项。理论进一步表明，任何过滤收益中有一部分仅来自让推理器看到更少，只有按内容进行选择才能让其看得更好。在此基础上，我们将工具增强推理重新定义为证据治理，将“何者算作证据”的判定与作答的推理器分离，并提出上下文无关证据治理（context-independent evidence governance，CIEG），这是首个在获取之后裁定每个单独工具输出能否作为证据进入的医学智能体框架。每个工具输出都被写成可对照原始输入核查的卡片；仅看到输入和卡片的独立核查器决定哪些卡片成为证据；推理器仅根据被采纳的卡片作答，全程无需任何训练。在医学问答、眼底青光眼筛查和胸部 X 线肺炎分类任务上，它在同等规模模型中取得最高准确率，并以更低成本显著优于基于相同骨干模型构建的最先进的工具使用型智能体和多智能体系统。

title: Compact and Decodable Electrocardiogram Text for Large Language Models
zh_title: 面向大语言模型的紧凑可解码心电图文本编码
summary: 提出确定性编码，将12导联心电图写成文本供LLM使用，只编码8个独立导联，其余4个肢体导联代数恢复，并在21,388条PTB-XL记录上评估。
key_points: 用26字母对数码本表示幅值，并编码精确时间间隔
10步容差调度使记录保持在固定token预算内
以解码再编码往返、重建误差和分类器对比评估
reason: 新颖的ECG文本化方法，基于公开数据，预印本，缺少临床验证
abstract: When a twelve-lead electrocardiogram is written as text for a large language model, the number of tokens has to be balanced against the information lost through compression. This paper presents a deterministic encoding that writes eight independent leads as amplitude letters and exact time gaps and recovers the remaining four limb leads algebraically. The key points are selected with a cardiac-cycle-dependent tolerance, the amplitudes are parameterized by a 26-letter logarithmic codebook learned from a training set, and a 10-step tolerance schedule keeps all records within a fixed token budget. The encoding was applied to 21,388 records from the public PTB-XL database and evaluated using an exact decode-and-re-encode round trip, waveform reconstruction error, and a paired comparison of convolutional classifiers trained with 5 different seeds on signals from the original and decoded databases. All records were contained in 4,080 tokens (average: 2,866 tokens, 64.3% fewer than a per-sample transcription), and all stored lead strings were exactly reproduced. The average correlation between the decoded and reference signals was 0.982. The macro-averaged area under the receiver operating characteristic curve was 0.9167 for the reference signals and 0.9157 for the decoded signals (paired difference -0.0010; 95% patient-level bootstrap interval, -0.0028 to 0.0007), within the pre-specified non-inferiority margin of -0.010; this is not a confirmatory result, because the test fold had been used during encoder development. The diagnostic content of a compact text can therefore be preserved, while the language model's ability to read the text is yet another matter.
zh_abstract: 当将十二导联心电图写成文本供大语言模型使用时，必须在 token 数量与压缩造成的信息损失之间取得平衡。本文提出一种确定性编码：将八个独立导联写成幅值字母和精确的时间间隔，其余四个肢体导联则通过代数方法恢复。关键点的选取采用随心动周期变化的容差，幅值由从训练集中学得的 26 个字母的对数码本参数化，并通过 10 步容差调度使所有记录保持在固定的 token 预算内。该编码应用于公开 PTB-XL 数据库的 21,388 条记录，并通过精确的解码再编码往返、波形重建误差，以及对在原始数据库和解码后数据库信号上用 5 个不同随机种子训练的卷积分类器进行配对比较来评估。所有记录均包含在 4,080 个 token 以内（平均：2,866 个 token，比逐采样点转录减少 64.3%），且所有存储的导联字符串均被精确重现。解码信号与参考信号之间的平均相关系数为 0.982。参考信号的宏平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积为 0.9167，解码信号为 0.9157（配对差值 -0.0010；患者水平 bootstrap 95% 区间为 -0.0028 至 0.0007），处于预先设定的 -0.010 非劣效界值之内；由于测试折在编码器开发期间已被使用，这并非确证性结果。因此，紧凑文本的诊断内容可以得到保留，而语言模型能否读懂该文本则是另一回事。

title: Leveraging Segmentation Representations for Efficient Classification: A Self-Configuring Framework Based on nnU-Net
zh_title: 基于nnU-Net的自配置分割表征高效分类框架
summary: 将nnU-Net自配置流程扩展到三维医学影像的分割与分类，复用分割模型编码器特征和预测概率，由轻量分类器完成图像级分类。
key_points: 冻结骨干分支加入ROI信息、前景体积和分割置信度
适配分支部分微调末级编码器并保留辅助分割损失
五折实验显示更复杂配置未稳定提升分类
reason: 实用的3D影像方法，预印本，增量性较强
abstract: We propose a self-configuring framework that extends the nnU-Net workflow to both segmentation and classification in 3D medical imaging. Building on nnU-Net's self-configuring method, the framework reuses representations learned by a segmentation model for image-level classification. Its encoder features and predicted segmentation probabilities are used by a lightweight classifier. Two information-sharing strategies are investigated. In the frozen-backbone branch, features are augmented with region-of-interest information, predicted foreground volume, and segmentation confidence. In the adaptation branch, the final encoder stage is partially fine-tuned for classification, with an auxiliary segmentation loss to preserve segmentation-related information. Additional five-fold experiments showed that more complex configurations did not consistently improve classification performance. On the public validation leaderboard, our selected framework achieved an Overall score of 0.8056. In the official FLARE 2026 Task 2 final evaluation, our framework ranked first overall, achieving the highest DSC, NSD, and AUROC across all four testing tasks, including two hidden testing tasks. Local inference measurements also remained below the challenge limits of $60 \mathrm{s}$ per case and $4 \mathrm{GB}$ GPU memory. These results demonstrate the practical value of reusing segmentation representations for classification while maintaining a simple and efficient framework.
zh_abstract: 我们提出了一种自配置框架，将 nnU-Net 工作流程扩展到三维医学影像的分割与分类。该框架以 nnU-Net 的自配置方法为基础，复用分割模型学到的表征进行图像级分类，其编码器特征和预测的分割概率由一个轻量级分类器使用。我们研究了两种信息共享策略。在冻结骨干网络分支中，特征通过感兴趣区域信息、预测的前景体积和分割置信度进行增强。在适应分支中，对最后一个编码器阶段进行部分微调以用于分类，并加入辅助分割损失以保留与分割相关的信息。额外的五折实验表明，更复杂的配置并未持续提升分类性能。在公开验证排行榜上，我们所选框架的总分（Overall）为 0.8056。在 FLARE 2026 Task 2 官方最终评估中，我们的框架总体排名第一，在包括两个隐藏测试任务在内的全部四个测试任务中取得了最高的 DSC、NSD 和 AUROC。本地推理测量结果也低于挑战赛规定的每例 $60 \mathrm{s}$ 和 $4 \mathrm{GB}$ GPU 显存上限。这些结果表明，在保持框架简单高效的同时，复用分割表征进行分类具有实际价值。

title: When Expert Disagreement Hurts: Prestige and Selectivity in LLM Decision Revision
zh_title: 专家分歧何时有害：LLM 决策修订中的权威与选择性
summary: 受控两轮审计显示，在医学、科学和法律的 1,989 个证据型决策上，五个模型在专家分歧下均未达到有益修订所需的选择性，准确率最多下降 16.1 点。
key_points: 固定题目、证据与初始答案，仅改变修订语境
修订有益需选择性高于 a/(1-a) 的阈值
专家标签这一权威线索增加了多个模型的翻转
reason: 设计清晰的预印本评测，涉及医学但非专门医疗，证据有限
abstract: When language models revise a decision after another agent disagrees, neither reversal counts nor final accuracy shows whether they are fixing mistakes or abandoning correct answers. We introduce a controlled two-pass audit that holds the question, the evidence, and the model's initial answer fixed and varies only the revision context: neutral reflection, anonymous disagreement, or disagreement attributed to a domain expert. For binary decisions the accounting is exact: revision raises accuracy only if it is selective enough, reversing wrong answers more than a/(1-a) times as often as correct ones, where a is initial accuracy (nine times at 90%). Across five models and 1,989 evidence-grounded decisions in medicine, science, and law, no model clears this bar under expert disagreement, and accuracy falls by up to 16.1 points. The expert label, a prestige cue, adds reversals for four of the five models, yet its effect on accuracy ranges from a 5.2-point loss to a 2.4-point gain, so reversal counts are a poor proxy for harm. With identical arguments from both sources, the label still raises reversal for three proprietary models and in a pooled analysis of four newer models. Models also respond to stated source reliability. Revision pipelines should therefore be evaluated with paired, conditional metrics, per model and protocol.
zh_abstract: 当语言模型在另一个智能体表示不同意后修改其决策时，无论是反转次数还是最终准确率，都无法说明它们是在纠正错误还是在放弃正确答案。我们提出一种受控的两轮审计方法，保持问题、证据和模型的初始答案不变，仅改变修订情境：中性反思、匿名异议，或归因于领域专家的异议。对于二元决策，其核算是精确的：只有当修订具有足够的选择性时，即推翻错误答案的频率超过推翻正确答案频率的 a/(1-a) 倍（其中 a 为初始准确率；准确率为 90% 时为9倍），修订才会提高准确率。在医学、科学和法律领域的五个模型和1,989个基于证据的决策中，没有任何模型在专家异议下达到这一标准，准确率最多下降16.1个百分点。专家标签作为一种声望线索，使五个模型中的四个反转增多，但其对准确率的影响从下降5.2个百分点到提高2.4个百分点不等，因此反转次数并不能很好地代表危害。当两种来源提供相同论据时，该标签仍会使三个专有模型以及四个较新模型的合并分析中的反转增加。模型也会对所陈述的来源可靠性作出反应。因此，修订流程应按模型和方案，采用配对的条件性指标进行评估。

title: Multiparametric 0.4-T low-field MRI mapping for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease in rats.
zh_title: 大鼠MASLD的0.4T低场多参数MRI定量成像
summary: 前瞻性横断面临床前研究，在90只大鼠中用深度学习重建T1成像的0.4T多参数MRI评估MASLD，并以数字病理对照。
key_points: 90只Wistar大鼠，饮食诱导、进展与恢复
指标含T1、FcT1、T2、T2*及PDFF估计
以全切片数字病理量化脂肪、纤维化、炎症与铁
reason: 动物单研究、无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [European radiology experimental] Low-field MRI may broaden access to quantitative liver imaging, but low signal-to-noise ratio and coexisting steatosis, inflammation, fibrosis, and iron complicate relaxometry in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). We evaluated multiparametric 0.4-T MRI with deep-learning-reconstructed T1 mapping in rats. In this prospective cross-sectional preclinical study, 90 male Wistar rats underwent 0.4-T liver MRI during dietary induction, progression, and recovery. Metrics included native T1, fat-corrected T1 (FcT1), T2, T2*, and an apparent proton density fat fraction (PDFF) estimate. Whole-section digital pathology quantified steatosis, fibrosis, inflammation, and iron. Associations were assessed using iron-adjusted and stage-aware analyses, multivariable regression with variance inflation factors, and receiver operating characteristic analysis. Steatosis strongly correlated with T2 (ρ = 0.90, p 2.42% (0.77 versus 0.62; p = 0.008) and > 2.90% (0.78 versus 0.60; p = 0.001). Stage-aware analyses attenuated T1-fibrosis associations, and recovery animals showed residual fibrosis with near-baseline T1. Multiparametric 0.4-T MRI showed complementary, partly stage-dependent associations with MASLD pathology. T2/PDFF tracked steatosis; T2* retained an inflammation-related association after stage adjustment; and T1 elevation characterized active high-burden progression rather than isolated residual fibrosis. Human validation and platform calibration are required. Question Noninvasive MASLD assessment needs accessible imaging biomarkers that account for coexisting steatosis, inflammation, fibrosis, and iron-related confounding in liver MRI. Findings Multiparametric 0.4-T MRI showed complementary but stage-dependent associations: T2/apparent PDFF tracked steatosis, T2* related to inflammation, and T1 rose during high-burden progression. Relevance statement Multiparametric 0.4-T MRI provides complementary pathology-correlated measurements for MASLD assessment in rats, but reconstruction-dependent T1 bias and apparent PDFF estimation require platform calibration and human validation before clinical interpretation.
zh_abstract: [欧洲放射学实验] 低场MRI可能扩大定量肝脏成像的可及性，但信噪比低，以及并存的脂肪变性、炎症、纤维化和铁沉积，使代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MASLD）的弛豫测量变得复杂。我们在大鼠中评估了采用深度学习重建T1成像的多参数0.4-T MRI。在这项前瞻性横断面临床前研究中，90只雄性Wistar大鼠在饮食诱导、进展及恢复过程中接受了0.4-T肝脏MRI。指标包括原生T1、脂肪校正T1（FcT1）、T2、T2*以及表观质子密度脂肪分数（PDFF）估计值。全切片数字病理定量了脂肪变性、纤维化、炎症和铁。采用经铁校正和分期感知的分析、带方差膨胀因子的多变量回归以及受试者工作特征分析评估相关性。脂肪变性与T2高度相关（ρ = 0.90，p 2.42%（0.77 对 0.62；p = 0.008）以及 > 2.90%（0.78 对 0.60；p = 0.001）。分期感知分析削弱了T1与纤维化的关联，恢复期动物表现为残余纤维化而T1接近基线。多参数0.4-T MRI显示出与MASLD病理互补的、部分依赖于分期的关联。T2/PDFF反映脂肪变性；T2*在分期校正后仍保留与炎症相关的关联；T1升高表征的是活动性的高负荷进展，而非孤立的残余纤维化。仍需进行人体验证和平台校准。问题：无创MASLD评估需要可及的影像生物标志物，以考虑肝脏MRI中并存的脂肪变性、炎症、纤维化及铁相关混杂。发现：多参数0.4-T MRI显示出互补但依赖分期的关联：T2/表观PDFF反映脂肪变性，T2*与炎症相关，T1在高负荷进展期升高。相关性说明：多参数0.4-T MRI为大鼠MASLD评估提供了与病理相关的互补测量，但依赖于重建的T1偏倚和表观PDFF估计，在临床解读之前需要平台校准和人体验证。
