title: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
zh_title: System 1 智能体：本地、可靠、快速的智能体方法
summary: 提出无需生成文本的本地 System 1 智能体，用确定性编译器将工具调用转为选择题，在157个生物医学工具的1952条请求上评测。
key_points: 在1952条请求中，工具选择或正确拒绝率为97.0%，高于18种本地LLM智能体设置（最佳95.2%）
6056个参数值中填充97.0%
System 1 调用中未出现编造内容
reason: 新方法有基线对比，但为预印本且为工具调用基准，非临床验证
abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence could automate analyses of sensitive clinical data, but current agents depend on large language models (LLMs). Cloud LLMs expose patient data. Local LLMs hallucinate, and an invented value in a tool call propagates through every later step. Here we present a method to build System 1 agents: local agents that call tools without generating text. A deterministic compiler turns each tool's schema and the request into multiple-choice questions whose options come from the request and the schema, then a one-pass decision model answers them. On 1,952 requests to 157 biomedical tools, the best System 1 agent chose the right tool, or correctly declined, for 97.0% of requests, significantly ahead of all 18 local LLM-agent settings (best 95.2%). The System 1 agent filled 97.0% of 6,056 stated argument values. No System 1 call contained invented content, against 5.5-19.7% of LLM calls. The System 1 Agents framework is freely available as open-source software at https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents.
zh_abstract: 智能体人工智能可以自动分析敏感的临床数据，但目前的智能体依赖大语言模型（LLM）。云端 LLM 会暴露患者数据。本地 LLM 会产生幻觉，而工具调用中虚构的数值会在之后的每一步中传播。在此我们提出一种构建 System 1 智能体的方法：这类本地智能体无需生成文本即可调用工具。一个确定性编译器将每个工具的模式（schema）和请求转换为多项选择题，其选项来自请求和模式，然后由单次前向的决策模型作答。在针对 157 个生物医学工具的 1,952 条请求中，最佳 System 1 智能体为 97.0% 的请求选对了工具或正确地拒绝调用，显著优于全部 18 种本地 LLM 智能体设置（最佳为 95.2%）。System 1 智能体填充了 6,056 个已陈述参数值中的 97.0%。System 1 的调用中没有出现虚构内容，而 LLM 调用中该比例为 5.5%–19.7%。System 1 Agents 框架作为开源软件免费提供，网址为 https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents。

title: PlainPairs: A Corpus Pairing the Prescriber and Patient Texts of U.S. Prescription Medicine Labels
zh_title: PlainPairs：美国处方药标签医生版与患者版配对语料库
summary: 基于 openFDA 构建开放语料库，含 35,177 份带患者文本的处方药标签、250,829 个与医生版章节匹配的患者文本片段，并附阅读难度指标。
key_points: 另含 NCI 癌症信息摘要 756 份，中英文
提供阅读水平与通俗语言措辞统计
公开语料可用于医患文本简化研究
reason: 公开中等规模语料，有用但为单一作者预印本
abstract: A prescription medicine in the United States comes with labeling written for prescribers, and many medicines also carry a text written for patients: a Medication Guide or a patient package insert. The two texts describe the same medicine for two readers, yet public resources rarely hold them side by side. I present PlainPairs, an open corpus built from the openFDA drug label files. Version 0.1.0 holds 35,177 prescription labels that carry a patient text, 21,416 distinct patient texts, 250,829 patient-text segments matched to prescriber sections through their regulatory headings, reading-level measures on both sides, and rule-based counts of plain-language wording. A second source, the National Cancer Institute's cancer information summaries, adds 756 summaries in health-professional and patient versions, in English and Spanish. Measured on the structure of the label, the median Medication Guide reads at grade 8.7 by Flesch-Kincaid and at grade 11.1 by SMOG. The same guides measured on the flattened text that the bulk files serve read about two grades higher, a difference that comes from lost list and heading boundaries. Patient texts address the reader in 41 of every 100 sentences, against 0.2 in prescriber sections. A blind hand check of 100 pairs supports the heading-based alignment for seven of ten heading types. The corpus, its code and its documents are public, and the release keeps texts that show a company copyright mark out of the text tables.
zh_abstract: 美国的处方药附有面向开处方者撰写的说明书，许多药品还附有面向患者的文本：用药指南（Medication Guide）或患者包装说明书。这两种文本为两类读者描述同一种药品，但公共资源很少将二者并列呈现。我提出 PlainPairs，这是一个基于 openFDA 药品标签文件构建的开放语料库。0.1.0 版包含35,177份带有患者文本的处方药标签、21,416份不同的患者文本、通过法规标题与开处方者章节匹配的250,829个患者文本片段、双方的阅读难度指标，以及基于规则的通俗语言措辞计数。第二个来源是美国国家癌症研究所的癌症信息摘要，新增756份摘要，包含医疗专业人员版和患者版，并有英文和西班牙文。按标签结构测量，用药指南的中位数阅读水平按 Flesch-Kincaid 为8.7年级，按 SMOG 为11.1年级。同样的指南若按批量文件提供的扁平化文本测量，阅读水平高出约两个年级，这一差异源于列表和标题边界的丢失。患者文本每100个句子中有41句直接称呼读者，而开处方者章节中为0.2句。对100对文本的盲法人工核查支持十种标题类型中七种的基于标题的对齐。该语料库、其代码和文档均已公开，发布版本将带有公司版权标记的文本排除在文本表之外。

title: FM-Recon: Exploring Foundation Model Features for Accelerated Cardiac Cine MRI Reconstruction
zh_title: FM-Recon：利用基础模型特征加速心脏电影MRI重建
summary: 提出将冻结的基础模型图像编码器特征融入展开式重建网络，在CMRxRecon2023数据集上评估，报告重建性能提升。
key_points: 冻结基础模型编码器特征嵌入展开网络
在伪影污染输入下仍能提取有效表征
基于CMRxRecon2023数据集系统评估
reason: 新颖预印本方法有基线对比，证据有限
abstract: Foundation models have demonstrated strong feature extraction capabilities across various medical imaging tasks, yet their potential for MRI reconstruction remains largely unexplored, particularly within unrolled reconstruction networks and under artifact-corrupted inputs. In this work, we explore whether and how features from pretrained foundation models can benefit accelerated cardiac cine MRI reconstruction. To this end, we propose FM-Recon, a framework that refines and integrates extracted features from frozen image encoder of foundation models into an unrolled reconstruction network. Through extensive experiments on the CMRxRecon2023 dataset, we systematically evaluate foundation model features across different reconstruction settings. Our results show that foundation models can extract informative representations from artifact-corrupted inputs and improve reconstruction performance, particularly at moderate acceleration factors. These findings demonstrate the potential of foundation model features for accelerated MRI reconstruction and provide insights into their effective integration into unrolled reconstruction networks.
zh_abstract: 基础模型（foundation models）已在多种医学影像任务中展现出强大的特征提取能力，但其在MRI重建中的潜力仍很大程度上未被探索，尤其是在展开式（unrolled）重建网络以及伪影污染输入的情形下。在本研究中，我们探讨预训练基础模型的特征是否以及如何有助于加速心脏电影MRI重建。为此，我们提出FM-Recon框架，该框架对基础模型冻结图像编码器所提取的特征进行优化，并将其整合到展开式重建网络中。通过在CMRxRecon2023数据集上开展的大量实验，我们在不同重建设置下系统评估了基础模型特征。结果表明，基础模型能够从伪影污染的输入中提取有信息量的表征并提升重建性能，在中等加速倍数下尤为明显。这些发现证明了基础模型特征用于加速MRI重建的潜力，并为将其有效整合进展开式重建网络提供了见解。

title: Does the Voice Matter? Evaluating Frustration Detection on Deployed Clinical Voice-Agent Calls
zh_title: 声音重要吗？已部署临床语音智能体通话中的挫败感检测评估
summary: 在真实部署的临床语音智能体通话上评估逐轮挫败感检测，比较仅转录文本与音频模型，并以表演语料作对照。
key_points: 标注 6 通通话 150 轮，另有 30 通 714 轮
真实患者发言多很短，约 59% 为一两个词
单词轮次上仅转录检测不能排除随机水平
reason: 真实部署数据有新意，但样本小、预印本
abstract: Autonomous voice agents now conduct routine clinical follow-up calls, so some automated triage is unavoidable. A patient becoming frustrated is one thing that triage should catch. These systems typically read only the transcript the speech-to-text stage produces, not the voice, and whether that is enough is largely untested on real clinical speech. We study per-turn frustration detection on real patient calls from a deployed clinical voice agent: 150 turns from six calls labelled by three annotators, with a length-matched acted corpus as a control, and 714 turns from 30 calls. Patient turns are overwhelmingly short: across the deployed calls, roughly 59% are one or two words, against 13% in the full acted corpus, and a corpus accuracy gap remains even after the acted set is length-matched. On one-word turns, transcript-only detection does not exclude chance. Across five audio-capable language models, the transcript flags 3 or 4 of the 39 frustrated one-word turns in the 30 calls, and a classifier given only the word count reaches 57.3%. Whether audio helps depends on the model and on the instruction. Asked to attend to delivery, two Gemini 2.5 models gain 3.0 pp over the transcript across 30 calls (-1.0 to 7.5 pp). Of the turns they confidently clear, 6.9% were in fact frustrated for audio against 13.0% for the transcript, a difference of 6.1 pp (2.2 to 10.4 pp). Across the 30 calls, given one prompt identical for both inputs, no model's audio-text interval excludes zero. Under the input-specific prompts, a newer Gemini model and two smaller open models do worse with audio than with the transcript (-3.5, -8.6 and -10.6 pp). A WavLM probe trained on the clinical calls matches the best prompted model overall (71.6%) but misses every frustrated one-word turn in the 24 added calls. When a patient's turn is short, the transcript alone is not enough to rule out frustration.
zh_abstract: 自主语音智能体目前已可开展常规临床随访电话，因此一定程度的自动分诊不可避免。患者出现沮丧情绪就是分诊应当识别的情形之一。这类系统通常只读取语音转文字环节生成的转录文本，而不读取语音本身，而这是否足够，在真实临床语音上基本未经检验。我们研究了来自已部署临床语音智能体的真实患者通话中的逐轮沮丧检测：来自6次通话的150个轮次由三名标注者标注，并以长度匹配的表演语料库作为对照，另有来自30次通话的714个轮次。患者的发言轮次绝大多数很短：在已部署的通话中，约59%为一到两个词，而完整表演语料库中这一比例为13%；即使将表演语料按长度匹配后，语料库间的准确率差距依然存在。对于单词轮次，仅基于转录文本的检测无法排除随机水平。在五个具备音频能力的语言模型中，转录文本在30次通话的39个沮丧的单词轮次中只标出3或4个，而仅给定词数的分类器可达到57.3%。音频是否有帮助取决于模型和指令。当被要求关注说话方式时，两个Gemini 2.5模型在30次通话中比转录文本提高3.0个百分点（-1.0至7.5个百分点）。在它们有把握地判定为无沮丧的轮次中，使用音频时实际沮丧的占6.9%，而使用转录文本时为13.0%，差异为6.1个百分点（2.2至10.4个百分点）。在30次通话中，当对两种输入使用同一个提示时，没有任何模型的音频-文本区间排除零。在针对各输入专门设计的提示下，一个较新的Gemini模型和两个较小的开源模型使用音频时表现比使用转录文本更差（分别为-3.5、-8.6和-10.6个百分点）。基于临床通话训练的WavLM探针总体上与表现最佳的提示模型相当（71.6%），但在新增的24次通话中漏掉了每一个沮丧的单词轮次。当患者的发言很短时，仅凭转录文本不足以排除沮丧情绪。

title: Scribble Once, Segment the Sequence: Bidirectional Temporal Consistency for Weakly Supervised Segmentation in Echocardiography Sequences
zh_title: 一次涂鸦分割整个序列：超声心动图弱监督分割
summary: 提出基于冻结2D视觉基础模型、仅需单次涂鸦标注的双向时序一致性弱监督超声心动图序列分割框架。
key_points: 仅需序列中单次涂鸦标注
利用冻结2D视觉基础模型的空间先验
双向时序一致性传播信息
reason: 有新意的预印本方法，涉及基础模型，证据有限
abstract: Temporal medical image segmentation relies on pixel-wise annotations, which are prohibitively expensive for long image sequences. Existing weakly-supervised methods reduce the annotation burden per frame but still require repeated annotations across the sequence. Furthermore, sparse supervision can result in temporally unstable representations. Addressing both challenges requires a model that can leverage strong spatial priors from large-scale pretraining while minimizing reliance on dense annotations. Frozen 2D vision foundation models provide a promising basis for this by offering transferable spatial representations with low trainable parameters. However, their lack of explicit temporal modeling limits their ability to propagate reliable information across anatomical sequences. To address this, we present a weakly-supervised framework for temporal segmentation from a single scribble-annotated frame, with all remaining frames left unlabeled. The framework combines parameter-efficient adaptation of DINOv3 encoders present in the mean-teacher architecture. Furthermore, a set of complementary losses, including a temporal loss helps generate reliable segmentation priors for the unlabeled frames. This formulation decouples annotation costs from sequence length while retaining the transferable spatial knowledge of the pretrained encoder. Extensive experiments on the publicly available CAMUS and CardiacNet datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms other scribble-supervised methods. These results show that accurate and temporally consistent segmentation can be achieved from extremely sparse supervision, substantially reducing annotation requirements for temporal echocardiographic segmentation and providing a practical framework for scalable clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: 时序医学图像分割依赖逐像素标注，而对于长图像序列而言，这种标注的成本高得令人难以承受。现有的弱监督方法虽然降低了每帧的标注负担，但仍需在整个序列中重复标注。此外，稀疏监督可能导致时间上不稳定的表征。要同时应对这两方面的挑战，需要一种既能利用大规模预训练带来的强空间先验、又能尽量减少对密集标注依赖的模型。冻结的二维视觉基础模型以较少的可训练参数提供可迁移的空间表征，为此提供了有前景的基础。然而，它们缺乏显式的时间建模，限制了其在解剖序列间传播可靠信息的能力。为此，我们提出了一种弱监督框架，仅需单个涂鸦（scribble）标注帧即可进行时序分割，其余所有帧均不标注。该框架在均值教师（mean-teacher）架构中结合了对 DINOv3 编码器的参数高效适配。此外，一组互补的损失函数（包括时间损失）有助于为未标注帧生成可靠的分割先验。这一设计使标注成本与序列长度脱钩，同时保留了预训练编码器可迁移的空间知识。在公开的 CAMUS 和 CardiacNet 数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法优于其他涂鸦监督方法。这些结果表明，在极其稀疏的监督下也能实现准确且时间一致的分割，从而大幅降低时序超声心动图分割的标注需求，并为可扩展的临床部署提供了实用框架。

title: MedJev: A System One Vision-Language Decision Model for Fast and Effective Medical Image Understanding
zh_title: MedJev：用于快速医学图像理解的系统一视觉语言决策模型
summary: MedJev去除自回归生成，单次前向将图像、问题和候选答案直接映射为决策，以降低推理延迟和解析错误。
key_points: 裁掉上层语言层与生成输出通路
保留完整视觉通路与全部视觉token
决策头对候选答案打分并精炼
reason: 医学VLM新方法，思路有新意，但摘要无具体结果，预印本
abstract: Medical image understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) typically relies on autoregressively generating reasoning and answer tokens. These unnecessary tokens make the inference cost scale with the response length and force the answer to be parsed from free-form text, incurring avoidable latency and decision errors. To this end, we introduce \textsc{MedJev}, a \emph{system one} vision-language decision model that maps medical images, questions, and candidate answers directly to decisions in a single multimodal forward pass, without any autoregressive generation process. For fast inference, \textsc{MedJev} removes the upper language layers and the generative output pathway, while keeping the full vision pathway and all visual tokens. On this shortened backbone, a decision head scores each candidate by pretrained query--key matching and refines the scores with a lightweight multilayer perceptron (MLP) residual, coupling the pretrained matching structure with task-specific nonlinear discrimination. Built on Qwen3.5-4B, \textsc{MedJev}-4B improves both accuracy and speed over the original model on each of four medical image classification and visual question answering benchmarks, with an absolute accuracy gain of \textbf{7.93\%} and a \textbf{6.04$\times$} end-to-end speedup. Further comparison with 20 cutting-edge models shows that \textsc{MedJev}-4B achieves state-of-the-art performance and inference speed among 4B--9B general and medical VLMs, indicating that direct multimodal decision making is an effective route to fast and effective medical image understanding.

title: Medical question answering collapses in Hausa: a pre-registered pilot on three small open models
zh_title: 医学问答在豪萨语中崩塌：三个小型开源模型的预注册试点
summary: 在配对的英语-豪萨语MedMCQA题上评估3–4B指令微调模型，发现豪萨语准确率显著下降，部分模型未超过多数类基线。
key_points: 多个模型未超过总选最常见选项的基线
所有差距经Holm校正均显著
回译可恢复约一半至三分之二差距
reason: 低资源语言公平性试点，预注册设计但模型小、规模有限
abstract: A system that reads nothing and always answers the most frequent letter scores \BaselineP{} on our Hausa medical multiple-choice set. \NBelowBaseline{} of the \NModels{} small open models we evaluate do not beat it. We lead with that because the usual summary of a multilingual result -- a percentage-point drop from English -- does not say whether what survives the drop is performance at all. On a paired English--Hausa set of \NEval{} MedMCQA items, three instruction-tuned models of 3--4B parameters lose between \GapMedGemma{} and \GapQwen{} points of accuracy, every gap significant after Holm correction. Back-translating the Hausa items into English recovers between half and two-thirds of the gap for the two general-purpose models but not demonstrably for the medically adapted one, so the deficit is substantially, though not wholly, a matter of the language of presentation. Answers are also far less stable: agreement across three option orderings falls from \ConsEnQwen{} to \ConsHaQwen{} in the worst case. An exploratory error analysis of \ENRows{} discordant items attributes most of the damage to medical vocabulary lost in translation (\ETerm{}, 95\% CI \ETermLo{}--\ETermHi{}), usually in the question stem. A fourth registered hypothesis proposed closing the gap with self-generated preference pairs. Its pilot gate found nothing to train on: asked to reason in Hausa rather than to pick a letter, the model echoes the prompt back, switches into Swahili, or simply stops without answering; only \GateParse{} of chains are parseable. We report that intervention as not run, which is itself the sharper result -- a forced-choice benchmark cannot see a model that has no generative command of the language at all. All hypotheses, thresholds and decision rules were registered before any model was run, and all deviations are logged.

title: Savant: A Fast, Structure-Free Binding Affinity Predictor For Protein-Ligand Drug Screening
zh_title: Savant：无需结构的快速蛋白-配体结合亲和力预测器
summary: 提出仅用蛋白序列和配体线性文本表示估计解离常数的机器学习模型，旨在替代需 GPU 与较长时间的共折叠打分方法用于药物筛选。
key_points: 输入仅为氨基酸序列与配体文本表示
目标是快速、无需结构的亲和力预测
面向大规模候选分子筛选
reason: 药物发现方法预印本，摘要未见充分对比数据
abstract: Protein-ligand binding affinity determines which of many candidate molecules is worth synthesizing and assaying, making it the central measurement in early drug discovery. Binding affinity is commonly expressed as the dissociation constant, an equilibrium measure that indicates how easily a complex separates into its components. AI-based generative chemistry and make-on-demand chemical catalogs now produce molecules faster than rigorous method can evaluate them. Leading computational methods co-fold the complex before scoring the binding affinity between the protein and the ligand, which provides high accuracy but requires a graphics processing unit (GPU) and substantial time for every pair evaluated.Here we present Savant, a machine learning model that estimates the dissociation constant using only the protein's amino acid sequence and the ligand's structure written as a line of text (SMILES). Savant needs no 3-dimensional folded structure, no docking, and no GPU. To test Savant fairly, we built a benchmark designed to prevent any training data to leak into the testing set, drawing only on measurements published after the training data was assembled and on molecules chemically unlike anything the model had seen. On an independent benchmark, Savant ranks ahead of every other 3-dimensional structure-free method.Savant is designed to rank compounds against a single protein, and performs as well as other methods that require a GPU, while running only on a central processing unit (CPU). Thus, Savant can screen libraries of 100,000 compounds in minutes with commodity hardware.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质-配体结合亲和力决定了众多候选分子中哪些值得合成和检测，因此是早期药物发现中的核心测量指标。结合亲和力通常以解离常数表示，这是一种平衡测量指标，反映复合物分解为各组分的难易程度。基于人工智能的生成化学和按需合成化学品目录产生分子的速度，如今已超过严谨方法能够评估的速度。领先的计算方法在对蛋白质与配体之间的结合亲和力评分之前，先对复合物进行共折叠（co-fold），这虽然精度高，但每评估一对分子都需要图形处理器（GPU）和大量时间。在此，我们提出 Savant，这是一种机器学习模型，仅利用蛋白质的氨基酸序列和以一行文本（SMILES）书写的配体结构来估计解离常数。Savant 不需要三维折叠结构，不需要对接，也不需要 GPU。为了公平地测试 Savant，我们构建了一个旨在防止任何训练数据泄漏到测试集的基准，仅使用训练数据汇集之后发表的测量结果，以及在化学上与模型所见过的任何分子均不相似的分子。在一个独立基准上，Savant 的排名领先于所有其他不依赖三维结构的方法。Savant 旨在针对单一蛋白质对化合物进行排序，其表现与其他需要 GPU 的方法相当，而仅在中央处理器（CPU）上运行。因此，Savant 可在普通硬件上于数分钟内筛选包含 100,000 个化合物的库。

title: Sequence-based models predict TF binding with negligible contributions from motif cooperativity
zh_title: 序列模型预测转录因子结合：基序协同作用贡献可忽略
summary: 利用约2000个ENCODE转录因子结合谱训练的BPNet模型评估基序协同性，发现其对全基因组结合预测贡献可忽略（预印本）。
key_points: 基于约2000个ENCODE TF谱的BPNet
个别位点可检出协同但全局贡献小
模型可区分基序相似TF的结合偏好
reason: 大规模数据的基础生物学分析，预印本，有新见解
abstract: How transcription factors (TFs) selectively recognize their genomic targets among numerous sites containing similar DNA motifs remains an open question. Cooperative binding at neighboring motif sites is widely considered a key mechanism of TF specificity, yet its genome-wide contribution remains unclear. Machine learning models can now predict TF binding directly from DNA sequence, providing opportunities to investigate its underlying determinants. Here, we leveraged BPNet models trained on ~2,000 ENCODE TF binding profiles to systematically assess motif cooperativity. Although detected at individual loci, cooperativity made a negligible contribution to genome-wide binding predictions. Nevertheless, the models captured differences in binding preferences between TFs with similar motif preferences, even within the same cellular environment. These findings highlight the need to critically assess prevailing assumptions and explore alternative mechanisms underlying selective TF binding.
zh_abstract: 转录因子（TF）如何在大量含有相似DNA基序的位点中选择性识别其基因组靶点，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。在相邻基序位点上的协同结合被广泛认为是TF特异性的关键机制，但其在全基因组范围内的贡献仍不清楚。机器学习模型现在可以直接从DNA序列预测TF结合，为研究其潜在决定因素提供了机会。在此，我们利用基于约2,000个ENCODE TF结合谱训练的BPNet模型，系统评估了基序协同性。尽管在个别位点可检测到协同性，但其对全基因组结合预测的贡献可忽略不计。然而，即使在相同的细胞环境中，这些模型仍能捕捉到具有相似基序偏好的TF之间在结合偏好上的差异。这些发现凸显了有必要批判性地审视现有假设，并探索选择性TF结合背后的其他机制。

title: Uncertainty-aware longitudinal prediction of multiple adverse pregnancy outcomes
zh_title: 多种不良妊娠结局的不确定性感知纵向预测
summary: 基于nuMoM2b队列9289名初产妇的二次分析，用逻辑回归与Mondrian共形预测在多次产检中预测五类妊娠结局，评估既往预测是否增加信息（预印本）。
key_points: 多中心队列，9289名初产妇
共形预测输出低危/高危/需复核
检验历史预测是否增加信息
reason: 大样本多中心队列二次分析，方法较传统，预印本
abstract: Risk of pregnancy complications is reassessed at each antenatal visit, but whether earlier predictions add information beyond the most recent one is unclear. Classifying every prediction as low or high risk can leave uncertainty unexpressed. Whether reliability per visit holds across visits is also unclear. This secondary analysis included 9289 nulliparous women from the nuMoM2b cohort (eight US centres, 2010-2013). Logistic regression models predicted gestational diabetes, pre-eclampsia, preterm birth, suspected fetal growth restriction and large for gestational age at 6-13, 16-21 and 22-29 weeks (Visits 3). Mondrian conformal prediction reported 'no' (low risk), 'yes' (high risk), or both (review). To test whether prediction history adds information beyond the Visit 3 prediction, we compared, among women classified as high risk at Visit 3, those first classified as high risk at Visit 2 or 3 (emerging high) with those classified as high risk at all three visits (persistent high), adjusting for Visit 3 predicted probability. The adjusted proportion with the outcome was higher in the emerging-high than the persistent-high group, by 6.1 percentage points for large for gestational age (95% CI -0.4 to 12.2) and 3.8 percentage points for suspected fetal growth restriction (-0.9 to 8.1). Other outcomes showed adjusted differences close to zero. With conformal prediction calibrated to a 90% level at each visit, the reported answers included the actual outcome in 89.6-90.6% of women at each visit (coverage). Coverage decreased when each woman's three visits were considered together (79.0-85.4%). For fetal growth outcomes, how a woman's predicted risk evolved during pregnancy may add information beyond her Visit 3 prediction. For repeated clinical use, the target coverage level should reflect the acceptable risk of incorrect low- or high-risk classifications over a woman's follow-up and the clinical decisions supported at each visit.
zh_abstract: 每次产前检查时都会重新评估妊娠并发症的风险，但较早的预测是否能在最近一次预测之外提供额外信息尚不清楚。将每次预测都分类为低风险或高风险可能使不确定性无法表达。各次检查之间每次检查的可靠性是否保持一致也不清楚。这项二次分析纳入了nuMoM2b队列（美国八个中心，2010-2013年）的9289名初产妇。逻辑回归模型分别在6-13周、16-21周和22-29周（访视3）预测妊娠期糖尿病、子痫前期、早产、疑似胎儿生长受限和大于胎龄儿。Mondrian保形预测给出“否”（低风险）、“是”（高风险）或两者皆有（需复核）。为检验预测历史是否能在访视3的预测之外增加信息，我们在访视3被分类为高风险的女性中，比较了在访视2或访视3首次被分类为高风险者（新近高风险）与在全部三次访视均被分类为高风险者（持续高风险），并对访视3的预测概率进行了校正。校正后出现结局的比例在新近高风险组高于持续高风险组，大于胎龄儿高6.1个百分点（95% CI -0.4至12.2），疑似胎儿生长受限高3.8个百分点（-0.9至8.1）。其他结局的校正后差异接近于零。在每次访视均按90%水平校准的保形预测下，所报告的答案在每次访视时包含实际结局的女性比例为89.6-90.6%（覆盖率）。当综合考虑每位女性的三次访视时，覆盖率下降（79.0-85.4%）。对于胎儿生长相关结局，女性预测风险在孕期中的演变过程可能在其访视3预测之外增加信息。对于重复性的临床使用，目标覆盖水平应反映在女性随访期间对错误的低风险或高风险分类的可接受风险，以及每次访视所支持的临床决策。

title: Casanovo-TMT: deep learning-based de novo sequencing of TMTpro-labeled peptides and phosphopeptides
zh_title: Casanovo-TMT：TMTpro标记肽及磷酸肽的深度学习从头测序
summary: 在Casanovo基础上扩展TMTpro与磷酸化词表，用2100万谱图微调，在自有与两个公开数据集上取得较高肽段识别率。
key_points: 自有测试集精确肽型识别84.7%
两个公开数据集为87.4%与79.6%
未微调的扩展词表仅0.3%
reason: 有外部公开数据集验证的新方法预印本
abstract: De novo peptide sequencing reads peptides directly from tandem mass spectra, but none of the released deep learning models can sequence peptides labeled with isobaric tags such as TMTpro, which are widely used for multiplexed quantitative proteomics. We extended the residue vocabulary of Casanovo with TMTpro tags and phosphorylation, fine-tuned it on 21 million spectra from our laboratory, most of them TMTpro-labeled, and re-ranked the candidates in the beam by their agreement with the measured precursor mass. The resulting model, Casanovo-TMT, predicted the exact peptidoform for 84.7% of the TMTpro-labeled spectra in our test set and for 87.4 and 79.6% of the spectra in two public global-proteome datasets from other laboratories, whereas the extended vocabulary without fine-tuning gave 0.3%. Discarding the lowest-scoring predictions raised precision to 95% while retaining 81.7% of the test spectra. Casanovo-TMT also predicted the exact peptidoform for 69.2% of the spectra in a public phosphopeptide-enriched dataset and for 66 to 72% of the phosphopeptide spectra in three phosphoproteomic studies from our laboratory that were not used for training. In these studies, it identified numbers of phosphopeptides comparable to or larger than those of database search engines, and proportionally more where database search identified fewer. For the phosphopeptides identified only by Casanovo-TMT, entrapment estimated that more than 90% were correct, and an independent search engine assigned the same sequence to 95 to 98% of the spectra that it identified with confidence. Casanovo-TMT can therefore extend database search in TMTpro-based quantitative proteomics, particularly in studies in which database search identifies few phosphopeptides.
zh_abstract: 从头肽段测序可直接从串联质谱中读取肽段序列，但目前已发布的深度学习模型均无法对用等重标签（如TMTpro）标记的肽段进行测序，而TMTpro广泛用于多重定量蛋白质组学。我们在Casanovo的残基词表中加入了TMTpro标签和磷酸化修饰，使用来自本实验室的2,100万张谱图（其中大部分为TMTpro标记）对其进行微调，并根据候选结果与实测前体质量的一致程度对束搜索（beam）中的候选结果重新排序。由此得到的模型Casanovo-TMT在我们测试集中对84.7%的TMTpro标记谱图预测出了准确的肽型（peptidoform），在来自其他实验室的两个公开全蛋白质组数据集中分别为87.4%和79.6%，而仅扩展词表而不微调时仅为0.3%。剔除得分最低的预测结果后，精确度提高到95%，同时保留了81.7%的测试谱图。Casanovo-TMT还对一个公开的磷酸肽富集数据集中69.2%的谱图预测出了准确的肽型，并对本实验室三项未用于训练的磷酸化蛋白质组学研究中66%至72%的磷酸肽谱图预测出了准确的肽型。在这些研究中，它鉴定到的磷酸肽数量与数据库搜索引擎相当或更多，且在数据库搜索鉴定较少的情况下，所占比例相对更高。对于仅由Casanovo-TMT鉴定到的磷酸肽，诱捕（entrapment）分析估计超过90%是正确的；对于其有把握鉴定的谱图，独立搜索引擎对其中95%至98%给出了相同的序列。因此，Casanovo-TMT可扩展基于TMTpro的定量蛋白质组学中的数据库搜索，尤其适用于数据库搜索鉴定到磷酸肽较少的研究。

title: Medtronic announces FDA clearance of general surgery procedures for the Hugo robotic-assisted surgery system
zh_title: 美敦力 Hugo 手术机器人获 FDA 批准用于普外科手术
summary: 标题称美敦力宣布 Hugo 机器人辅助手术系统获 FDA 批准用于普外科术式；仅有标题，细节未知。

title: Evaluation of System One Models on Biomedical Texts
zh_title: System One模型在生物医学文本上的评估
summary: 比较三种System One模型与三种通用大模型在七个数据集、八个终点上的表现与成本，并评估基于置信度的路由。
key_points: Claude Opus 5.5在全部八个终点表现最佳
最强SOM（Jev）性能有竞争力，成本多低于Opus的1%
SOM到LLM路由可降低成本
reason: 有基线对比的评测预印本，但证据有限
abstract: Objective To compare the performance and cost of System One models (SOMs) with general-purpose large language models (LLMs) on biomedical tasks and evaluate confidence-based routing. Materials and Methods We evaluated three SOMs and three LLMs across seven datasets and eight endpoints covering question answering, error detection, structured extraction, and clinical-note assessment. Outcomes included task-specific performance, recorded inference cost and latency, and confidence calibration. Calibration data determined routing schemes and confidence thresholds to evaluate test predictions, with cost-matched random referral as a comparator. Results Claude Opus 5.5 had the highest primary performance on all eight endpoints. The strongest SOM, Jev, had competitive performance with the evaluated LLMs and cost less than 1% of Opus on most datasets. Three selected SOM-to-LLM routes reduced costs by 30.0%-71.7% relative to the receiving LLM, with modest reductions in performance. On one benchmark, SOM-to-SOM routing achieved 91.1% accuracy, compared with 82.3% and 82.2% for the individual models. Discussion SOMs offered favorable performance-cost tradeoffs for most tasks. The magnitude of the advantages depended on task structure and prompting requirements. Confidence-based routing between SOMs and LLMs can leverage complementary model strengths and offers additional flexibility in performance-cost tradeoffs. The price advantages offered by SOMs can facilitate experimentation and development of workflows. This warrants further evaluation on closed datasets. Conclusion For biomedical tasks with predefined choices, SOMs represent a competitive stand-alone or first-stage approach.
zh_abstract: 【目的】比较System One模型（SOM）与通用大语言模型（LLM）在生物医学任务上的性能和成本，并评估基于置信度的路由。【材料与方法】我们在七个数据集、八个终点上评估了三个SOM和三个LLM，任务涵盖问答、错误检测、结构化提取和临床记录评估。结局指标包括特定任务性能、记录的推理成本和延迟，以及置信度校准。利用校准数据确定路由方案和置信度阈值以评估测试预测，并以成本匹配的随机转诊作为对照。【结果】Claude Opus 5.5在全部八个终点上均取得最高的主要性能。最强的SOM Jev与所评估的LLM性能相当，且在大多数数据集上成本不到Opus的1%。三条选定的SOM到LLM路由相对于接收端LLM将成本降低了30.0%–71.7%，性能仅有小幅下降。在一项基准上，SOM到SOM路由的准确率为91.1%，而单个模型分别为82.3%和82.2%。【讨论】SOM在大多数任务上提供了有利的性能–成本权衡。优势的大小取决于任务结构和提示要求。SOM与LLM之间基于置信度的路由可以利用模型间的互补优势，并为性能–成本权衡提供更多灵活性。SOM的价格优势可促进工作流程的试验与开发。这一点值得在封闭数据集上进一步评估。【结论】对于具有预定义选项的生物医学任务，SOM是一种有竞争力的独立方法或第一阶段方法。

title: statLens enables accurate and interpretable statistical intelligence
zh_title: statLens：准确且可解释的统计智能框架
summary: statLens整合大模型、代码与人工审核，在六种组学模态的102项差异表达任务上准确率达92.5–95.0%，高于仅用LLM的17.5–46.8%。
key_points: 102项任务、74个数据集、六种组学模态
七种语言模型下准确率稳定在92.5–95.0%
小模型准确率提升至92.5–94.4%
reason: 有清晰方法与基线对比的预印本，属值得一看档
abstract: Diverse existing approaches and analyses of large-scale biomedical omics datasets along with the complexity of the corresponding statistical analytical workflows pose challenges to the direct application of large language models (LLMs) to data analysis tasks. We present statLens, a model-agnostic AI-driven statistical intelligence framework that integrates LLMs, code and human review. We demonstrate statLens using differential expression analysis across heterogeneous biomedical data as a use case. On 102 benchmark tasks from 74 datasets across six omics modalities, statLens maintained consistently high accuracy (92.5--95.0%) across seven language models and outperformed LLM-only inference (17.5--46.8%), whereas autonomous-agent accuracy varied widely (58.7--99.5%). We also showed that statLens substantially improved the accuracy of the four small language models (92.5--94.4%) over autonomous agents (58.7--92.2%) and LLM-only inference (17.5--43.5%). By decomposing analytical workflows into complementary tasks for code, LLMs and human experts, statLens provides an integrated framework for more accurate, interpretable and reproducible AI-assisted data analysis, particularly in complex omics settings.
zh_abstract: 现有的大规模生物医学组学数据集的方法和分析多种多样，相应统计分析流程又十分复杂，这为将大语言模型（LLM）直接应用于数据分析任务带来了挑战。我们提出statLens，一种与模型无关、由AI驱动的统计智能框架，整合了LLM、代码和人工审核。我们以跨异质生物医学数据的差异表达分析为用例展示statLens。在来自74个数据集、涵盖六种组学模态的102个基准任务上，statLens在七种语言模型上均保持了持续较高的准确率（92.5–95.0%），优于仅使用LLM推理（17.5–46.8%），而自主智能体的准确率差异很大（58.7–99.5%）。我们还表明，statLens显著提高了四种小语言模型的准确率（92.5–94.4%），高于自主智能体（58.7–92.2%）和仅使用LLM推理（17.5–43.5%）。通过将分析流程分解为分别由代码、LLM和人类专家承担的互补任务，statLens提供了一个整合的框架，使AI辅助数据分析更准确、可解释且可重复，尤其适用于复杂的组学场景。

title: Deciphering the Biological Function of Tandem Mass Spectra Using a Dual-Modal Metabolite Language Model
zh_title: 双模态代谢物语言模型从串联质谱推断生物功能
summary: 预印本提出Spec2Function，用谱图-文本对训练的双编码器模型，无需结构鉴定即可从MS2谱推断生物功能。
key_points: 针对未鉴定代谢特征的“功能暗物质”
核心为Spec2Biotext双编码器
推理时无需先验结构注释
reason: 新颖方法预印本，摘要信息有限
abstract: Liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry untargeted metabolomics captures thousands of metabolic peaks from biological samples. Conventional identification-dependent metabolomics workflows require confident structural annotation before identified features can enter downstream pathway or functional analysis. However, only a small fraction of detected metabolic features can be assigned confident structural annotations, leaving a large fraction difficult to incorporate into downstream biological interpretation, a form of "functional dark matter". Here, we introduce Spec2Function, a function-centric framework that infers biological functions from tandem mass spectrometry (MS2) spectra. Spec2Function is trained using characterized spectrum-text pairs but does not require prior structural identification of the query spectra at inference time. At its core is Spec2Biotext, a dual-encoder contrastive model that embeds MS2 spectra and curated multi-aspect natural language functional texts into a unified functional space. Combined with a retrieval-augmented generation framework grounded in curated databases and biomedical literature, Spec2Function retrieves evidence-grounded biological knowledge and produces coherent functional summaries for individual spectra or groups of spectra. Across metabolite- and pathway-level benchmarks, Spec2Function achieved higher similarity to reference functional descriptions than the evaluated comparators and expanded the fraction of the metabolome accessible to functional interpretation. Application to a human liver cirrhosis cohort recapitulated known metabolic alterations and identified additional literature-supported functional modules. Applying Spec2Function to a 30-organ macaque aging atlas revealed organ-specific metabolic functions and previously unreported functional modules that were supported by independent human and mouse datasets. Together, these results position Spec2Function as a function-centric framework for scalable biological interpretation of structurally unannotated MS2 spectra.
zh_abstract: 液相色谱-串联质谱非靶向代谢组学可从生物样本中捕获数千个代谢峰。传统依赖鉴定的代谢组学流程要求先对结构进行可靠注释，已鉴定的特征才能进入下游通路或功能分析。然而，所检测到的代谢特征中只有一小部分能够获得可靠的结构注释，导致大量特征难以纳入下游生物学解读，形成所谓的“功能暗物质”。在此，我们提出 Spec2Function，这是一个以功能为中心、可从串联质谱（MS2）谱图推断生物学功能的框架。Spec2Function 使用已表征的谱图-文本对进行训练，但在推断时无需事先对待查询谱图进行结构鉴定。其核心是 Spec2Biotext，一种双编码器对比学习模型，可将 MS2 谱图与经整理的多方面自然语言功能文本嵌入同一功能空间。结合基于经整理数据库和生物医学文献的检索增强生成框架，Spec2Function 能检索有证据支持的生物学知识，并为单个谱图或谱图组生成连贯的功能摘要。在代谢物水平和通路水平的基准测试中，Spec2Function 与参考功能描述的相似度高于所评估的对比方法，并扩大了可用于功能解读的代谢组比例。将其应用于人类肝硬化队列，重现了已知的代谢改变，并识别出更多有文献支持的功能模块。将 Spec2Function 应用于包含 30 个器官的猕猴衰老图谱，揭示了器官特异性的代谢功能以及此前未报道的功能模块，这些模块得到独立的人类和小鼠数据集的支持。总体而言，这些结果表明 Spec2Function 是一个以功能为中心、可对未注释结构的 MS2 谱图进行可扩展生物学解读的框架。

title: S-PLM-TM enables fast and accurate sequence-based search for remote homologs
zh_title: S-PLM-TM：基于序列的远缘同源蛋白快速搜索
summary: 预印本提出结构感知蛋白语言模型S-PLM-TM，仅凭序列检测远缘同源，称优于所测序列方法，结构分类上可比结构方法。
key_points: 跨模态流匹配与对比学习注入结构信息
轻量校准头支持冻结编码器下的结构相似性搜索
残基级对齐头可直接由序列生成结构比对
reason: 新方法有基线对比，但为预印本且信息有限，属值得一看档
abstract: Protein structures and functions can remain conserved after extensive sequence divergence, but detecting these distant relationships across large databases remains challenging. Here we present S-PLM-TM, a sequence-only remote homology search tool based on a structure-aware protein language model. Cross-modal flow matching and contrastive learning incorporate structural information into sequence representations. A lightweight calibration head enables structural-similarity search with the frozen encoder, while a residue-level alignment head generates structural alignments directly from sequence. S-PLM-TM outperforms the tested sequence-based methods in remote homology detection, rivals structure-based methods in structural classification and retrieves the most functionally consistent neighbors. It also retrieves distantly related enzymes with shared catalytic functions at a level comparable to the best-performing structure-based methods. In large-scale database search, S-PLM-TM achieves the highest average precision among both sequence-based and alignment-free methods, with speed approaching the fastest sequence-alignment tools. Together, these results establish S-PLM-TM as a practical tool that combines sensitive and biologically informative remote homology search with the speed required for database-scale retrieval.
zh_abstract: 蛋白质的结构与功能在序列发生大幅分歧后仍可保持保守，但在大型数据库中检测这些远缘关系仍具有挑战性。在此，我们提出 S-PLM-TM，一种基于结构感知蛋白质语言模型的、仅依赖序列的远缘同源性搜索工具。跨模态流匹配（flow matching）与对比学习将结构信息融入序列表征。一个轻量级校准头可借助冻结的编码器实现结构相似性搜索，而残基水平的比对头则可直接由序列生成结构比对。在远缘同源性检测方面，S-PLM-TM 优于所测试的基于序列的方法；在结构分类方面可与基于结构的方法相媲美；并能检索到功能一致性最高的近邻。它在检索具有共同催化功能的远缘相关酶方面，也达到了与表现最佳的基于结构的方法相当的水平。在大规模数据库搜索中，S-PLM-TM 在基于序列的方法和无比对方法中取得了最高的平均精确度，其速度接近最快的序列比对工具。综上，这些结果表明 S-PLM-TM 是一种实用工具，兼具灵敏且富含生物学信息的远缘同源性搜索能力，以及数据库规模检索所需的速度。

title: The Evolving Role of Artificial Intelligence in Facial Plastic Surgery: From Education and Research to EHR-Embedded Applications.
zh_title: 人工智能在面部整形外科中的角色演变：从教育科研到EHR嵌入应用
summary: 叙述性综述，梳理AI在面部整形外科教育、科研及含EHR嵌入工具的临床流程中的应用，并讨论负责任采用。
key_points: 涵盖内容生成、手术技能评估、面部测量、术前模拟、病历摘要等
现有证据多评估可行性与测量一致性，而非临床结局
幻觉、隐私、安全与偏倚需关注
reason: 叙述性综述，无新数据，属增量档且受综述上限约束
abstract: [Facial plastic surgery : FPS] Aims and Backgrounds Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly relevant to facial plastic surgery. This narrative review examines applications in education, research, and clinical workflows, including tools embedded in the electronic health record (EHR), and discusses responsible adoption. Technology Applications include educational content generation, surgical skill assessment, facial measurement, research assistance, preoperative simulation and planning, decision support, chart summarization, ambient documentation, and patient-message drafting. Agentic workflows could coordinate clinical tasks. Current and Future Development Available evidence primarily evaluates feasibility, content quality, measurement agreement, and workflow effects rather than improved clinical outcomes. Hallucinations, readability, privacy, safety, and bias require attention. Priorities include external validation, outcome assessment, and governance with continued monitoring as systems change. Conclusions and Clinical Relevance AI should augment surgeons, with oversight proportionate to clinical risk, protection of patient information, and assessment across patient groups. Its value should be judged by demonstrated improvements in clinical work, patient experience, and meaningful outcomes.
zh_abstract:
【背景】人工智能（AI）与面部整形外科的关系日益密切。本叙述性综述探讨了AI在教育、研究和临床工作流程中的应用，包括嵌入电子健康记录（EHR）的工具，并讨论了如何负责任地采用。
【技术应用】应用包括教育内容生成、手术技能评估、面部测量、研究辅助、术前模拟与规划、决策支持、病历摘要、环境式文档记录（ambient documentation）以及患者消息起草。具备自主能力的智能体（agentic）工作流程可协调临床任务。
【当前与未来发展】现有证据主要评估可行性、内容质量、测量一致性和工作流程影响，而非临床结局的改善。幻觉、可读性、隐私、安全和偏倚问题需要引起重视。优先事项包括外部验证、结局评估，以及随系统变化而持续监测的治理。
【结论与临床意义】AI应当辅助外科医生，监督力度应与临床风险相称，同时保护患者信息，并在不同患者群体中进行评估。其价值应以临床工作、患者体验和有意义结局的切实改善来衡量。

title: [Clinical Advances and Artificial Intelligence Applications in Bone Health Management in Children and Adolescents].
source: PubMed · Sichuan da xue xue bao. Yi xue ban = Journal of Sichuan University. Medical science edition
zh_title: 儿童青少年骨健康管理的临床进展与人工智能应用
summary: 综述儿童青少年骨健康管理的临床要点，强调需结合生长轨迹评估，并讨论人工智能在其中的应用。
key_points: 强调不能照搬成人诊断范式
评估需结合骨龄、青春期、体重等背景
涉及AI在骨健康管理中的应用
reason: 综述类，AI内容有限，信息泛化
abstract: [Sichuan da xue xue bao. Yi xue ban = Journal of Sichuan University. Medical science edition] Childhood and adolescence are critical windows for peak bone mass accrual, skeletal modeling, and the establishment of musculoskeletal function. During this period, unrecognized and untreated modifiable skeletal risk factors can progress to permanent structural skeletal disorders. Pediatric bone health management cannot rely on adult-derived diagnostic paradigms, nor should it be reduced to isolated metrics such as calcium intake, vitamin D status, and bone mineral density (BMD). Instead, all assessments must be interpreted in the context of each child's individual growth trajectory, integrating skeletal maturation, pubertal stage, weight status, motor function, comorbidities, and preexisting structural skeletal deformities. Contemporary clinical guidelines and consensus statements consistently emphasize that BMD testing, nutritional and exercise-related functional assessments, and skeletal deformity screening in pediatric populations must be guided by well-defined clinical indications and risk stratification. They explicitly caution against adult-centric result interpretation, indiscriminate testing, and one-off screening disconnected from longitudinal care. Despite these recommendations, notable gaps persist in routine clinical practice, including under-recognition of high-risk pediatric patients, fragmentation of the care continuum across screening, reassessment, and referral, suboptimal follow-up adherence, and marked variability in manual measurement reliability and imaging quality control. Artificial intelligence (AI) has demonstrated promising performance across multiple pediatric skeletal care domains, including bone age assessment, Cobb angle quantification, scoliosis population screening, hip ultrasound quality assurance, disease progression risk stratification, and longitudinal follow-up management. Nonetheless, its real-world clinical utility remains to be fully validated through large-scale multicenter trials and real-world evidence studies. This review synthesizes current evidence on standardized assessment protocols, AI-enabled clinical applications, and early identification strategies for common skeletal deformities in pediatric bone health. We further discuss actionable care pathways for risk stratification, cross-setting referral coordination, and continuous longitudinal care tailored to children and adolescents.
zh_abstract: [四川大学学报（医学版）] 儿童和青少年期是获得峰值骨量、骨骼塑形以及建立肌肉骨骼功能的关键时期。在此期间，未被识别和未经治疗的可改变骨骼危险因素可发展为永久性的结构性骨骼疾病。儿童骨健康管理不能依赖源自成人的诊断模式，也不应简化为钙摄入量、维生素D状态和骨密度（BMD）等孤立指标。相反，所有评估都必须结合每名儿童个体的生长轨迹来解读，综合考虑骨骼成熟度、青春期分期、体重状况、运动功能、合并症以及既有的结构性骨骼畸形。现行临床指南和共识声明一致强调，儿科人群的BMD检测、营养及运动相关功能评估和骨骼畸形筛查必须以明确的临床适应证和风险分层为指导，并明确告诫应避免以成人为中心解读结果、不加区分的检测以及与纵向照护脱节的一次性筛查。尽管有这些建议，常规临床实践中仍存在明显差距，包括对高危儿科患者识别不足、筛查、复评和转诊等照护连续环节的碎片化、随访依从性欠佳，以及手工测量可靠性和影像质量控制存在显著差异。人工智能（AI）已在多个儿童骨骼照护领域展现出良好性能，包括骨龄评估、Cobb角量化、脊柱侧弯人群筛查、髋关节超声质量保证、疾病进展风险分层和纵向随访管理。然而，其真实世界临床效用仍有待大规模多中心试验和真实世界证据研究的充分验证。本综述总结了儿童骨健康中标准化评估方案、AI赋能的临床应用以及常见骨骼畸形早期识别策略的现有证据。我们还讨论了面向儿童和青少年的风险分层、跨场景转诊协调和持续纵向照护的可行照护路径。

title: Using a Large Language Model Chatbot for Allergen Avoidance Counseling in Contact Dermatitis: Quantitative Evaluation Study.
zh_title: 用GPT-4聊天机器人为接触性皮炎提供过敏原回避咨询
summary: 研究评估GPT-4针对30类过敏原推荐无过敏原产品的表现，由皮肤科医生对回答分类。

abstract: [JMIR dermatology] AI is increasingly impacting health care. Large language models (LLMs), such as ChatGPT, have shown potential in supporting clinical decision-making. However, their application in dermatology, particularly in allergen avoidance counseling for contact dermatitis, remains underexplored. This study aimed to demonstrate a potential use case for LLM responses in recommending allergen-free products for the management of contact allergies. A total of 30 allergen groups included in the international standard patch test were assessed. ChatGPT (GPT-4) was used in this study from September 2023 to January 2024. For each allergen, ChatGPT was tasked with recommending 5 allergen-free products using 3 question formats of varying complexity. Responses were included if they specified a product and were manually classified by dermatologists into 5 categories: valid, invalid, cross-reaction, unknown, and unresponsive. ChatGPT provided 79.20% (1782/2250) valid responses, with 1.78% (40/2250) classified as invalid, 2% (45/2550) classified as cross-reactions, 8.67% (195/2250) classified as unknown, and 8.36% (188/2250) classified as unresponsive. The simplest question format yielded the highest proportion of valid recommendations (640/750, 85.33%). ChatGPT performed best when recommending cosmetics (1233/1365, 90.33%) and medications (198/240, 82.5%). However, lower validity rates were observed for recommendations involving certain sensitive allergens, including fragrance mixes and para-phenylenediamine (PPD), with frequent cross-reactive recommendations related to Peru balsam. The version of ChatGPT evaluated in this study showed potential as a supplementary tool for allergen avoidance counseling. However, its recommendations require verification and should not replace clinician guidance or established allergen avoidance resources.
zh_abstract: [JMIR dermatology] 人工智能对医疗保健的影响日益增大。ChatGPT 等大语言模型（LLMs）已显示出支持临床决策的潜力。然而，其在皮肤科的应用，尤其是在接触性皮炎的过敏原回避咨询方面，仍未得到充分探索。本研究旨在展示 LLM 回答在为接触性过敏管理推荐无过敏原产品方面的潜在用途。研究评估了国际标准斑贴试验所含的 30 组过敏原。本研究于 2023 年 9 月至 2024 年 1 月使用 ChatGPT（GPT-4）。针对每种过敏原，要求 ChatGPT 使用 3 种复杂程度不同的提问格式推荐 5 种无过敏原产品。若回答指明了具体产品则纳入，并由皮肤科医生手动分为 5 类：有效、无效、交叉反应、未知和无回应。ChatGPT 给出 79.20%（1782/2250）的有效回答，其中 1.78%（40/2250）被归为无效，2%（45/2550）为交叉反应，8.67%（195/2250）为未知，8.36%（188/2250）为无回应。最简单的提问格式产生的有效推荐比例最高（640/750，85.33%）。ChatGPT 在推荐化妆品（1233/1365，90.33%）和药物（198/240，82.5%）时表现最佳。然而，在涉及某些致敏性较强的过敏原（包括香料混合物和对苯二胺（PPD））的推荐中，有效率较低，且与秘鲁香脂相关的交叉反应推荐较为频繁。本研究所评估的 ChatGPT 版本显示出作为过敏原回避咨询辅助工具的潜力。然而，其推荐需要核实，不应取代临床医生的指导或已建立的过敏原回避资源。

title: Artificial intelligence-based finish-line detection and margin-related accuracy in fixed prosthodontic digital workflows: A systematic review and functional meta-synthesis.
source: PubMed · The Journal of prosthetic dentistry
zh_title: 固定修复数字工作流中AI终止线检测的系统综述
summary: 系统综述评估AI在固定修复中终止线检测、边缘提取及边缘相关精度的证据，并按功能角色进行meta综合。
key_points: 检索PubMed、Scopus、Embase
纳入AI/机器学习/深度学习研究
证据存在异质性
reason: 牙科细分领域综述，证据异质，增量档
abstract: [The Journal of prosthetic dentistry] Artificial intelligence (AI) has been increasingly incorporated into fixed prosthodontic digital workflows, but evidence regarding finish-line detection, margin handling, and margin-related crown accuracy remains heterogeneous. The purpose of this systematic review was to evaluate AI-based finish-line detection, margin-line extraction, and margin-related accuracy in tooth-supported fixed prosthodontic workflows using a functional meta-synthesis. The PubMed, Scopus, and Embase databases were searched through May 2026. Studies evaluating AI, machine learning, or deep learning for finish-line detection, margin extraction, crown design, margin-aware crown generation, or margin-related accuracy were included. Findings were synthesized according to the functional role of AI, and risk of bias and applicability were assessed using an adapted quality framework. A total of 17 studies were included. AI demonstrated measurable performance for margin detection and supported crown-design workflows, frequently reducing design time. Marginal and internal adaptation were generally clinically acceptable or comparable with conventional workflows, although superiority was inconsistent. Quantitative pooling was precluded by substantial methodological and outcome heterogeneity. AI showed technical feasibility for margin-sensitive fixed prosthodontic workflows, but current evidence remains heterogeneous, predominantly early-stage, and insufficient to establish consistent clinical superiority.
zh_abstract: [The Journal of prosthetic dentistry] 人工智能（AI）越来越多地被纳入固定修复的数字化工作流程，但关于终止线检测、边缘处理以及与边缘相关的牙冠精度的证据仍存在异质性。本系统评价的目的是采用功能性元综合（functional meta-synthesis），评估基于 AI 的终止线检测、边缘线提取以及牙支持式固定修复工作流程中与边缘相关的精度。检索了截至 2026 年 5 月的 PubMed、Scopus 和 Embase 数据库。纳入评估 AI、机器学习或深度学习用于终止线检测、边缘提取、牙冠设计、边缘感知牙冠生成或与边缘相关精度的研究。根据 AI 的功能角色对结果进行综合，并使用改编的质量框架评估偏倚风险和适用性。共纳入 17 项研究。AI 在边缘检测方面显示出可测量的性能，并支持牙冠设计工作流程，常可缩短设计时间。边缘适合性和内部适合性总体上在临床上可接受，或与传统工作流程相当，但优越性并不一致。由于方法学和结局存在显著异质性，无法进行定量合并。AI 在对边缘敏感的固定修复工作流程中显示出技术可行性，但目前证据仍然存在异质性，主要处于早期阶段，不足以确立一致的临床优越性。

title: A Large Language Model Content Analysis of a National Plastic Surgery Residency Advice Library.
source: PubMed · The Journal of surgical research
zh_title: 大模型分析整形外科住院医师申请建议库
summary: 用Claude Opus对美国整形外科教育者协会的申请建议录音转写后提取并编码建议内容，并与两名研究者的人工编码对比。
key_points: 转写79场会话，74场含匹配建议
模型编码主题、可操作性与资源需求
250句分层样本与人工对照
reason: 医学教育文本分析，单一场景，增量档
abstract: [The Journal of surgical research] Integrated plastic surgery is a small, competitive field in which guidance travels through mentors and home programs, and published evidence comes largely from program-director surveys. The American Council of Educators in Plastic Surgery maintains a free library of recorded application-advice sessions that has not previously been systematically quantified. Eligible sessions published between April 2020 and July 2026 were transcribed, and speaker roles were identified. Recommendations were extracted and coded for topic, advice pattern, actionability, and resource requirements using Claude Opus 5. A stratified 250-sentence sample was coded by two investigators. The actionability rule was revised after an audit and all units were recoded by the model, the human comparison used labels from the original rule. Seventy-four of 79 sessions provided match advice (63.2 h), yielding 8069 model-extracted recommendations; 70.5% were actionable. Actionability among advice sentences identified by the two human coders was 48.6%-63.4%, a descriptive sample range rather than a corrected corpus estimate. Actionable advice was more likely to be detected, which may increase its proportion in the model-extracted set. Personal-statement guidance emphasized self-presentation, general-strategy guidance emotional well-being, and mentorship guidance advocacy. Resource requirements affected 12.4% of recommendations. At the precondition-instance level, 722 assumptions of access versus 106 alternatives yielded a ratio of 6.8:1 (95% confidence interval, 5.60-8.76). The American Council of Educators in Plastic Surgery library covers multiple stages of the application process and includes advice that depends on resources applicants may not have. Guidance within this library should offer practical alternatives when recommended strategies require mentorship, money, or home-program access.
zh_abstract: [外科研究杂志（The Journal of surgical research）] 整合式整形外科是一个规模小、竞争激烈的领域，指导信息通过导师和所在项目传递，已发表的证据主要来自项目主任调查。美国整形外科教育者委员会（American Council of Educators in Plastic Surgery）维护着一个免费的申请建议录音课程库，此前尚未被系统量化。对2020年4月至2026年7月间发布的符合条件的课程进行了转录，并识别了发言者角色。使用Claude Opus 5提取建议，并就主题、建议模式、可操作性和资源需求进行编码。由两名研究者对分层抽取的250个句子样本进行编码。在一次审核后修订了可操作性规则，并由模型对所有单元重新编码，人工比较使用的是原规则下的标签。79个课程中有74个提供了匹配（match）建议（63.2小时），共产生8069条模型提取的建议；其中70.5%具有可操作性。由两名人工编码者识别的建议句子中，可操作性为48.6%–63.4%，这是描述性的样本范围，而非校正后的语料库估计值。可操作的建议更容易被检出，这可能提高其在模型提取集中的比例。个人陈述方面的指导强调自我呈现，一般策略方面的指导强调情绪健康，导师指导方面的指导强调倡导。资源需求影响了12.4%的建议。在前提条件实例层面，722条假定具备相应条件，106条提供替代方案，比值为6.8:1（95%置信区间，5.60–8.76）。美国整形外科教育者委员会的课程库涵盖申请过程的多个阶段，其中包含依赖申请者可能不具备的资源的建议。当推荐策略需要导师指导、资金或所在项目资源时，该库内的指导应提供切实可行的替代方案。

title: Evaluation of an Artificial Intelligence-based Monitoring Technique for Measuring Oral Hygiene during Orthodontic Therapy.
zh_title: AI监测技术评估正畸治疗期间口腔卫生
summary: 44例正畸患者分两组，使用Dental Monitoring AI口内扫描监测的试验组牙龈炎症和菌斑评分显著下降。
key_points: 44例患者，每组22例
试验组使用Scanbox口内扫描监测
牙龈炎症与菌斑评分下降
reason: 单中心小样本，增量档，无外部验证
abstract: [Annals of African medicine] Good oral hygiene is mandatory for orthodontic patients. This study was done for evaluating how well an artificial intelligence (AI)-based supervising system could improve oral hygiene during orthodontic procedures. A total of 44 patients who were undergoing for permanent orthodontic procedures were split into two groups of 22 each: Group I as the control, and Group II as the AI monitoring test group. The test group's patients were instructed to get routine intraoral scans using Scanbox (Dental Monitoring®). For all groups, the Orthodontic Plaque Index and Marginal Gingival Index (MGI) were measured at baseline (T0), 2 weeks later (T1, T2, and T3, respectively), and at 3 months (T4). A statistical analysis was performed on the collected data. Subjects in the test group showed a considerable decrease in gingival inflammation and plaque score in contrast to the control group. Plaque and gingival irritation are reduced during orthodontic treatment when a remote monitoring system is used. By using this technique, patients are able to maintain the greatest possible dental health.
zh_abstract: [非洲医学年鉴]良好的口腔卫生对正畸患者而言是必不可少的。本研究旨在评估基于人工智能（AI）的监督系统在正畸治疗过程中改善口腔卫生的效果。共44例接受固定正畸治疗的患者被分为两组，每组22例：第一组为对照组，第二组为AI监测试验组。试验组患者被要求使用Scanbox（Dental Monitoring®）进行常规口内扫描。所有组均在基线（T0）、2周后（分别为T1、T2和T3）以及3个月时（T4）测量正畸菌斑指数和边缘龈指数（MGI）。对所收集的数据进行了统计学分析。与对照组相比，试验组受试者的牙龈炎症和菌斑评分显著下降。使用远程监测系统可减少正畸治疗期间的菌斑和牙龈刺激。通过这一技术，患者能够尽可能保持最佳的口腔健康。

title: DynSurvX: Time-Resolved Explanations for Dynamic Survival Predictions
zh_title: DynSurvX：动态生存预测的时间分辨解释
summary: 提出基于 Shapley 值的模型无关解释框架，为含静态与纵向协变量的动态生存预测提供随时间演变的解释。
key_points: 分层两阶段策略降低计算成本
解释随新患者数据更新
在模拟数据和两个临床数据集上实验
reason: 可解释性新方法，预印本，验证有限
abstract: Recent survival models integrating longitudinal data achieve strong predictive performance, but their predictions are often difficult to interpret, limiting their clinical use. We propose DynSurvX, a model-agnostic explainability framework for dynamic survival prediction with mixed static and longitudinal covariates. Based on Shapley values, DynSurvX introduces a hierarchical two-phase strategy that first identifies influential longitudinal features and then adaptively refines their temporal importance, enabling fine-grained explanations while reducing computational cost. The framework provides time-resolved explanations that evolve as new patient data become available. Experiments on simulated and two clinical datasets show varying agreement with theoretical importance across prediction models, with closer agreement for better-performing models, alongside clinically interpretable insights in real-world settings. It remains robust across prediction settings and reduces computation time by 41--80\% relative to the temporal explanation baseline, making dynamic explanations practical.
zh_abstract: 近期整合纵向数据的生存模型取得了很强的预测性能，但其预测往往难以解释，限制了临床应用。我们提出DynSurvX，一种面向包含静态与纵向协变量的动态生存预测的、与模型无关的可解释性框架。DynSurvX基于Shapley值，引入分层的两阶段策略：首先识别有影响的纵向特征，然后自适应地细化其时间重要性，从而在降低计算成本的同时实现细粒度解释。该框架提供随新患者数据出现而演变的、随时间分辨的解释。在模拟数据和两个临床数据集上的实验表明，不同预测模型与理论重要性的一致程度各异，性能更好的模型一致性更高，同时在真实场景中得到了具有临床可解释性的见解。该框架在不同预测设置下保持稳健，与时间解释基线相比计算时间减少41-80%，使动态解释具有实用性。

title: Fix, Don't Retake: Physics-Simulated Training for Correcting Patient Positioning Errors in Dental Panoramic Radiographs
zh_title: 物理模拟训练纠正牙科全景片体位错误
summary: 用CBCT生成的物理模拟配对数据，比较五种方法纠正全景片体位误差，U-Net及误差感知方法表现更优。
key_points: 物理模拟器由CBCT生成配对数据
比较U-Net、pix2pix、扩散等五种方法
U-Net与误差感知方法优于pix2pix和扩散
reason: 新意尚可，但为预印本且基于模拟数据，证据有限
abstract: Patient-positioning errors can distort panoramic radiographs and lead to repeat examinations. This study investigated artificial intelligence for correcting these errors in existing images. A physics-based simulator generated paired correctly positioned and mispositioned panoramics from cone-beam computed tomography volumes, with controlled individual and combined positioning errors. Five approaches were compared: U-Net, pix2pix, conditional diffusion, an error-conditioned model, and a mixture of error-specific specialists. Evaluation used image similarity and geometric metrics across three test sets. All approaches improved mean image similarity and reduced geometric errors, with U-Net and the two error-aware approaches outperforming pix2pix and conditional diffusion.
zh_abstract: 患者体位错误会使全景X线片失真，导致重复检查。本研究探讨了利用人工智能对现有图像中的这类错误进行校正。我们使用基于物理的模拟器，从锥形束计算机断层扫描体数据生成成对的体位正确与体位错误的全景片，并对单个及组合的体位错误加以控制。比较了五种方法：U-Net、pix2pix、条件扩散模型、以错误为条件的模型，以及由针对特定错误的专家组成的混合模型。在三个测试集上使用图像相似性和几何指标进行评估。所有方法均提高了平均图像相似性并减少了几何误差，其中U-Net和两种感知错误的方法优于pix2pix和条件扩散模型。

title: Generative Data Augmentation Without External Data: An Empirical and Theoretical Study on Deep Networks
zh_title: 无外部数据的生成式数据增强：深度网络的实证与理论研究
summary: 研究生成器仅用分类器自身训练集时，加入生成样本何时提升或降低测试精度，并给出超额风险界；实验含6个数据集（其中2个医学）。
key_points: 4种骨干、6个数据集、4种生成器
推导含总变差距离的超额风险界
仅2个数据集为医学数据
reason: 方法学研究，医学相关性有限，预印本，增量档
abstract: Generative data augmentation adds samples from generative models to a classifier's training set. Many influential studies use generators pre-trained on large external datasets, and so mix the value of synthetic data with knowledge transferred through pretraining. We study the case without external data, where each generator learns only from the classifier's own training set, and ask when and why adding generated samples to that training set raises or lowers the classifier's test accuracy. We train classifiers with four backbones on six datasets, two of them medical, adding samples from four generators. We bound the excess risk of a classifier trained with synthetic data, that is, how far its population risk can lie above the minimum risk within its hypothesis class. The bound charges synthetic data for the total variation distance between the real and generated distributions and credits synthetic data for a larger training set. The gain from adding synthetic data, the fall in population risk, is at most the excess risk of the real-only classifier, which trains on the real images alone. Read through the bound, the experiments suggest that synthetic data help most when our classifiers detect only a small discrepancy between the generated and real data and the real-only classifier has room to improve, and that synthetic data help little or hurt when the detected discrepancy is large. Generators with a larger lower bound on the total variation distance, a bound that we estimate from our own classifiers, tend to help less on five of the six datasets, and on the CIFAR datasets the most accurate backbone gains the least. The bound gives these directions but not the size of the largest gains, most of which traditional augmentation also reaches at the same number of optimizer steps.

title: Unsupervised Multi-modal Medical Image Registration via Invertible Translation
zh_title: 基于可逆翻译的无监督多模态医学图像配准
summary: 提出INNReg，用可逆神经网络做模态翻译并将多模态配准转为单模态配准，以保持几何一致性。
key_points: 图像翻译网络转为单模态
引入可逆网络保持几何一致
无监督配准方法
reason: 方法新但摘要未见充分验证，增量档
abstract: In medical imaging, the alignment of multi-modal images plays a critical role in providing comprehensive information for image-guided therapies. Despite its importance, multi-modal image registration poses significant challenges due to the complex and often unknown spatial relationships between different image modalities. To address this, we introduce a novel unsupervised translation-based multi-modal registration method, termed Invertible Neural Network-based Registration (INNReg). INNReg consists of an image-to-image translation network that converts multi-modal images into mono-modal counterparts and a registration network that uses the translated mono-modal images to align the multi-modal images. Specifically, to ensure the preservation of geometric consistency after image translation, we introduce an Invertible Neural Network (INN) that leverages a dynamic depthwise convolution-based local attention mechanism. Additionally, we design a novel barrier loss function based on Normalized Mutual Information to impose constraints on the registration network, which enhances the registration accuracy. The superior performance of INNReg is demonstrated through experiments on two public multi-modal medical image datasets, including MRI T1/T2 and MRI/CT pairs. The code is available at https://github.com/MeggieGuo/INNReg
zh_abstract: 在医学影像中，多模态图像的配准对于为影像引导治疗提供全面信息起着关键作用。尽管十分重要，但由于不同图像模态之间的空间关系复杂且往往未知，多模态图像配准面临重大挑战。为此，我们提出了一种新颖的基于翻译的无监督多模态配准方法，称为基于可逆神经网络的配准（Invertible Neural Network-based Registration，INNReg）。INNReg 包括一个将多模态图像转换为单模态对应图像的图像到图像翻译网络，以及一个利用翻译后的单模态图像对多模态图像进行对齐的配准网络。具体而言，为确保图像翻译后几何一致性得以保持，我们引入了一种利用基于动态深度卷积的局部注意力机制的可逆神经网络（INN）。此外，我们设计了一种基于归一化互信息的新型屏障损失函数，对配准网络施加约束，从而提高配准精度。在两个公开的多模态医学图像数据集（包括 MRI T1/T2 和 MRI/CT 配对数据）上的实验证明了 INNReg 的优越性能。代码可在 https://github.com/MeggieGuo/INNReg 获取。

title: Call-Efficient ICD-10 Code Prediction via Supervised Candidate Generation and Selective LLM Invocation
zh_title: ICD-10编码预测：监督候选生成与选择性调用LLM
summary: 提出结合嵌入、树模型候选生成、重排序与门控LLM辅助的ICD-10编码预测流程，减少LLM调用次数。
key_points: 防泄漏验证，锁定测试集评估
候选生成器Top-1准确率74.32%
Top-10候选覆盖率93.05%
reason: 增量方法，短文本编码任务，预印本且证据有限
abstract: Automatic assignment of ICD-10 codes from short clinical diagnosis text is a practical medical text classification and normalization task. The task is difficult because diagnosis phrases are short and noisy, the ICD-10 label space is hierarchical, and the class distribution is strongly imbalanced. This paper presents a call-efficient ICD-10 code prediction pipeline that combines transformer embeddings, tree-based supervised candidate generation, candidate-level reranking, and a gated LLM assistance. The evaluation uses a leakage-safe validation protocol: model and threshold selection are based on out-of-fold cross-validation predictions, while final reporting is performed on a locked test set with no shared source-file groups. The supervised conditional parent-code candidate generator reaches 74.32% Top-1 accuracy on the locked test set and 93.05% Top-10 candidate coverage. A direct zero-shot GPT-5.6-Sol baseline reaches 81.01% Top-1 accuracy, but requires an invocation of this large model for every diagnosis. The final deployable system, Pre-LLM fusion, reaches 81.24% OOF-CV accuracy and 83.19% locked-test accuracy while calling the LLM for only 31.97% of cases. This improves the locked-test error rate from 25.68% for the supervised parent-code baseline to 16.81%, corresponding to a 34.5% relative error reduction. The results show that the most effective role of the LLM is controlled reranking on uncertain examples rather than unrestricted coding or full-dataset invocation.

title: LeViT-UNet++: Towards Balanced Fine-Grained Details and Context for Efficient Medical Image Segmentation
zh_title: LeViT-UNet++：高效医学图像分割
summary: 提出结合Haar小波多尺度下采样的高效编码器-解码器，平衡细粒度细节与全局上下文，用于医学图像分割。
key_points: 引入HWMD模块分解高低频特征
面向低算力下的精度-效率权衡
摘要未给出具体结果
reason: 预印本方法改进，摘要信息有限，增量档
abstract: Efficient medical image segmentation is essential for clinical applications requiring fast and accurate delineation, such as surgical navigation, radiation therapy, and real-time image-guided intervention. Despite substantial advances in convolutional neural networks and Transformers, attaining high accuracy under limited computational resources remains difficult, because reducing model complexity often sacrifices fine-grained structural details and global context modeling, yielding an unfavorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off. To address this, we propose LeViT-UNet++, an efficient encoder-decoder architecture that better balances local detail preservation and global context modeling. Specifically, we introduce a Haar Wavelet Multi-Scale Downsampling (HWMD) module that decomposes feature representations into low- and high-frequency components to extract multi-scale structural information, thereby mitigating detail loss during downsampling. We further develop a depthwise convolution-based decoder that integrates multi-scale global representations from Transformer blocks with local spatial features, enabling progressive feature refinement while reducing computational overhead. Evaluated on four benchmarks (Synapse, ACDC, LA2018, and MSD Heart) under both 2D and 3D settings, LeViT-UNet++ achieves competitive accuracy with a compact parameter footprint and fast inference. On Synapse, for instance, it attains a DSC of 76.57% with only 8.025M parameters and 241.72 FPS, confirming a favorable accuracy-efficiency balance. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining wavelet-based multi-scale feature extraction with lightweight local-global feature fusion for efficient medical segmentation. The source code is available at https://github.com/apple1986/levit_unet_pp.
zh_abstract: 高效的医学图像分割对于需要快速而准确勾画的临床应用至关重要，例如手术导航、放射治疗和实时图像引导干预。尽管卷积神经网络和Transformer已取得显著进展，但在有限计算资源下实现高精度仍然困难，因为降低模型复杂度往往会牺牲精细的结构细节和全局上下文建模，导致精度与效率之间的权衡不佳。为此，我们提出了LeViT-UNet++，一种能更好平衡局部细节保留与全局上下文建模的高效编码器-解码器架构。具体而言，我们引入了Haar小波多尺度下采样（HWMD）模块，将特征表示分解为低频和高频分量以提取多尺度结构信息，从而减轻下采样过程中的细节损失。我们进一步开发了基于深度卷积的解码器，将来自Transformer模块的多尺度全局表示与局部空间特征相融合，在降低计算开销的同时实现逐步的特征细化。在四个基准数据集（Synapse、ACDC、LA2018和MSD Heart）上，在2D和3D设置下进行评估，LeViT-UNet++以紧凑的参数量和较快的推理速度取得了具有竞争力的精度。例如在Synapse上，仅用8.025M参数和241.72 FPS便获得了76.57%的DSC，证实了良好的精度-效率平衡。这些结果表明，将基于小波的多尺度特征提取与轻量级局部-全局特征融合相结合，对高效医学分割是有效的。源代码可在 https://github.com/apple1986/levit_unet_pp 获取。

title: Inventa: Decentralized Self-Improving Agents for Autonomous Scientific Discovery
zh_title: Inventa：用于自主科学发现的去中心化自改进智能体
summary: 提出由自主研究单元与经验证共享知识组成的LLM智能体框架，用于自动化科学发现，缓解想法趋同与无依据主张传播。
key_points: 各单元用mutator智能体演化候选想法
编排智能体在停滞时更换模型或重启
验证器记录已验证的改进
reason: 科学发现智能体方向，但摘要中医疗关联弱、证据有限
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can generate research ideas and improve scientific discovery through iterative experimentation. However, increasing the number of agents or iterations does not automatically translate to producing more diverse or feasible ideas. Agents may converge on similar candidates, propagate unsupported claims through shared memory components and repeatedly apply search strategies that no longer yield any improvements. We introduce Inventa, a framework for automated scientific discovery that employs autonomous research units and verified shared knowledge. Each unit creates a lineage of candidate ideas using a mutator agent. A local orchestrator agent periodically adapts the mutator's harness. When progress stalls, the orchestrator agent replaces its model or restarts the idea evolution process. Verifiers evaluate each candidate idea and record verified improvements, useful components and constraint violations in a shared knowledge, the only channel between units. We evaluate Inventa on five benchmarks spanning the research cycle, covering retrieval (ScholarCatalyst), ideation (IdeaBench), proposal writing (IdeaScientist), and scientific law discovery (EurekaBench, SciLaws-Bench). It leads all five, achieving 73.6% on EurekaBench versus 56.2% for CORAL. On IdeaBench, it discovers 26.0 novel ideas per paper, compared with 18.6 for ResearchAgent, with 82% fewer model calls.
zh_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体可以生成研究想法，并通过迭代实验促进科学发现。然而，增加智能体数量或迭代次数并不会自动带来更多样或更可行的想法。智能体可能收敛于相似的候选想法，通过共享记忆组件传播缺乏依据的论断，并反复使用已不再带来改进的搜索策略。我们提出 Inventa，一种采用自主研究单元和经验证的共享知识的自动化科学发现框架。每个单元利用变异智能体（mutator agent）构建候选想法谱系。局部编排智能体定期调整变异器的运行框架（harness）。当进展停滞时，编排智能体会更换其模型或重启想法演化过程。验证器评估每个候选想法，并将经验证的改进、有用组件和约束违反记录到共享知识中，该共享知识是各单元之间唯一的通道。我们在涵盖研究周期的五个基准上评估 Inventa，涉及检索（ScholarCatalyst）、构思（IdeaBench）、提案撰写（IdeaScientist）和科学定律发现（EurekaBench、SciLaws-Bench）。它在全部五项上领先，在 EurekaBench 上达到73.6%，而 CORAL 为56.2%。在 IdeaBench 上，它每篇论文发现26.0个新颖想法，而 ResearchAgent 为18.6个，且模型调用减少82%。

title: DAP-MR: Degradation-Aware Prompt-Magnitude Routing for Real-World Ultrasound Super-Resolution
zh_title: DAP-MR：面向真实超声超分辨的退化感知提示-强度路由
summary: 针对超声超分辨，提出以退化类型token与强度路由取代语义文本提示的方法，以缓解通用文本编码器的不匹配。
key_points: 语义提示在超声上不可靠，医学术语易被误解
每类退化用专用token表示，并在训练中适配
将退化类型与强度解耦以控制修复程度
reason: 超声复原方法增量，摘要无定量结果，属增量档
abstract: When super-resolution models designed for natural images are used on ultrasound scans, relying on semantic text prompts can lead to unreliable results. The tags these models generate often do not match the actual restoration needs, and specialized medical terms may be misunderstood by general-purpose text encoders. Instead, prompts focused on common image degradations are more directly useful for guiding restoration. However, using a single prompt to describe both the type and severity of image degradation can entangle these factors, making it hard for the model to know how strong the degradation is. To address this limitation, we introduce Degradation-Aware Prompt--Magnitude Routing (DAP-MR). Each degradation type is represented by a dedicated token initialized from the contextualized EOS embedding of a degradation-oriented prompt and subsequently adapted during ultrasound SR training. A separate magnitude router predicts a continuous, input-dependent magnitude that modulates the corresponding token. Thus, language provides a degradation-aware initialization for what should be restored, while magnitude routing supplies an explicit signal for how strongly it should influence restoration. DAP-MR can be added to both one-step and multi-step diffusion super-resolution frameworks without changing their core structures. Our experiments--on synthetic datasets with both in-domain and under anatomical-domain shift, as well as unpaired real-world ultrasound data--show that DAP-MR delivers better restoration quality and generalizes more consistently across different domains.
zh_abstract: 当为自然图像设计的超分辨率模型用于超声图像时，依赖语义文本提示可能导致结果不可靠。这些模型生成的标签往往与实际的复原需求不符，且专业医学术语可能被通用文本编码器误解。相反，聚焦于常见图像退化的提示对指导复原更为直接有用。然而，用单一提示同时描述图像退化的类型和严重程度，可能使这两个因素相互纠缠，导致模型难以判断退化的强度。为解决这一局限，我们提出退化感知提示-强度路由（DAP-MR）。每种退化类型由一个专用 token 表示，该 token 由面向退化的提示的上下文化 EOS 嵌入初始化，并在超声超分辨率训练期间进一步适配。一个独立的强度路由器预测一个随输入而变的连续强度值，用以调制相应的 token。因此，语言为“应复原什么”提供了退化感知的初始化，而强度路由则为“其对复原的影响应有多强”提供了明确的信号。DAP-MR 可添加到单步和多步扩散超分辨率框架中，而无需改变其核心结构。我们的实验——包括在域内及解剖域偏移下的合成数据集，以及未配对的真实超声数据——表明，DAP-MR 带来了更好的复原质量，并在不同域之间具有更一致的泛化能力。

title: Artificial intelligence in radiology education: from AI-supported learning to clinical innovation-a narrative review.
zh_title: 放射学教育中的AI：从辅助学习到临床创新的叙述性综述
summary: 叙述性综述梳理放射学AI教育现状，指出培训缺口，并讨论能力框架、课程模式及AI教学工具。
key_points: 25国调查中仅10.3%接受过正式AI培训

reason: 叙述性综述，教育方向，上限偏低
abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing diagnostic radiology, but education and training have not kept pace. This narrative review brings together current evidence on AI-supported learning in radiology education and how such learning can move into clinical innovation. Surveys from different countries point to the same gap: in a 25-country international survey of radiographers, radiologists, and students, only 10.3% had received formal AI training; in one national survey of Turkish residents, 84.5% had received none. The review maps competency frameworks and curriculum models that define AI literacy and support staged integration into residency. It also assesses AI as a teaching tool, including AI-assisted case-based learning, computer-aided diagnosis training, precision-education knowledge recommenders, and virtual, augmented, and extended reality. Controlled and randomized studies show measurable gains: computer-aided diagnosis training raised resident scores above self-study controls (mean score 52 vs. 38 on a 100-point scale), while an AI-based knowledge recommender shortened reporting time by 162 s per case and relative improvement in graded reporting accuracy scores of 14% (95% CI 8.1-19.8%). Large language models are promising but limited: GPT-4 approaches board-style examination performance (80.6%) yet remains poor at image-based reasoning (47.8%). The review closes by considering how education can feed clinical innovation, along with algorithmic and automation bias, ethical governance, and future research needs. AI education should therefore span the full continuum-from undergraduate training to continuing professional development-if radiology is to innovate safely, effectively, and equitably.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] 人工智能（AI）正在改变诊断放射学，但教育和培训尚未跟上步伐。本叙述性综述汇集了关于放射学教育中AI支持学习的现有证据，以及此类学习如何转化为临床创新。来自不同国家的调查显示出相同的差距：在一项涵盖25个国家的放射技师、放射科医生和学生的国际调查中，仅10.3%接受过正规AI培训；在一项土耳其住院医师的全国性调查中，84.5%未接受过任何培训。本综述梳理了界定AI素养并支持分阶段融入住院医师培训的能力框架和课程模式。同时评估了AI作为教学工具的应用，包括AI辅助的基于病例学习、计算机辅助诊断训练、精准教育知识推荐系统，以及虚拟、增强和扩展现实。对照研究和随机研究显示出可测量的收益：计算机辅助诊断训练使住院医师得分高于自学对照组（100分制下平均分52对38），而基于AI的知识推荐系统使每例报告时间缩短162秒，分级报告准确性评分相对提高14%（95% CI 8.1–19.8%）。大语言模型前景可期但存在局限：GPT-4在委员会式考试中的表现接近（80.6%），但在基于图像的推理方面仍较差（47.8%）。综述最后探讨了教育如何推动临床创新，以及算法偏倚和自动化偏倚、伦理治理和未来研究需求。因此，若放射学要安全、有效且公平地创新，AI教育应涵盖从本科培训到继续职业发展的整个连续体。

title: Artificial intelligence-enabled healthcare access and user experience: comparative institutional analysis and survey evidence from China.
zh_title: AI赋能医疗可及性与用户体验：中国制度比较与调查
summary: 比较中美欧AI医疗制度安排，并分析430份有效中国在线问卷；能力较低者报告更多进入与操作障碍。
key_points: 比较中美欧监管对象与责任分配
430份问卷通过注意力检查
低能力者障碍更大
reason: 政策比较加在线调查，样本有限，增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in public health] Regulatory entry and public experience describe different aspects of artificial intelligence-enabled healthcare access. This health policy study compares institutional arrangements in China, the United States, and the European Union, examines the coverage of equity-related evidence, and analyses an online Chinese survey. Of 480 submissions, 430 passed an attention check, including 32 respondents without reported functional contact and 398 entering the experience models. The institutional comparison identifies differences in regulatory objects, information recipients, and responsibility allocation. The coverage analysis distinguishes institutional information and hospital governance from measured portal use and service experience. In the survey, lower-capability respondents reported greater entry and operational barriers; 79 of 159 reported reducing or abandoning use because of barriers. Among contacted respondents, functional contact intensity was positively associated with perceived process ease (standardized β = 0.496), which was associated with perceived health-service responsiveness (standardized β = 0.381). The contact-by-capability interaction was negative (B = -0.254), contrary to the hypothesized direction. The findings highlight entry and operational barriers alongside differences in experience among existing users, supporting evaluation of both access conditions and service encounters.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in public health] 监管准入与公众体验反映了人工智能赋能的医疗服务可及性的不同方面。这项卫生政策研究比较了中国、美国和欧盟的制度安排，考察了与公平相关证据的覆盖情况，并分析了一项中国在线调查。在480份提交问卷中，430份通过了注意力检查，其中包括32名未报告功能性接触的受访者，以及398名纳入体验模型的受访者。制度比较发现了监管对象、信息接收者和责任分配方面的差异。覆盖情况分析将制度信息和医院治理与实测的门户使用及服务体验区分开来。在调查中，能力较低的受访者报告了更大的准入和操作障碍；159人中有79人报告因这些障碍而减少或放弃使用。在有接触经历的受访者中，功能性接触强度与感知的流程便利性呈正相关（标准化β = 0.496），而感知的流程便利性与感知的卫生服务响应性相关（标准化β = 0.381）。接触×能力的交互作用为负（B = -0.254），与假设方向相反。这些发现突出了准入和操作障碍，以及现有用户之间体验的差异，支持同时评估可及条件与服务接触过程。

zh_title: 急性卒中AI：葡萄牙国家医疗体系应用现状与启示

abstract: [Acta medica portuguesa] Acute stroke is a leading cause of death and long-term disability in Portugal. Rapid and accurate imaging is critical to guide acute stroke management, and artificial intelligence has shown growing potential to support triage, quantification, and therapeutic decision-making. This study aimed to characterize the current use of artificial intelligence in acute stroke imaging workflow in Portuguese public hospital neuroradiology departments, and to identify perceived benefits, implementation barriers and prospects. A descriptive, cross-sectional study was conducted using an online questionnaire distributed between January and April 2026 to neuroradiology departments of Portuguese public hospitals with stroke intervention units. The questionnaire covered department characterization, current use of artificial intelligence, and perceptions regarding future applications. Responses were analyzed descriptively. Ten hospitals from the North, Centre, Lisbon Metropolitan Area, South and insular regions were included. All operated under a stroke code protocol, used computed tomography as the first-line modality, and provided 24-hour neuroradiology coverage through a combined on-site and teleradiology model. Only two hospitals used dedicated artificial intelligence software, and one was in an implementation phase. Three additional centers used computational tools with artificial intelligence functionalities without identifying them as such. Prior contact with artificial intelligence was reported by 80% of respondents, and all anticipated its integration into routine practice. The most frequently cited applications were automated ASPECTS, core/penumbra quantification, large vessel occlusion identification and hemorrhage detection. Faster time-to-treatment and support for teleradiology workflows were the most perceived benefits. Opinions on funding were divided between the hospital institution and the state. Formal staff training was reported only by one center. Despite high awareness and a well-established organizational framework, adoption of artificial intelligence remains limited. Coordinated procurement strategies, structured training programs and shared operational definitions of artificial intelligence are needed to enable broader and more equitable integration into stroke care.
zh_abstract: [Acta medica portuguesa] 急性卒中是葡萄牙死亡和长期残疾的主要原因。快速、准确的影像学检查对指导急性卒中处置至关重要，人工智能在分诊、量化和治疗决策支持方面已显示出日益增长的潜力。本研究旨在描述葡萄牙公立医院神经放射科在急性卒中影像工作流程中使用人工智能的现状，并识别其感知获益、实施障碍和前景。本研究为描述性横断面研究，于2026年1月至4月向设有卒中干预单元的葡萄牙公立医院神经放射科发放在线问卷。问卷内容包括科室特征、人工智能的当前使用情况以及对未来应用的看法。对回复进行描述性分析。纳入了来自北部、中部、里斯本大都会区、南部及海岛地区的10家医院。所有医院均按卒中代码（stroke code）方案运行，以计算机断层扫描作为一线检查方式，并通过现场与远程放射学相结合的模式提供24小时神经放射科服务。仅有两家医院使用专用人工智能软件，另有一家处于实施阶段。另有三个中心使用了具有人工智能功能的计算工具，但并未将其认定为人工智能。80%的受访者报告既往接触过人工智能，且全部受访者预期其将融入常规实践。最常被提及的应用包括自动ASPECTS评分、核心/半暗带量化、大血管闭塞识别和出血检测。治疗时间缩短以及对远程放射学工作流程的支持是最受认可的获益。关于经费来源，意见在医院机构与国家之间存在分歧。仅有一个中心报告开展过正式的人员培训。尽管认知度较高且组织框架完善，人工智能的应用仍然有限。需要协调的采购策略、结构化的培训项目以及共同的人工智能操作性定义，以便在卒中诊疗中实现更广泛、更公平的整合。
