abstract: [American heart journal plus : cardiology research and practice] Cardiovascular disease (CVD) remains a leading cause of global morbidity and mortality despite major advances in pharmacological therapy, interventional cardiology, and lifestyle-based prevention. Although many current treatments reduce disease burden and improve outcomes, they often fail to address the underlying molecular and genetic mechanisms driving disease progression dot CRISPR hyphen-based gene- editing systems (Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats) have introduced the possibility of directly correcting, silencing, or modulating pathogenic genetic determinants involved in cardiovascular pathology. When integrated with artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled design, prediction, and optimization tools, an AI-guided CRISPR framework may assist in prioritizing editing strategies, predicting editing outcomes, and informing delivery design, although cardiovascular-specific validation of these applications remains limited. This narrative review examines the potential role of AI-guided CRISPR technologies in cardiovascular disease. It first outlines the major pathophysiologic mechanisms underlying CVD, then reviews molecular and genetic targets that may be amenable to editing. Current CRISPR applications in cardiometabolic and cardiovascular disorders are discussed, followed by an evaluation of how AI may support guide RNA design, off-target prediction, vector engineering, and therapeutic prioritization. Finally, major translational barriers are examined, including tissue-specific delivery, editing in non-dividing cells, long-term genomic safety, disease complexity, and regulatory implementation. Although early preclinical findings are encouraging, most cardiovascular applications remain in the experimental or early translational stage, and direct evidence for integrated AI-guided CRISPR applications in cardiovascular disease remains limited and largely preclinical. Progress in this field will depend on advances in delivery science, genome engineering, computational modelling, and long-term safety validation. AI-guided CRISPR should therefore be regarded as a developing precision medicine strategy with substantial future potential rather than an immediately deployable clinical solution.
zh_abstract: [American heart journal plus : cardiology research and practice] 尽管药物治疗、介入心脏病学和基于生活方式的预防取得了重大进展，心血管疾病（CVD）仍是全球发病和死亡的主要原因。虽然目前许多治疗可减轻疾病负担并改善结局，但往往无法针对驱动疾病进展的潜在分子和遗传机制。基于 CRISPR（成簇规律间隔短回文重复序列）的基因编辑系统使直接纠正、沉默或调控参与心血管病理的致病遗传决定因素成为可能。当与人工智能（AI）支持的设计、预测和优化工具相结合时，AI 引导的 CRISPR 框架可能有助于确定编辑策略的优先次序、预测编辑结果并为递送设计提供依据，不过这些应用在心血管领域的专门验证仍然有限。本叙述性综述探讨了 AI 引导的 CRISPR 技术在心血管疾病中的潜在作用。文章首先概述 CVD 的主要病理生理机制，然后回顾可能适合编辑的分子和遗传靶点。接着讨论 CRISPR 在心脏代谢及心血管疾病中的现有应用，并评估 AI 如何支持向导 RNA 设计、脱靶预测、载体工程和治疗优先级排序。最后，探讨主要的转化障碍，包括组织特异性递送、非分裂细胞中的编辑、长期基因组安全性、疾病复杂性以及监管实施。尽管早期临床前研究结果令人鼓舞，但大多数心血管应用仍处于实验或早期转化阶段，关于整合 AI 引导的 CRISPR 在心血管疾病中应用的直接证据仍然有限，且主要为临床前研究。该领域的进展将取决于递送科学、基因组工程、计算建模和长期安全性验证方面的进步。因此，AI 引导的 CRISPR 应被视为一种具有巨大未来潜力的、正在发展的精准医学策略，而非可立即部署的临床解决方案。

title: State-Message Interaction Adapter for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation
zh_title: 用于跨域小样本分割的状态-消息交互适配器
summary: 在冻结DINOv3中插入SMIA适配器，利用各注意力头消息与token状态交互，用于向医学或工业域的小样本分割迁移。
key_points: 冻结预训练注意力与FFN参数
按每个patch状态调节头消息更新
面向医学及工业跨域分割
reason: 通用方法预印本，医学为部分应用，摘要信息有限
abstract: Cross-domain few-shot segmentation adapts natural-image pretrained encoders to medical or industrial domains from a few pixel-annotated support masks. Within frozen DINOv3, intermediate per-head attention messages already carry target-background distinctions that baseline final-layer similarities and predictions do not consistently reflect. We propose the State-Message Interaction Adapter (SMIA) to learn how per-head messages should update each receiving token representation while keeping pretrained attention and FFN parameters frozen. Inserted right after per-head aggregation, SMIA conditions the transformation of each head's aggregated output (message) on each patch's pre-attention feature (state), allowing similar contextual messages to produce distinct or opposing updates depending on the receiving position. Because scarce support masks cover only limited state-message combinations, a shared low-rank bilinear map confines the learned interactions to low-dimensional state, message, and output subspaces. Added before each adapted block's frozen FFN, these updates yield adapted features that are refined by frozen FFNs and deeper blocks for linear readout. With only 0.51M trainable parameters and single-pass, support-free inference, SMIA achieves six-dataset mean mIoUs of 77.40% at 5 shots and 80.99% at 10 shots across 20 medical and industrial tasks, surpassing the strongest prior methods by +3.61 and +3.93 percentage points. In controlled 10-shot comparisons across three benchmarks on the same DINOv3 backbone, SMIA also outperforms parameter-matched AdaptFormer, LoRA, and ParaX with a better precision-recall balance.
zh_abstract: 跨域少样本分割旨在利用少量带像素标注的支持集掩码，将在自然图像上预训练的编码器适配到医学或工业领域。在冻结的 DINOv3 中，中间层各注意力头的消息（per-head attention messages）已经携带了目标与背景之间的区分信息，而基线方法的最终层相似度和预测并不能一致地反映这些信息。我们提出状态-消息交互适配器（State-Message Interaction Adapter，SMIA），在保持预训练注意力和 FFN 参数冻结的前提下，学习各头的消息应如何更新每个接收 token 的表示。SMIA 插入在各头聚合之后，将每个头的聚合输出（消息）的变换条件化于每个图像块的注意力前特征（状态），使得相似的上下文消息可以根据接收位置的不同产生不同甚至相反的更新。由于稀缺的支持集掩码仅覆盖有限的状态-消息组合，我们采用共享的低秩双线性映射，将所学习的交互限制在低维的状态、消息和输出子空间内。这些更新被加入每个被适配模块的冻结 FFN 之前，得到的适配后特征再由冻结的 FFN 和更深的模块进一步精炼，用于线性读出。SMIA 仅有 0.51M 可训练参数，推理时单次前向且无需支持集；在 20 个医学和工业任务的六个数据集上，其 5-shot 和 10-shot 的平均 mIoU 分别达到 77.40% 和 80.99%，较此前最强方法分别高出 3.61 和 3.93 个百分点。在同一 DINOv3 骨干网络上、跨三个基准的受控 10-shot 比较中，SMIA 也优于参数量相当的 AdaptFormer、LoRA 和 ParaX，并具有更好的精确率-召回率平衡。

title: Machine Learning Prediction of Antibiotic Resistance Genes: Performance, Interpretability, and Cross-Database Redundancy
zh_title: 抗生素耐药基因的机器学习预测：性能、可解释性与跨库冗余
summary: 以XGBoost基于氨基酸三联体频率和理化特征在CARD上分类耐药基因，AUROC 0.982，并用SHAP解释，探讨跨数据库冗余。
key_points: AUROC 0.982，MCC 0.886
标签打乱基线降至随机水平
SHAP指出KTG、等电点、芳香性为关键特征
reason: 预印本，单库内评估，传统方法增量
abstract: Antibiotic resistance gene (ARG) classifiers are typically developed and evaluated within a single curated database, leaving open how much two independently curated databases agree and what that implies for apparent cross-database generalization. We trained an XGBoost classifier on amino acid trigram frequencies and physicochemical descriptors using the Comprehensive Antibiotic Resistance Database (CARD), the field's largest curated ARG resource. The model separated resistance genes from non-resistance proteins with near-ceiling accuracy (AUROC = 0.982, MCC = 0.886); a label-shuffling null baseline collapsed to chance (AUROC = 0.508) and bootstrap confidence intervals were narrow, confirming genuine signal rather than data leakage or overfitting. SHAP analysis attributed this performance to biologically interpretable features, notably the trigram KTG, isoelectric point, and aromaticity, each consistent with known catalytic motifs in resistance enzymes. Before testing the classifier against ResFinder, one of CARD's most widely used counterparts, we assessed database independence by clustering sequences with CD-HIT, finding that 96.8-98.7% of ResFinder sequences shared substantial protein identity with CARD even at a permissive 50% identity threshold, indicating the two databases largely represent the same sequence population, with direct implications for how cross-database generalization should be measured. On the small subset of ResFinder sequences genuinely non-redundant with CARD (40-100 sequences, depending on threshold), the classifier failed completely, never classifying any as resistance genes; SHAP traced this failure to sequence length, as non-redundant sequences are nearly three times longer than training proteins, and length is among the model's most influential features. The same pattern emerged by resistance mechanism: the model achieved perfect accuracy on beta-lactamases, compact single-domain enzymes well represented in training (100%, n = 351), but correctly identified only 38.5% of efflux pump components (n = 13), a mechanism built from large, multi-domain transporters rather than compact catalytic enzymes. Together, these results describe a capable, interpretable ARG classifier alongside a quantified methodological caution: cross-database redundancy must be measured rather than assumed, and when a sequence-composition classifier fails, the failure is often explained by protein architecture rather than database origin.
zh_abstract: 抗生素耐药基因（ARG）分类器通常在单一的人工整理数据库内开发和评估，因此两个独立整理的数据库之间一致程度如何，以及这对表观的跨数据库泛化意味着什么，仍悬而未决。我们使用该领域最大的人工整理ARG资源——综合抗生素耐药性数据库（CARD），基于氨基酸三联体频率和理化描述符训练了XGBoost分类器。该模型以接近上限的准确度区分耐药基因与非耐药蛋白（AUROC = 0.982，MCC = 0.886）；标签打乱的零模型基线降至随机水平（AUROC = 0.508），自助法（bootstrap）置信区间较窄，证实其反映的是真实信号，而非数据泄漏或过拟合。SHAP分析将这一性能归因于具有生物学可解释性的特征，尤其是三联体KTG、等电点和芳香性，均与耐药酶中已知的催化基序一致。在用ResFinder（CARD最广泛使用的同类数据库之一）检验该分类器之前，我们通过CD-HIT对序列聚类来评估数据库的独立性，发现即使在宽松的50%同一性阈值下，仍有96.8–98.7%的ResFinder序列与CARD具有显著的蛋白同一性，表明两个数据库在很大程度上代表相同的序列群体，这对于应如何衡量跨数据库泛化具有直接意义。在ResFinder中与CARD真正非冗余的少量序列子集上（取决于阈值，为40–100条序列），分类器完全失败，没有将任何序列判为耐药基因；SHAP将这一失败追溯到序列长度：非冗余序列的长度几乎是训练蛋白的三倍，而长度是模型最具影响力的特征之一。按耐药机制分析也出现了相同模式：模型对β-内酰胺酶（训练中代表性充分的紧凑单结构域酶）达到完美准确率（100%，n = 351），但对外排泵组分仅正确识别38.5%（n = 13），外排泵由大型多结构域转运蛋白而非紧凑的催化酶构成。总之，这些结果既呈现了一个能力良好且可解释的ARG分类器，也给出了量化的方法学警示：跨数据库冗余必须加以测量而非想当然，而当序列组成分类器失败时，其原因往往在于蛋白质结构架构，而非数据库来源。

title: Pharmacophore-Inspired Virtual Receptor: Generating Realistic Peptide Binding Data for Machine Learning
zh_title: VReceptor：为机器学习生成逼真的肽结合数据
summary: 提出结合药效团加权与氨基酸相似性的虚拟受体模拟框架，用PrRP数据集验证，可用于肽设计与主动学习。
key_points: 虚拟受体生成序列依赖的结合数据
用PrRP数据集验证结合行为近似
支持肽设计与主动学习流程
reason: 预印本，单数据集验证，增量档
abstract: VReceptor is a virtual receptor simulation framework that generates realistic, sequence-dependent binding data for peptide-based therapeutics. It combines pharmacophore-inspired weighting schemes with amino acid similarity metrics to evaluate peptide design strategies in a controlled environment. Validation using the Prolactin-Releasing Peptide (PrRP) dataset confirms VReceptor's ability to approximate binding behaviours and optimize experimental planning. This framework empowers researchers in computational peptide design and active learning workflows while highlighting areas for further refinement.
zh_abstract: VReceptor是一种虚拟受体模拟框架，可为肽类治疗药物生成真实的、序列依赖性的结合数据。它将受药效团启发的加权方案与氨基酸相似性度量相结合，以在受控环境中评估肽设计策略。使用催乳素释放肽（PrRP）数据集进行的验证证实，VReceptor能够近似模拟结合行为并优化实验规划。该框架可为计算肽设计和主动学习工作流程中的研究人员提供支持，同时也指出了有待进一步改进的方面。

title: Automated segmentation of renal structures using brightfield images of unstained kidney biopsies
zh_title: 未染色肾活检明场图像的肾脏结构自动分割
summary: 针对未染色肾活检明场显微图像，综述并评估现有分割方法，以减少对染色的依赖并保留组织用于分子分析。
key_points: 未染色图像对比度低，分割困难
旨在减少染色带来的变异并保留组织
对肾脏明场图像分割方法进行全面综述
reason: 病理方向预印本，摘要未见外部验证或大样本，属增量档
abstract: The automated segmentation of unstained kidney brightfield microscopy images remains a significant challenge in medical imaging. In conventional histopathology, staining provides crucial structural and molecular contrast, allowing renal compartments and structures to be readily distinguished. The absence of staining markedly reduces this contrast, obscuring the fine architectural details that are essential for diagnosis. Addressing this gap would reduce reliance on staining protocols, reduce technical and interpretive variability, and preserve valuable tissue for downstream molecular or multi-omics analyses. Ultimately, automation of unstained image segmentation could enable faster, more objective tissue analysis while preserving samples for further molecular testing. In this work, we provide a comprehensive review of state-of-the-art segmentation methods applied to renal brightfield microscopy images. Current findings highlight a predominance of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based architectures for semantic segmentation approaches while recent trends point to the growing application of transformer-based and instance-segmentation strategies. However, the field is still hampered by the scarcity and poor annotation of publicly available renal datasets. Aiming to further contribute to the enhancement of the field, a dataset of 18 Whole Slide Images (WSIs) of unstained human kidney tissue is made publicly available. Additionally, in the dataset, we provide 543 annotated tiles extracted from the WSIs, facilitating further research into stain-independent segmentation approaches. As a third contribution, we present a preliminary case study, evaluating state-of-the-art deep learning segmentation architectures, including U-Net and Segment Anything Model (SAM). Our preliminary results indicate that deep learning models demonstrate promising segmentation performance in unstained kidney biopsies. In alignment with these findings, advanced customised loss functions and data augmentation were integrated into the supervised training of the promising U-Net, DeepLabv3+, and TransUNet models, achieving significant improvements compared to the baseline experiments. To exploit the abundance of unlabelled data, we further tested FixMatchSeg, a semi-supervised learning method; however, its segmentation performance remained slightly behind the supervised methods. Taken together, these contributions establish a foundation for future research in stain-independent Computationa
zh_abstract: 未染色肾脏明场显微镜图像的自动分割仍是医学影像领域的一项重大挑战。在传统组织病理学中，染色提供了关键的结构和分子对比，使肾脏的各个区室和结构易于区分。缺乏染色会显著降低这种对比度，掩盖对诊断至关重要的精细结构细节。解决这一空白将减少对染色流程的依赖，降低技术和判读变异，并为下游分子或多组学分析保留宝贵的组织。最终，未染色图像分割的自动化可实现更快速、更客观的组织分析，同时为进一步分子检测保留样本。在本工作中，我们对应用于肾脏明场显微镜图像的最新分割方法进行了全面综述。目前的发现表明，语义分割方法以基于卷积神经网络（CNN）的架构为主，而近期趋势显示基于Transformer和实例分割的策略应用日益增多。然而，该领域仍受限于公开可用肾脏数据集的稀缺和标注不佳。为进一步推动该领域的发展，我们公开了一个包含18张未染色人类肾组织全切片图像（WSI）的数据集。此外，数据集中还提供了从WSI中提取的543个已标注图块，以促进对不依赖染色的分割方法的进一步研究。作为第三项贡献，我们呈现了一项初步案例研究，评估了包括U-Net和Segment Anything Model（SAM）在内的最新深度学习分割架构。我们的初步结果表明，深度学习模型在未染色肾活检中显示出有前景的分割性能。与此发现一致，我们将先进的定制损失函数和数据增强整合进有前景的U-Net、DeepLabv3+和TransUNet模型的监督训练中，与基线实验相比取得了显著改善。为利用大量未标注数据，我们进一步测试了半监督学习方法FixMatchSeg；然而，其分割性能仍略低于监督方法。综上，这些贡献为不依赖染色的计算病理学的未来研究奠定了基础（原文在此处截断）

title: Recording sampling rate as a negative-control exposure for detecting measurement-driven bias in heart-rate-variability-outcome associations: a quantitative bias analysis across ICU waveform databases
zh_title: 以记录采样率作阴性对照暴露检测HRV与结局关联中的测量偏倚
summary: 方法学研究，利用ICU波形数据库间ECG采样率差异作为阴性对照暴露，并用定量偏倚分析评估HRV-结局关联对测量失真的敏感性。
key_points: HRV值受ECG采样率系统性扭曲
采样率作为阴性对照暴露检测测量驱动偏倚
跨多个ICU波形数据库开展定量偏倚分析
reason: 方法学价值有限的预印本，摘要未见具体结果
abstract: Importance. Heart-rate variability (HRV) is studied extensively as a prognostic marker in critical illness, yet the electrocardiographic sampling rate at which HRV is computed systematically distorts the resulting values. Whether the associations between HRV and clinical outcomes reported in the literature are partly a consequence of this distortion has not been examined directly. Objective. To evaluate whether between-database differences in native ECG sampling rate can be used as a negative-control exposure to detect measurement-driven bias in HRV-outcome associations, and to quantify the sensitivity of a published association to an empirically measured distortion coefficient using quantitative bias analysis (QBA). Design. A methods investigation in three parts. Part I sets out the causal structure and states why a strict instrumental-variable (IV) design is inappropriate here. Part II derives a bias-correction factor under a multiplicative measurement-error model and propagates the empirical confidence interval of the distortion coefficient as a sensitivity band. Part III applies the procedure to an observed HRV-mortality association from a single ICU waveform database, and examines the separate bias arising from threshold-based categorisation. Setting and data sources. Two critical-care waveform databases with different native sampling rates (MIMIC-IV Waveform, approximately 250 Hz; MIMIC-III Waveform Matched p04, 125 Hz) and an independent 500-Hz reference cohort (PTB-XL) for mechanism validation. The outcome association was estimated in 1,445 ICU stays from MIMIC-III p04, of whom 141 died in hospital (9.8%). Exposures. Native ECG sampling rate as a negative-control exposure; SDNN, RMSSD and heart rate as the measured exposures whose associations with mortality are evaluated. Main outcomes and measures. In-hospital mortality. Distortion coefficients were obtained by end-to-end reprocessing of 7,293 original waveform segments with a fixed QRS detector. Corrected odds ratios were reported as QBA sensitivity bands rather than point-identified effects. Misclassification was quantified as the proportion of recordings below a 20 ms HRV threshold reclassified above it by coarse sampling. Results. End-to-end reprocessing gave an RMSSD distortion coefficient of 1.1575 (95% CI 1.0835-1.2492; 2,276 segments in 188 patients) for 250->62.5 Hz and 1.0588 (95% CI 1.0294-1.1033; 4,988 segments) for 125->62.5 Hz; high-frequency power was more affected than low-frequen
zh_abstract:
【重要性】心率变异性（HRV）作为危重症预后标志物已被广泛研究，然而计算HRV所用的心电图采样率会系统性地扭曲所得数值。文献中报告的HRV与临床结局之间的关联是否部分源于这种扭曲，尚未得到直接检验。
【目的】评估不同数据库间原始心电图采样率的差异能否作为阴性对照暴露，用于检测HRV–结局关联中由测量所致的偏倚，并使用定量偏倚分析（QBA）量化已发表关联对经验测得的扭曲系数的敏感性。
【设计】一项分为三部分的方法学研究。第一部分阐明因果结构，并说明为何此处不适合采用严格的工具变量（IV）设计。第二部分在乘性测量误差模型下推导偏倚校正因子，并将扭曲系数的经验置信区间作为敏感性区间进行传递。第三部分将该程序应用于单一ICU波形数据库中观察到的HRV–死亡率关联，并考察基于阈值分类所产生的独立偏倚。
【背景与数据来源】两个原始采样率不同的重症监护波形数据库（MIMIC-IV Waveform，约250 Hz；MIMIC-III Waveform Matched p04，125 Hz），以及用于机制验证的独立500 Hz参考队列（PTB-XL）。结局关联在 MIMIC-III p04 的1,445例ICU住院中估计，其中141例在院内死亡（9.8%）。
【暴露】原始心电图采样率作为阴性对照暴露；SDNN、RMSSD 和心率作为被测暴露，评估其与死亡率的关联。
【主要结局与指标】院内死亡率。扭曲系数通过使用固定QRS检测器对7,293个原始波形片段进行端到端重新处理而获得。校正后的比值比以QBA敏感性区间而非点识别效应的形式报告。错误分类以HRV低于20 ms阈值的记录因粗采样而被重新分类至阈值以上的比例来量化。
【结果】端到端重新处理得出的RMSSD扭曲系数：250→62.5 Hz 为1.1575（95% CI 1.0835–1.2492；188例患者的2,276个片段），125→62.5 Hz 为1.0588（95% CI 1.0294–1.1033；4,988个片段）；高频功率比低频受到的影响更大（原文此处截断）

title: Quantum Machine Learning for Missense Variant Pathogenicity Prediction in the KCNQ Gene Family
zh_title: 量子机器学习预测KCNQ基因家族错义变异致病性
summary: 预印本称首次将量子机器学习用于错义变异致病性预测，混合量子框架在KCNQ家族上AUC-ROC约0.94，与经典方法相当或更优。

覆盖KCNQ全基因家族

abstract: Missense variants in the KCNQ family of voltage-gated potassium channel genes are associated with a broad spectrum of neurological and cardiac disorders for which computational tools capable of differentiating benign and pathogenic variants are essential. Here, we present, to our knowledge, the first application of quantum machine learning (QML) to missense pathogenicity prediction. We employ a hybrid quantum framework combining data re-uploading quantum neural networks with quantum support vector machines and applied it to pathogenicity classification across the full KCNQ gene family. Systematic exploration of circuit architectures revealed that optimal hyperparameter choices enable the proposed quantum model to achieve predictive performance superior to or comparable to state-of-the-art classical machine learning approaches, reaching AUC-ROC values of approximately 0.94 across the full dataset. Although no clear quantum advantage is observed at present, these results demonstrate that quantum feature representations can effectively capture biologically relevant patterns in variant data and establish QML as a viable framework for future applications in computational genomics and precision medicine.
zh_abstract: KCNQ家族电压门控钾通道基因的错义变异与多种神经系统和心脏疾病相关，因此需要能够区分良性与致病性变异的计算工具。据我们所知，本文首次将量子机器学习（QML）应用于错义变异致病性预测。我们采用一种混合量子框架，将数据重上传量子神经网络与量子支持向量机相结合，并将其应用于整个KCNQ基因家族的致病性分类。对电路架构的系统探索表明，选择最优超参数可使所提出的量子模型取得优于或可比于最先进经典机器学习方法的预测性能，在整个数据集上AUC-ROC值约为0.94。尽管目前尚未观察到明确的量子优势，但这些结果表明量子特征表示能够有效捕捉变异数据中与生物学相关的模式，并确立了QML作为未来计算基因组学和精准医学应用的可行框架。

abstract: [Journal of clinical medicine] Background/Objectives: Sarcopenia is a progressive skeletal muscle disorder associated with adverse health outcomes, including disability, hospitalization, and mortality. Despite the availability of consensus-based diagnostic criteria, its identification in clinical practice remains limited due to reliance on specialized assessments and resource-intensive measurements. Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) approaches have emerged as promising tools to enhance sarcopenia detection; however, evidence remains methodologically heterogeneous and has not been comprehensively synthesized. The objective was to systematically map the existing literature on AI/ML models developed to detect or predict sarcopenia, describing their methodological characteristics, input features, model performance, validation strategies, and adherence to reporting standards. Methods: A scoping review was conducted following PRISMA-ScR guidelines. Searches were performed in five databases (MEDLINE, Scopus, SciELO, Web of Science, and LILACS) from inception to 28 February 2026. Studies were included if they developed and/or validated AI/ML models for binary classification of sarcopenia using recognized consensus definitions. Two reviewers independently screened studies, extracted data, and assessed adherence to TRIPOD+AI reporting recommendations and appraised methodological quality using the NHLBI Quality Assessment Tool. Findings were synthesized descriptively. The review protocol was registered in the Open Science Framework. Results: Of 2910 records, 28 studies (n = 34,498 participants in the primary analytical cohorts, with an additional 2800 participants in independent external validation cohorts) were included, predominantly from Asia (China n = 14, South Korea n = 7). Random Forest was the most frequent algorithm (n = 6), followed by voting classifiers, MLP, and XGBoost (n = 4 each). Clinical tabular data, including anthropometric and laboratory variables, were the most common input features. Model performance was generally high, with AUC values ranging from 0.710 to 0.975 (mean ≈ 0.869), although heterogeneity across populations and validation strategies was substantial. External validation was performed in only 7 of the 28 studies (25%). No study fully adhered to TRIPOD+AI recommendations; mean compliance was moderate, with critical gaps in code sharing, patient/public involvement, external validation, and subgroup performance reporting. Conclusions: AI/ML models

【方法】按照PRISMA-ScR指南开展范围综述。检索了五个数据库（MEDLINE、Scopus、SciELO、Web of Science和LILACS），检索时间从建库至2026年2月28日。纳入使用公认共识定义、开发和/或验证用于肌少症二分类的AI/ML模型的研究。两名评审员独立筛选研究、提取数据，评估其对TRIPOD+AI报告建议的遵循情况，并使用NHLBI质量评估工具评价方法学质量。研究结果采用描述性方式综合。综述方案已在Open Science Framework注册。
【结果】在2910条记录中，共纳入28项研究（主要分析队列n = 34,498名参与者，另有2800名参与者来自独立外部验证队列），主要来自亚洲（中国n = 14，韩国n = 7）。随机森林是最常用的算法（n = 6），其次是投票分类器、MLP和XGBoost（各n = 4）。包括人体测量和实验室变量在内的临床表格数据是最常见的输入特征。模型性能总体较高，AUC值范围为0.710至0.975（均值约0.869），但不同人群和验证策略之间的异质性较大。28项研究中仅7项（25%）进行了外部验证。没有研究完全遵循TRIPOD+AI建议；平均依从程度为中等，在代码共享、患者/公众参与、外部验证和亚组性能报告方面存在关键缺失。
【结论】AI/ML模型

abstract: [Heart failure clinics] This article examines the evolving role of artificial intelligence (AI) across the continuum of care in cardiomyopathies, from opportunistic screening to decision-critical risk stratification. AI-enhanced electrocardiography enables scalable early detection, while advanced echocardiographic and cardiac magnetic resonance-based radiomics refine myocardial substrate characterization. Multimodal models integrating imaging, electrical, and clinical data refine risk stratification beyond conventional metrics such as left ventricular ejection fraction. However, clinical translation requires external validation, calibration stability, interpretability, and structured workflow integration. AI emerges not as autonomous diagnosis, but as accountable, clinician-supervised decision support embedded within multidisciplinary cardiovascular care.

title: The Formal-Functional Gap: How Artificial Intelligence Reshapes Medical Professional Identity.
source: PubMed · Advances in medical education and practice

abstract: [Advances in medical education and practice] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into clinical practice and medical education, yet research on AI and medical professional identity has largely evolved in parallel. To examine how AI is transforming fundamental components of medical professional identity and propose a framework for understanding its implications for professional identity formation in medical education. This narrative review synthesizes conceptual, empirical, and theoretical literature on AI, professional identity formation, and clinical practice through iterative literature searching and citation tracking. Peer-reviewed studies, regulatory data, and national survey reports were considered. AI affects professional identity unevenly. Diagnostic, predictive, generative, and emerging autonomous systems most directly influence expertise, clinical reasoning, and professional autonomy, shifting physicians from exclusive holders of specialized knowledge toward validators of increasingly accessible but variably trusted information. Evidence of automation bias and reduced diagnostic performance highlights this transition. We conceptualize the divergence between the formal locus of clinical responsibility, which remains with physicians, and the functional locus of influence decisions, shared with AI, as the formal-functional gap (FFG). Its magnitude varies by AI configuration, identity component, and career stage, potentially placing trainees at risk of never-skilling and experienced physicians at risk of deskilling. Ethical responsibility, humanistic care, lifelong learning, and professional authority are affected more indirectly. AI-mediated professional identity change reflects a dynamic interaction between physicians' developmental trajectories and evolving AI capabilities. Medical education should prioritize sustained expertise, clinical reasoning, professional autonomy, AI-interpretive judgment, and human oversight. The FFG remains a conceptual framework whose relationships require empirical validation.
zh_abstract:
【背景】[医学教育与实践进展] 人工智能（AI）日益融入临床实践和医学教育，但有关AI与医学职业身份的研究在很大程度上是各自平行发展的。
【目的】探讨AI如何改变医学职业身份的基本组成部分，并提出一个框架，用于理解其对医学教育中职业身份形成的影响。
【方法】本叙述性综述通过迭代式文献检索和引文追踪，综合了关于AI、职业身份形成和临床实践的概念性、实证性和理论性文献。纳入了同行评审研究、监管数据和全国性调查报告。
【结果】AI对职业身份的影响并不均衡。诊断型、预测型、生成型以及新兴的自主系统最直接地影响专业知识、临床推理和职业自主性，使医生从专业知识的唯一持有者转变为对日益易得但可信度不一的信息进行验证的人。自动化偏倚和诊断表现下降的证据凸显了这一转变。我们将临床责任的正式归属（仍由医生承担）与决策影响的功能性归属（与AI共享）之间的分歧概念化为“正式-功能差距”（formal-functional gap，FFG）。其大小因AI配置、身份组成部分和职业阶段而异，可能使受训者面临“从未获得技能”（never-skilling）的风险，使经验丰富的医生面临技能退化（deskilling）的风险。伦理责任、人文关怀、终身学习和职业权威受到的影响则较为间接。AI介导的职业身份变化反映了医生发展轨迹与不断演进的AI能力之间的动态相互作用。
【结论】医学教育应优先重视持续的专业知识、临床推理、职业自主性、对AI的解读判断能力以及人的监督。FFG仍是一个概念框架，其相互关系有待实证验证。

abstract: Philosophers have recently been trying to develop uniform decision rules for instances in which physicians' judgments diverge from the recommendations of medical artificial intelligence (AI) systems. I argue that this effort is fatally flawed because the performance and appropriate use of algorithmic recommendation systems by physicians are highly context-specific, empirical medical matters rather than epistemological ones. In such instances, general decision rules can be stipulated only to the extent that they abstract away from relevant, indeed determinative, contextual circumstances. The alleged problem of physician-AI disagreement, and others like it, play into longstanding disputes in technology ethics about the viability and utility of envisioning possible futures: is this useful "anticipation" or wasteful "speculation"? I suggest that the two may be distinguished. Anticipation explores plausible futures to help inform present actions under irreducible uncertainty. Speculation abstracts away uncertainty, developing formal solutions to stipulated circumstances whose relationship to the real present is often quite unclear. Efforts to develop crisp philosophical solutions to physician-AI disagreement, among other problems, fall into the latter category. Technology ethics should remember that fruitful futures thinking must both begin from and return to the messy, uncertain present.

abstract: Analysis of fibrous structures in SEM images is a routine task in biomedical engineering and materials science. However, most available methods for fiber quantification still rely on classical image binarization followed by simple post-processing. These approaches often produce unreliable results in images with weak boundaries, heterogeneous contrast, and densely packed fibers. Here, we introduce Fiberpose, a framework that reformulates fiber analysis as direct regression of a smooth distance-transform (DT) field, together with a novel set of geometry-based algorithms specifically adapted to this representation. The predicted field directly encodes fiber geometry, while the accompanying algorithms enable instance reconstruction and measurement of diameter and orientation within a unified workflow. The framework is implemented as a standalone Python desktop application and a web tool https://fiberpose.org. On an independent dataset of fibrous SEM images, Fiberpose achieved state-of-the-art instance-segmentation accuracy in comparison with SAM2 and Cellpose-SAM, and more accurate diameter measurements than DiameterJ, Fibar and GIFT. The method remains effective in dense and weakly contrasted regions and shows qualitative generalization across microscopy modalities not represented in the training data. Fiberpose therefore provides an interpretable geometric representation and an automated pipeline for reproducible quantitative characterization of fibrous materials.
zh_abstract: 扫描电镜（SEM）图像中纤维结构的分析是生物医学工程和材料科学中的常规任务。然而，现有大多数纤维定量方法仍依赖经典的图像二值化加简单后处理。在边界较弱、对比度不均匀以及纤维密集堆积的图像中，这些方法往往产生不可靠的结果。在此，我们提出 Fiberpose，该框架将纤维分析重新表述为对平滑距离变换（DT）场的直接回归，并配套一套专门针对该表示形式设计的、基于几何的新算法。预测得到的场直接编码了纤维几何信息，而配套算法则可在统一的工作流程中完成实例重建以及直径和取向的测量。该框架以独立的 Python 桌面应用程序和网页工具 https://fiberpose.org 的形式实现。在一个独立的纤维状 SEM 图像数据集上，与 SAM2 和 Cellpose-SAM 相比，Fiberpose 达到了最先进的实例分割精度；与 DiameterJ、Fibar 和 GIFT 相比，其直径测量更为准确。该方法在密集及低对比度区域依然有效，并在训练数据未涵盖的多种显微成像模态上表现出定性的泛化能力。因此，Fiberpose 为纤维材料的可重复定量表征提供了可解释的几何表示和自动化流程。

title: Rethinking the public health research ecosystem in the era of artificial intelligence: from evidence generation to population impact.

summary: 文章提出AI赋能的公共卫生研究生态，并引入“证据到行动延迟”概念，指出瓶颈转向验证、治理与实施。

abstract: [Frontiers in public health] Public health is constrained less by the generation of evidence than by the time to act on it; artificial intelligence should be judged by whether it shortens that gap. AI has largely been evaluated within disciplinary silos, obscuring how choices at one stage of the research process shape the next. In this article, we propose an AI-enabled public health research ecosystem spanning evidence synthesis, knowledge extraction, prediction, adaptive implementation, health system operations and policy, and introduce evidence-to-action latency: the interval between recognising a problem and implementing an evidence-informed response. AI does not remove the bottlenecks; it relocates them from generating evidence towards validation, governance, implementation and workforce capability. These capabilities are least available in low-resource and community-based services, where need is greatest. Because inequity in source data propagates through every subsequent stage, the aim is equity-preserving latency, not speed alone. The AI-READY Framework sets out the conditions for responsible integration. The greatest gains will come from redesigning research systems rather than optimising individual methods.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in public health] 公共卫生的制约因素不在于证据的产生，而在于将证据付诸行动所需的时间；评判人工智能（artificial intelligence，AI）的标准应是其能否缩短这一差距。AI 在很大程度上是在各学科壁垒内被评估的，这掩盖了研究过程中某一阶段的选择如何影响下一阶段。本文提出一个涵盖证据综合、知识提取、预测、适应性实施、卫生系统运行与政策的 AI 赋能公共卫生研究生态系统，并引入“证据到行动延迟”（evidence-to-action latency）这一概念：即从认识到问题到实施以证据为依据的应对措施之间的时间间隔。AI 并不会消除瓶颈，而是将瓶颈从证据生成转移到验证、治理、实施和劳动力能力方面。这些能力在资源匮乏和社区为基础的服务中最为缺乏，而这些地方的需求恰恰最大。由于源数据中的不公平会传递到后续每一个阶段，因此目标应是保持公平的延迟缩短，而不仅仅是速度。AI-READY 框架（AI-READY Framework）提出了负责任整合的条件。最大的收益将来自对研究系统的重新设计，而非对单个方法的优化。

abstract: Background: With the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI), large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT have demonstrated strong potential to transform healthcare research and practice. However, LLMs are probabilistic and generate inherently variable outputs, which create risk and uncertainty in healthcare applications. Therefore, analyzing the current research landscape of ChatGPT applications is imperative to understand applied techniques and related concerns and to facilitate their practical integration into healthcare information systems. Objective: Leveraging LLM-based agentic AI with domain experts to analyze trends in ChatGPT healthcare applications and to examine the collaborative and interpretative capacities of LLM agents in broader contexts beyond narrowly defined topics. Methods: The review used a systematic search of the PubMed and Web of Science databases, following PRISMA-ScR guidelines, and focused on ChatGPT applications, associated concerns, applied techniques, and usage factors. To support the review process, an adaptive, iterative LLM-based agentic AI with a human-in-the-loop mechanism was employed for automated metadata extraction, identification, classification, and knowledge synthesis. The extracted information was subsequently used for temporal and thematic analyses, citation network construction, and main-path analysis. Results: Across 192 papers, the review identified 511 ChatGPT application types, 690 concern items, and 368 influence usage factors distinct from traditional IT, achieving a metadata error rate of 1.04%. The human-agentic AI workflow enabled efficient synthesis of contextual information across studies, addressing the growing challenge of timely evidence integration in medical knowledge. The findings provide insights into the evolving trajectories of ChatGPT applications in healthcare and demonstrate the value of an expert-validated human-agentic AI workflow in supporting literature analysis and streamlining review processes. Conclusion: This review provides a comprehensive overview of emerging ChatGPT applications, associated concerns, applied techniques, and usage factors in healthcare. The study further provides meaningful insights into the operational mechanisms of agentic AI, demonstrating the potential of human-AI collaboration for medical informatics research.
zh_abstract: 【背景】随着人工智能（AI）的快速发展，ChatGPT等大语言模型（LLM）已显示出变革医疗研究与实践的强大潜力。然而，LLM具有概率性，其输出本质上存在变异，这给医疗应用带来风险和不确定性。因此，分析ChatGPT应用的当前研究格局，对于了解所应用的技术和相关问题，并促进其在医疗信息系统中的实际整合至关重要。【目的】借助基于LLM的智能体AI（agentic AI）与领域专家合作，分析ChatGPT医疗应用的趋势，并考察LLM智能体在超出狭义主题的更广泛情境下的协作和解释能力。【方法】本综述按照PRISMA-ScR指南，对PubMed和Web of Science数据库进行系统检索，聚焦于ChatGPT应用、相关问题、所用技术及使用因素。为支持综述过程，采用了带有人在回路机制的自适应、迭代式LLM智能体AI，用于自动元数据提取、识别、分类和知识综合。所提取的信息随后用于时间和主题分析、引文网络构建以及主路径分析。【结果】在192篇论文中，本综述识别出511种ChatGPT应用类型、690项问题条目和368项有别于传统信息技术的影响使用因素，元数据错误率为1.04%。人-智能体AI工作流程能够高效综合各研究的情境信息，应对医学知识中及时整合证据这一日益严峻的挑战。研究结果为ChatGPT在医疗领域应用的演变轨迹提供了见解，并证明了经专家验证的人-智能体AI工作流程在支持文献分析和简化综述流程方面的价值。【结论】本综述全面概述了医疗领域中新兴的ChatGPT应用、相关问题、所用技术和使用因素。本研究还为智能体AI的运作机制提供了有意义的见解，展示了人机协作在医学信息学研究中的潜力。

abstract: [Clinics in plastic surgery] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly shaping patient assessment, communication, and clinical decision-making in plastic surgery. Its potential benefits are accompanied by risks of plausible but inaccurate outputs, demographic and esthetic bias, compromised image privacy, and weakened human oversight. These risks become more consequential as systems move from providing information to recommending and executing clinical actions. This review examines the implications for patient safety, informed consent, equity, and professional accountability and outlines safeguards that scale with clinical risk and autonomy, emphasizing validation, continuous monitoring, and preservation of independent surgical judgment.

abstract: [Clinics in plastic surgery] Artificial intelligence (AI) has rapidly transformed education, including plastic surgical training through adaptive learning platforms, automated competency assessment and intraoperative performance analytics. These platforms support competency-based medical education by enabling continuous objective evaluation, personalized feedback, trajectory predictions, and scalable simulation environments. Emerging applications include virtual patients, plastic surgery-specific adaptive question banks, surgical video analysis, and augmented-reality operative guidance. Despite promising gains in efficiency and educational precision, implementation will require careful validation, transparency, and sustained expert oversight. Strategic AI integration into training programs offers the potential to enhance technical skill acquisition, standardize evaluation and expand access to high-quality surgical education globally.
zh_abstract: [整形外科临床]人工智能（AI）已迅速改变了教育领域，包括通过自适应学习平台、自动化能力评估和术中表现分析来改变整形外科培训。这些平台通过实现持续客观评价、个性化反馈、轨迹预测以及可扩展的模拟环境，支持基于胜任力的医学教育。新兴应用包括虚拟患者、整形外科专用的自适应题库、手术视频分析以及增强现实手术导航。尽管在效率和教育精准度方面前景可期，但其实施仍需要审慎的验证、透明度和持续的专家监督。将AI战略性地整合进培训项目，有望提升技术技能的获得、使评价标准化，并在全球范围内扩大高质量外科教育的可及性。

abstract: [Clinics in plastic surgery] This article surveys artificial intelligence (AI) applications across aesthetic plastic surgery, spanning large language models (publicly available software, practice chatbots, and clinical decision support tools), simulation technologies (3 dimensional imaging platforms like Vectra and Crisalix, generative adversarial network-based and diffusion-based image generation), surgical planning, and operational tools for documentation, billing, scheduling, and marketing. It highlights validation evidence where available, alongside persistent limitations including training data bias, hallucinations, black-box opacity, and unresolved regulatory and liability questions. Despite AI's expanding capabilities, individualized surgical judgment remains irreplaceable, positioning AI as a decision-support tool that enhances, rather than substitutes, the surgeon-patient relationship.

abstract: [Clinics in plastic surgery] Artificial intelligence (AI) offers surgical leaders a means of augmenting-not replacing-the craft of leadership. This article outlines practical applications across strategic vision, such as innovation and problem-solving, recruitment and faculty development, meetings and decision-making, project execution, academic productivity, and regulatory governance, while delineating where AI reliably fails: judgment, accountability, and contextual nuance. It introduces the throughput asymmetry that arises when AI-accelerated leaders outpace an unequipped implementing organization, and addresses the heterogeneous AI exposure spanning AI-native trainees and appropriately skeptical senior faculty. Governance should be constructed as an iterative loop rather than a static policy.
zh_abstract: [整形外科临床（Clinics in plastic surgery）] 人工智能（AI）为外科领导者提供了增强——而非取代——领导艺术的手段。本文概述了其在战略愿景（如创新与问题解决）、招聘与师资发展、会议与决策、项目执行、学术产出以及监管治理等方面的实际应用，同时指出了 AI 可靠地失效之处：判断、问责和情境细微差别。文章介绍了当由 AI 加速的领导者超越了未配备相应能力的执行组织时出现的吞吐量不对称，并探讨了从 AI 原生的受训者到持适度怀疑态度的资深教员之间 AI 接触程度的异质性。治理应被构建为一个迭代循环，而非静态政策。
